paragraphs.en: Consensus is a fundamental problem in distributed computing and at the core of state machine replication (SMR). Despite decades of active human research, discovering practical low-latency solutions to the problem is still open. This endeavor is very challenging since it requires combining protocol knowledge, correctness reasoning, implementation, and experimental evaluation. We report on how AI helped us discover A-greement , a new consensus protocol for geo-replicated state machines that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art solutions. Averaged across six deployments with 5 or 9 replicas, A-greement reduces the mean latency of a geo-distributed key-value store over the fastest baseline by 12.2% and 33.3% on write-heavy and read-heavy workloads, respectively, and matches the fastest baseline on read-only workloads. A-greement combines lease-authorized local reads, direct client learning for leader-ordered writes, and a fast fixed-quorum per-key write path. It selects replica roles and write paths according to network topology and workload, accounting for both write completion and read waiting. At the heart of our consensus discovery lies AI-greement , an agent harness for the “autonomous” discovery, implementation, experimentation, and verification of candidate protocols. AI-greement integrates (1) a concept-oriented protocol knowledge base that explores consensus mechanisms through published protocols, (2) a modular implementation skeleton that structures protocol development, and (3) a Lean -based verification framework with reusable safety definitions, reference specifications, and proofs. Our harness supports iterative design exploration, using performance measurements and fault-injection feedback to refine protocols. AI-greement is of independent interest, beyond A-greement . Its Lean formalization uncovers several previously unreported vulnerabilities in existing consensus protocols. AI-greement provides guidelines on how domain-specific harnesses can turn general-purpose coding agents into effective tools for (distributed) computing research. Yet we argue that human consensus experts remain essential before, during, and after the search: agents reshape the researcher’s role rather than end consensus research.
paragraphs.zh: 共识是分布式计算中的一个基本问题，也是状态机复制（SMR）的核心。 尽管人类已经进行了数十年的积极研究，发现该问题的实用低延迟解决方案仍是一个开放问题。 这项工作极具挑战性，因为它需要结合协议知识、正确性推理、实现以及实验评估。 我们报告了AI如何帮助我们发现了A-greement，这是一种面向地理复制状态机的新共识协议，其性能显著优于最先进的解决方案。 在5或9个副本的六种部署设置中取平均值，A-greement使地理分布式键值存储在写密集型和读密集型负载下的平均延迟分别比最快的基线降低了12.2%和33.3%，并在只读负载下与最快的基线持平。 A-greement结合了租约授权的本地读取、针对领导者排序写入的客户端直接学习，以及针对每个键的快速固定法定人数写入路径。 它根据网络拓扑和负载选择副本角色和写入路径，同时兼顾写入完成和读取等待。 我们共识发现工作的核心是AI-greement，这是一个智能体工具框架，用于候选协议的“自主”发现、实现、实验和验证。 AI-greement集成了：(1) 一个以概念为导向的协议知识库，通过已发表的协议探索共识机制；(2) 一个模块化的实现骨架，用于规范协议开发；(3) 一个基于Lean的验证框架，包含可复用的安全性定义、参考规范和证明。 我们的工具框架支持迭代式设计探索，利用性能测量和故障注入反馈来改进协议。 除A-greement之外，AI-greement本身也具有独立的价值。 其Lean形式化揭示了现有共识协议中若干此前未被报道的漏洞。 AI-greement提供了指导方针，说明领域特定的工具框架如何将通用编程智能体转化为（分布式）计算研究的有效工具。 然而，我们认为人类共识专家在搜索之前、期间和之后仍然不可或缺：智能体改变的是研究者的角色，而不是终结共识研究。

paragraphs.en: In SMR ( SMR ) [ 37 , 65 ] , a universal paradigm to build highly-available computing systems, consensus enables replicas to agree on a common sequence of client commands, maintaining consistent state despite concurrent requests and failures. Consensus is a fundamental building block of modern distributed systems, underpinning replicated databases [ 17 , 71 , 30 ] , storage systems [ 6 ] , cloud coordination services [ 10 ] and blockchain infrastructures [ 8 , 81 ] . Consensus has been an active research area for over four decades. However, designing and implementing consensus protocols that are both correct and practically efficient remains an exceptionally challenging task [ 12 , 55 ] . Protocol decisions involving ordering, quorums, recovery, and execution are tightly coupled: an optimization that shortens the common-case path may complicate recovery or introduce subtle correctness violations [ 12 , 70 , 64 ] , as we also find for the optimizations of EPaxos Revisited [ 75 ] ( § 8 ). Translating a protocol design into a working system further requires preserving its safety properties throughout implementation optimizations [ 25 , 79 , 68 ] , as well as demonstrating performance improvements across diverse network topologies and workloads. Advancing the state of the art in consensus therefore requires tightly integrating protocol knowledge, correctness reasoning, implementation and experimental evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 在状态机复制（SMR）[37, 65]这一构建高可用计算系统的通用范式中，共识使各个副本就客户端命令的公共序列达成一致，从而在并发请求和故障的情况下保持状态一致。 共识是现代分布式系统的基本构件，支撑着复制数据库[17, 71, 30]、存储系统[6]、云协调服务[10]以及区块链基础设施[8, 81]。 四十多年来，共识一直是一个活跃的研究领域。 然而，设计并实现既正确又具备实际效率的共识协议仍然是一项极具挑战性的任务[12, 55]。 涉及排序、法定人数（quorum）、恢复和执行的协议决策是紧密耦合的：缩短常见路径的优化可能会使恢复变得复杂，或引入微妙的正确性违规[12, 70, 64]，正如我们在对 EPaxos Revisited[75] 的优化中也发现的那样（§8）。 将协议设计转化为可运行的系统，还要求在整个实现优化过程中保持其安全性属性[25, 79, 68]，并在多样的网络拓扑和工作负载下展示性能提升。 因此，推进共识领域的最新技术水平，需要将协议知识、正确性推理、实现与实验评估紧密结合起来。

paragraphs.en: The overall question we address in this paper is whether, just like in other fields of computing, AI could help “crack” the consensus problem. More specifically, we aim to come up with a new practically effective solution that would, on the one hand, tolerate, besides failures of the processes, failures of the network ( i . e ., asynchronous periods) and, on the other hand, expedite decisions in common failure-free executions. In particular, we ask whether we can develop a consensus protocol that would yield an SMR scheme in which, in the common case, (a) read-only commands complete at a nearby replica and (b) commands with updates take one round trip to a majority of replicas. This would essentially be optimal. Importantly, and unlike many recent AI-assisted results in mathematics and theoretical computer science, we seek a protocol that is practically useful and hence, besides algorithmic design and proofs, consider the implementation, deployment and evaluation as part of the AI-assisted task.
paragraphs.zh: 本文所要探讨的总体问题是：与计算领域的其他方向一样，AI 能否帮助“攻克”共识问题。 更具体地说，我们旨在提出一种新的实用有效方案，一方面，除进程故障外，还能容忍网络故障（即异步期间），另一方面，能在通常无故障的执行中加快决策速度。 特别地，我们探讨能否设计出一个共识协议，由其构建一个 SMR 方案，使得在常见情况下，(a) 只读命令在附近的副本处完成，(b) 带有更新的命令只需一次到多数副本的往返。 这基本上就是最优的。 重要的是，与近来许多 AI 辅助的数学和理论计算机科学成果不同，我们寻求的是具有实用价值的协议，因此除算法设计与证明外，还将实现、部署和评估视为 AI 辅助任务的一部分。

Yet, we highlight the crucial role of the human researcher in the development of an adequate AI agent, the prompting of the agent as well as the certification of the agent’s output. We furthermore argue that this human researcher needs to be a consensus expert to effectively steer and leverage the capabilities of agents.

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in the capabilities of LLM have indeed enabled coding agents to autonomously perform increasingly complex software engineering tasks [ 35 , 80 ] . For example, Codex by OpenAI [ 57 ] , Claude Code by Anthropic [ 4 ] , and Cursor Agent by Anysphere [ 5 ] can navigate repositories, modify code, execute tests, and iteratively refine implementations based on execution feedback. However, these general-purpose capabilities do not necessarily translate into the autonomous discovery of consensus protocols. Existing AI-driven systems research frameworks optimize self-contained policies such as schedulers and load balancers in simulators [ 54 , 14 ] , but do not seem an adequate fit for consensus, whose logic is spread across many communicating, failure-prone nodes [ 14 ] . Our preliminary experiment in § 2.3 also suggests that a coding agent combined with a frontier LLM , starting from a single existing consensus codebase, finds only marginal improvements. This gap motivates the need for specific support for consensus research beyond general-purpose coding capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 能力的最新进展确实使编码智能体能够自主执行日益复杂的软件工程任务 [ 35 , 80 ] 。 例如，OpenAI 的 Codex [ 57 ] 、Anthropic 的 Claude Code [ 4 ] 以及 Anysphere 的 Cursor Agent [ 5 ] 可以浏览代码仓库、修改代码、执行测试，并根据执行反馈迭代地改进实现。 然而，这些通用能力并不一定能转化为共识协议的自主发现。 现有的 AI 驱动的系统研究框架在模拟器中优化自包含的策略，例如调度器和负载均衡器 [ 54 , 14 ] ，但似乎并不适合共识，因为共识的逻辑分布在许多相互通信且容易发生故障的节点上 [ 14 ] 。 我们在 § 2.3 中的初步实验也表明，将编码智能体与前沿 LLM 相结合，从单个现有共识代码库出发，只能找到微小的改进。 这一差距促使我们认识到，在通用编码能力之外，还需要针对共识研究的专门支持。

paragraphs.en: We present AI-greement , an agent harness that equips general-purpose coding agents with domain-specific support for autonomous consensus research. AI-greement addresses three key challenges in consensus discovery. First, synthesizing new protocols requires understanding and combining mechanisms scattered across the consensus literature. To support this, a concept-oriented protocol knowledge base organizes consensus mechanisms and grounds them in concrete examples from published protocols. Second, translating novel designs into executable implementations is challenging because consensus mechanisms often have complex protocol states and message flows. A modular implementation skeleton structures this scheme through well-defined components and interfaces, allowing the agent to focus on protocol-specific logic. Third, subtle correctness violations can escape conventional testing, which covers only a limited set of message orderings and failure scenarios. Formal verification closes this gap by proving safety for every execution of a protocol model, but writing such models and proofs from scratch for each candidate is too costly. A Lean -based verification framework therefore provides reusable safety definitions, reference specifications, and proof libraries, so the agent can obtain machine-checked evidence that its design, as modeled, is safe. These components work together in an iterative discovery process, where performance measurements and fault-injection results guide the agent toward more efficient and robust designs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 AI-greement，这是一个智能体框架，为通用编码智能体配备针对自主共识研究的领域特定支持。 AI-greement 解决了共识发现中的三个关键挑战。 首先，综合新协议需要理解并组合散落在共识文献中的各种机制。 为支持这一点，一个面向概念的协议知识库对共识机制进行组织，并将其锚定在已发表协议的具体实例上。 其次，将新设计转化为可执行的实现颇具挑战，因为共识机制通常具有复杂的协议状态和消息流。 一个模块化的实现骨架通过明确定义的组件和接口来构建该方案，使智能体能够专注于协议特定的逻辑。 第三，细微的正确性违例可能逃过常规测试的检测，因为常规测试只覆盖有限的消序排列和故障场景。 形式化验证通过证明协议模型的每一次执行都满足安全性来弥补这一缺口，但为每个候选协议从零开始编写此类模型和证明的代价过高。 因此，一个基于 Lean 的验证框架提供可复用的安全性定义、参考规范和证明库，使智能体能够获得机器可校验的证据，证明其设计（按所建模的形式）是安全的。 这些组件在一个迭代式的发现过程中协同工作，其中性能测量和故障注入结果引导智能体朝着更高效、更健壮的设计前进。

sents.en: We present AI-greement , an agent harness that equips general-purpose coding agents with domain-specific support for autonomous consensus research.
sents.zh: 我们提出 AI-greement，这是一个智能体框架，为通用编码智能体配备针对自主共识研究的领域特定支持。

sents.en: AI-greement addresses three key challenges in consensus discovery.
sents.zh: AI-greement 解决了共识发现中的三个关键挑战。

sents.en: First, synthesizing new protocols requires understanding and combining mechanisms scattered across the consensus literature.
sents.zh: 首先，综合新协议需要理解并组合散落在共识文献中的各种机制。

sents.en: To support this, a concept-oriented protocol knowledge base organizes consensus mechanisms and grounds them in concrete examples from published protocols.
sents.zh: 为支持这一点，一个面向概念的协议知识库对共识机制进行组织，并将其锚定在已发表协议的具体实例上。

sents.en: Second, translating novel designs into executable implementations is challenging because consensus mechanisms often have complex protocol states and message flows.
sents.zh: 其次，将新设计转化为可执行的实现颇具挑战，因为共识机制通常具有复杂的协议状态和消息流。

sents.en: A modular implementation skeleton structures this scheme through well-defined components and interfaces, allowing the agent to focus on protocol-specific logic.
sents.zh: 一个模块化的实现骨架通过明确定义的组件和接口来构建该方案，使智能体能够专注于协议特定的逻辑。

sents.en: Third, subtle correctness violations can escape conventional testing, which covers only a limited set of message orderings and failure scenarios.
sents.zh: 第三，细微的正确性违例可能逃过常规测试的检测，因为常规测试只覆盖有限的消序排列和故障场景。

sents.en: Formal verification closes this gap by proving safety for every execution of a protocol model, but writing such models and proofs from scratch for each candidate is too costly.
sents.zh: 形式化验证通过证明协议模型的每一次执行都满足安全性来弥补这一缺口，但为每个候选协议从零开始编写此类模型和证明的代价过高。

sents.en: A Lean -based verification framework therefore provides reusable safety definitions, reference specifications, and proof libraries, so the agent can obtain machine-checked evidence that its design, as modeled, is safe.
sents.zh: 因此，一个基于 Lean 的验证框架提供可复用的安全性定义、参考规范和证明库，使智能体能够获得机器可校验的证据，证明其设计（按所建模的形式）是安全的。

sents.en: These components work together in an iterative discovery process, where performance measurements and fault-injection results guide the agent toward more efficient and robust designs.
sents.zh: 这些组件在一个迭代式的发现过程中协同工作，其中性能测量和故障注入结果引导智能体朝着更高效、更健壮的设计前进。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate the capabilities of AI-greement through A-greement , a new consensus protocol that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art solutions. To the best of our knowledge, A-greement is the first consensus protocol that is designed and implemented by an LLM agent. When replicating a key-value store, A-greement jointly optimizes read and write latency. A-greement builds on the quorum-lease local reads of PQL ( PQL ) [ 50 ] , generalizes Bodega ’s leader-side gating of writes [ 29 ] to any replica, and adds a leaderless write path in the style of SwiftPaxos [ 63 ] . Its design couples write completion with read availability: for frequently accessed keys, a designated completion owner can continue serving reads while a write is pending; for ordinary keys, clients learn leader-ordered writes directly from acceptor votes; and for infrequently accessed keys, writes can bypass leader ordering through a fixed-majority per-key path. These paths share rules ensuring that local reads do not miss completed writes. A planner uses network delays and workload statistics to select replica roles and write paths, accounting for both write latency and the time reads spend waiting behind pending writes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过 A-greement 展示了 AI 一致性的能力，A-greement 是一种显著优于最先进方案的新型共识协议。 据我们所知，A-greement 是首个由大语言模型智能体设计并实现的共识协议。 在复制键值存储时，A-greement 联合优化读写延迟。 A-greement 建立在 PQL（PQL）[50] 的法定租约本地读取之上，将 Bodega 在领导者侧对写入的门控 [29] 泛化到任意副本，并以 SwiftPaxos [63] 的风格增加了一条无领导者的写入路径。 其设计将写入完成与读取可用性耦合：对于频繁访问的键，指定的完成所有者可以在写入未决期间继续提供读取服务；对于普通键，客户端直接从接受者投票中获知按领导者排序的写入；对于不常访问的键，写入可以通过每键固定多数路径绕过领导者排序。 这些路径共享一些规则，确保本地读取不会遗漏已完成的写入。 规划器利用网络延迟和工作负载统计信息来选择副本角色和写入路径，同时兼顾写入延迟以及读取在未决写入之后排队等待所花费的时间。

sents.zh: 规划器利用网络延迟和工作负载统计信息来选择副本角色和写入路径，同时兼顾写入延迟以及读取在未决写入之后排队等待所花费的时间。

paragraphs.en: Averaged across six deployments with 5 or 9 replicas, on write-intensive workloads (50% writes) A-greement reduces mean latency by 12.2% relative to SwiftPaxos , the best alternative, at the cost of a 13.8% higher p99 latency. On read-dominated workloads (5% writes), A-greement reduces mean and p99 latency by 33.3% and 30.1%, respectively, relative to Bodega , the alternative with the lowest mean latency, with a p99 latency within 3.4% of the best alternative on that metric, SwiftPaxos . In the common case, A-greement ’s reads complete at a single nearby replica, and writes to rarely accessed keys complete in one round trip. AI-greement completed the discovery process (including the verification) of A-greement in around 24 hours, consuming 778.45 million tokens at an estimated API-equivalent cost of $198.69.
paragraphs.zh: 在使用 5 个或 9 个副本的六次部署中取平均值，在写密集型工作负载（50% 写入）下，与最佳替代方案 SwiftPaxos 相比，A-greement 将平均延迟降低了 12.2%，代价是 p99 延迟升高 13.8%。 在读主导型工作负载（5% 写入）下，与平均延迟最低的替代方案 Bodega 相比，A-greement 将平均延迟和 p99 延迟分别降低了 33.3% 和 30.1%，其 p99 延迟与该指标上最佳的替代方案 SwiftPaxos 相差在 3.4% 以内。 在常见情况下，A-greement 的读取操作在单个附近的副本上完成，而对很少被访问的键的写入操作可在一个往返内完成。 AI-greement 在约 24 小时内完成了 A-greement 的发现过程（包括验证），消耗了 7.7845 亿个 token，估计的等价 API 成本为 198.69 美元。

paragraphs.en: To summarize, we make the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 总结而言，我们做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: We design AI-greement , an agent harness designed for the automated discovery of consensus protocols ( § 3 ). AI-greement integrates a consensus knowledge base, a modular consensus skeleton, and Lean -based formalization and verification.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了 AI-greement，一个用于自动化发现共识协议的智能体框架（§3）。 AI-greement 集成了共识知识库、模块化共识骨架，以及基于 Lean 的形式化与验证。

sents.en: We design AI-greement , an agent harness designed for the automated discovery of consensus protocols ( § 3 ).
sents.zh: 我们设计了 AI-greement，一个用于自动化发现共识协议的智能体框架（§3）。

sents.en: AI-greement integrates a consensus knowledge base, a modular consensus skeleton, and Lean -based formalization and verification.
sents.zh: AI-greement 集成了共识知识库、模块化共识骨架，以及基于 Lean 的形式化与验证。

paragraphs.en: Using AI-greement , we synthesize A-greement , a new consensus protocol “autonomously” designed and implemented by AI-greement . A-greement combines localized reads, complementary write paths, as well as topology- and workload-aware planning ( § 4 , 5 , 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 利用 AI-greement，我们合成了 A-greement，这是一个由 AI-greement「自主」设计并实现的新型共识协议。 A-greement 结合了本地化读取、互补的写入路径，以及拓扑感知与负载感知的规划（§4、5、6）。

sents.en: Using AI-greement , we synthesize A-greement , a new consensus protocol “autonomously” designed and implemented by AI-greement .
sents.zh: 利用 AI-greement，我们合成了 A-greement，这是一个由 AI-greement「自主」设计并实现的新型共识协议。

sents.en: A-greement combines localized reads, complementary write paths, as well as topology- and workload-aware planning ( § 4 , 5 , 6 ).
sents.zh: A-greement 结合了本地化读取、互补的写入路径，以及拓扑感知与负载感知的规划（§4、5、6）。

paragraphs.en: We perform an extensive experimental evaluation of A-greement across replica counts, workloads, and network topologies. Averaged across six deployments with 5 or 9 replicas, A-greement reduces mean latency relative to the best alternative by 12.2% and 33.3% on write-heavy and read-heavy workloads, respectively, while matching the best-performing baseline on the read-only workload ( § 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 A-greement 在不同副本数量、工作负载和网络拓扑下进行了广泛的实验评估。 在六个部署（分别包含 5 或 9 个副本）的平均结果中，A-greement 在写密集型和读密集型工作负载上相对于最佳替代方案分别将平均延迟降低了 12.2% 和 33.3%，同时在只读工作负载上与表现最佳的基线持平（ § 7 ）。

sents.en: We perform an extensive experimental evaluation of A-greement across replica counts, workloads, and network topologies.
sents.zh: 我们对 A-greement 在不同副本数量、工作负载和网络拓扑下进行了广泛的实验评估。

sents.en: Averaged across six deployments with 5 or 9 replicas, A-greement reduces mean latency relative to the best alternative by 12.2% and 33.3% on write-heavy and read-heavy workloads, respectively, while matching the best-performing baseline on the read-only workload ( § 7 ).
sents.zh: 在六个部署（分别包含 5 或 9 个副本）的平均结果中，A-greement 在写密集型和读密集型工作负载上相对于最佳替代方案分别将平均延迟降低了 12.2% 和 33.3%，同时在只读工作负载上与表现最佳的基线持平（ § 7 ）。

paragraphs.en: Using AI-greement , we describe four previously unreported safety vulnerabilities in existing consensus protocols, found through agent-driven Lean formalization and verification, demonstrating AI-greement ’s ability to uncover subtle protocol flaws ( § 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 使用 AI-greement，我们描述了现有共识协议中四个此前未被报告的安全漏洞，这些漏洞是通过智能体驱动的 Lean 形式化与验证发现的，展示了 AI-greement 发掘细微协议缺陷的能力（§ 8）。

paragraphs.en: We reflect on our results and ask whether this marks the end of human-driven consensus research, based on where our agent succeeded, where it needed human steering, and what remains for researchers to do ( § 10 ). Our findings imply that a human consensus expert is (still) badly needed. Many of these findings should apply to other (distributed) computing problems, especially when the goal is to discover, formally prove and practically evaluate a solution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对结果进行了反思，并基于我们的智能体在哪些方面取得成功、在哪些方面需要人类引导、以及研究者还有哪些工作要做（§10），探讨这是否标志着人类主导的共识研究的终结。 我们的研究结果表明，（仍然）非常需要人类共识专家。 这些发现中有许多应当适用于其他（分布式）计算问题，尤其是当目标是发现、形式化证明并实际评估一个解决方案时。

sents.en: We reflect on our results and ask whether this marks the end of human-driven consensus research, based on where our agent succeeded, where it needed human steering, and what remains for researchers to do ( § 10 ).
sents.zh: 我们对结果进行了反思，并基于我们的智能体在哪些方面取得成功、在哪些方面需要人类引导、以及研究者还有哪些工作要做（§10），探讨这是否标志着人类主导的共识研究的终结。

sents.en: Our findings imply that a human consensus expert is (still) badly needed.
sents.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，（仍然）非常需要人类共识专家。

sents.en: Many of these findings should apply to other (distributed) computing problems, especially when the goal is to discover, formally prove and practically evaluate a solution.
sents.zh: 这些发现中有许多应当适用于其他（分布式）计算问题，尤其是当目标是发现、形式化证明并实际评估一个解决方案时。

paragraphs.en: We first provide the background needed to motivate AI-greement by explaining consensus and state machine replication ( § 2.1 ). We then describe how LLM agents and their harnesses can solve complex problems ( § 2.2 ). Finally, we show that a frontier general-purpose coding agent, given an existing consensus codebase and repeated experimental feedback, rarely improves on existing designs, and we identify the shortcomings that directly motivate the design of our AI-greement ( § 2.3 ) agent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先通过解释共识与状态机复制（ § 2.1 ）来提供所需的背景知识，以说明提出 AI-greement 的动机。 然后我们描述 LLM 智能体及其运行框架如何解决复杂问题（ § 2.2 ）。 最后，我们表明，一个前沿的通用编码智能体在给定现有共识代码库和反复的实验反馈的情况下，很少能在现有设计基础上做出改进，并且我们指出了直接促使我们设计 AI-greement（ § 2.3 ）智能体的种种不足。

sents.en: We first provide the background needed to motivate AI-greement by explaining consensus and state machine replication ( § 2.1 ).
sents.zh: 我们首先通过解释共识与状态机复制（ § 2.1 ）来提供所需的背景知识，以说明提出 AI-greement 的动机。

sents.en: We then describe how LLM agents and their harnesses can solve complex problems ( § 2.2 ).
sents.zh: 然后我们描述 LLM 智能体及其运行框架如何解决复杂问题（ § 2.2 ）。

sents.en: Finally, we show that a frontier general-purpose coding agent, given an existing consensus codebase and repeated experimental feedback, rarely improves on existing designs, and we identify the shortcomings that directly motivate the design of our AI-greement ( § 2.3 ) agent.
sents.zh: 最后，我们表明，一个前沿的通用编码智能体在给定现有共识代码库和反复的实验反馈的情况下，很少能在现有设计基础上做出改进，并且我们指出了直接促使我们设计 AI-greement（ § 2.3 ）智能体的种种不足。

paragraphs.en: SMR ( SMR ) implements a fault-tolerant service by maintaining copies of its state at multiple replicas [ 65 ] . The service is modeled as a deterministic state machine: a command and the current state uniquely determine the next state and the response. Clients submit commands and receive their results through the SMR protocol, which coordinates execution across replicas to present the behavior of a single state machine.
paragraphs.zh: SMR（SMR）通过在多个副本处维护其状态的副本，实现了一种容错服务。 该服务被建模为一个确定性状态机：命令和当前状态唯一地确定下一个状态和响应。 客户端提交命令并通过 SMR 协议接收其结果，该协议跨副本协调执行，以呈现单个状态机的行为。

sents.en: SMR ( SMR ) implements a fault-tolerant service by maintaining copies of its state at multiple replicas [ 65 ] .
sents.zh: SMR（SMR）通过在多个副本处维护其状态的副本，实现了一种容错服务。

sents.en: The service is modeled as a deterministic state machine: a command and the current state uniquely determine the next state and the response.
sents.zh: 该服务被建模为一个确定性状态机：命令和当前状态唯一地确定下一个状态和响应。

sents.en: Clients submit commands and receive their results through the SMR protocol, which coordinates execution across replicas to present the behavior of a single state machine.
sents.zh: 客户端提交命令并通过 SMR 协议接收其结果，该协议跨副本协调执行，以呈现单个状态机的行为。

paragraphs.en: This behavior is formalized by linearizability : the responses observed by all clients must be consistent with a single sequential execution of their commands by the state machine, preserving real-time order across clients [ 26 ] . Our verification framework uses linearizability, with the corrected definition of Sela et al. [ 66 ] , as a uniform proof target for all candidate SMR protocols. Command ordering can exploit commutativity: replicas may choose different execution orders for commuting commands while agreeing on the order of conflicting commands [ 39 , 60 ] . Two commands commute if exchanging their order from any state leaves both the resulting state and each command’s response unchanged; otherwise, they conflict.
paragraphs.zh: 这种行为由线性一致性来形式化：所有客户端观察到的响应必须与状态机对其命令的单一顺序执行相一致，并保持客户端之间的实时顺序 [ 26 ] 。 我们的验证框架使用线性一致性，采用 Sela 等人修正后的定义。 [ 66 ] ，作为所有候选 SMR 协议的统一证明目标。 命令排序可以利用交换性：副本可以为可交换的命令选择不同的执行顺序，同时对冲突命令的顺序保持一致 [ 39 , 60 ] 。 如果从任意状态交换两个命令的顺序后，所得状态和每个命令的响应都保持不变，则这两个命令可交换；否则，它们相互冲突。

paragraphs.en: To coordinate command execution, SMR protocols use consensus , in which processes propose values and agree on one of them [ 38 ] . For example, consensus can be used to commit commands in an order proposed by a leader, as in Multi-Paxos [ 38 ] . It can also establish agreement on command dependencies from which replicas determine an execution order, as in EPaxos [ 49 , 75 , 64 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了协调命令的执行，SMR 协议使用共识，其中各进程提议值并就其中一个值达成一致 [ 38 ] 。 例如，共识可用于按领导者提议的顺序提交命令，如 Multi-Paxos [ 38 ] 所示。 它还可以就命令依赖关系达成一致，从而让各副本据此确定执行顺序，如 EPaxos [ 49 , 75 , 64 ] 所示。

paragraphs.en: The performance of SMR protocols is commonly measured using four metrics. (i) Mean latency measures the average time between a client submitting a request and receiving its response, while (ii) tail latency (P99) measures the 99th percentile of request completion times. (iii) Throughput measures the number of requests completed per unit of time. (iv) Recovery time measures how long it takes for request latency or throughput to stabilize after the failure of a leader or replica.
paragraphs.zh: SMR 协议的性能通常使用四个指标来衡量。 (i) 平均延迟衡量客户端提交请求到收到响应之间的平均时间，而 (ii) 尾延迟 (P99) 衡量请求完成时间的第 99 百分位数。 (iii) 吞吐量衡量单位时间内完成的请求数量。 (iv) 恢复时间衡量在领导者或副本发生故障后，请求延迟或吞吐量恢复稳定所需的时间。

paragraphs.en: LLM are neural networks trained on large text corpora to predict the next token given the preceding context. The underlying transformer architecture was originally developed for natural language tasks such as machine translation [ 77 ] , and early LLM were primarily used for tasks such as translation, summarization, and question answering [ 7 ] . Instruction tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback turned these models into general-purpose conversational assistants, which have been popularized by ChatGPT [ 56 ] . As their capabilities improved, LLM also became capable at reasoning and more complex tasks such as writing code, extending their use beyond language tasks [ 78 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型是在大规模文本语料上训练的神经网络，用于根据前文上下文预测下一个词元。 其底层的Transformer架构最初是为机器翻译等自然语言任务而开发的[77]，早期的LLM主要用于翻译、摘要和问答等任务[7]。 指令微调和基于人类反馈的强化学习将这些模型转变成了通用对话助手，并通过ChatGPT得以普及[56]。 随着能力的提升，LLM在推理以及编写代码等更复杂的任务上也变得游刃有余，使其用途超越了语言任务的范畴[78]。

sents.zh: 大语言模型是在大规模文本语料上训练的神经网络，用于根据前文上下文预测下一个词元。

sents.zh: 随着能力的提升，LLM在推理以及编写代码等更复杂的任务上也变得游刃有余，使其用途超越了语言任务的范畴[78]。

paragraphs.en: On its own, an LLM can only produce text in response to its input prompt. Agentic AI removes this limitation by placing the model in a loop with tools and an environment , as shown in Figure 1 [ 1 ] . At each step, the model decides on an action, such as reading a file, running a command, or querying a search engine; the action is executed in the environment, and its result is returned to the model as an observation that informs the next decision. This loop lets an LLM agent pursue multi-step goals, gather information it was not given up front, and correct its own mistakes based on feedback. Coding agents, such as Codex [ 57 ] , Claude Code [ 4 ] , and Cursor Agent [ 5 ] , apply this paradigm to software development and enable agents to solve complex coding tasks. Given a task, a coding agent iteratively inspects relevant files, edits code, executes programs, and runs tests, and it revises its approach based on the results until the task is complete. LLM agents are also increasingly used for scientific discovery [ 23 ] . Our objective is to use agentic AI and LLM agents to synthesize and discover new consensus protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 就其本身而言，大语言模型只能根据输入提示生成文本。 智能体式人工智能通过将模型置于与工具和环境的循环中消除了这一限制，如图 1 所示 [ 1 ] 。 在每一步，模型决定一个动作，例如读取文件、运行命令或查询搜索引擎；该动作在环境中执行，其结果作为观测返回给模型，为下一步决策提供依据。 这一循环使大语言模型智能体能够追求多步目标、获取事先未提供的信息，并根据反馈纠正自身错误。 Codex [ 57 ] 、Claude Code [ 4 ] 和 Cursor Agent [ 5 ] 等编程智能体将这一范式应用于软件开发，使智能体能够解决复杂的编程任务。 给定一个任务，编程智能体会迭代地检查相关文件、编辑代码、执行程序并运行测试，并根据结果修正其方法，直到任务完成。 大语言模型智能体也越来越多地被用于科学发现 [ 23 ] 。 我们的目标是利用智能体式人工智能和大语言模型智能体来综合并发现新的共识协议。

paragraphs.en: An agent harness is the software infrastructure that organizes this interaction between the LLM , its tools, and the environment [ 53 ] . At each step, it supplies the model with instructions and relevant context, dispatches the model’s tool calls, and feeds the resulting observations back into subsequent model inputs. It also manages execution state and stopping conditions across steps. The model proposes actions and interprets feedback, while the harness makes those actions executable and maintains the interaction loop. Beyond these general functions, a harness can provide domain-specific knowledge, implementation interfaces, and evaluation tools for a particular class of tasks. The harness has a large effect on agent performance: changing the harness around a fixed LLM can produce a 6 × 6\times performance gap on the same benchmark [ 74 ] . In this work, we build on this observation by providing a harness specialized for consensus research.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体框架（agent harness）是一种软件基础设施，用于组织大语言模型、其工具与环境之间的这种交互 [53]。 在每一步中，它为模型提供指令和相关上下文，分发模型的工具调用，并将产生的观测结果反馈到后续的模型输入中。 它还跨步骤管理执行状态和停止条件。 模型提出动作并解读反馈，而框架则使这些动作可以执行，并维护交互循环。 除了这些通用功能之外，框架还可以为某类特定任务提供领域知识、实现接口和评估工具。 框架对智能体性能有很大影响：在固定的大语言模型下更换框架，在同一基准上可产生 6 × 6\times 的性能差距 [74]。 在本工作中，我们基于这一观察，提供了一个专为共识研究设计的框架。

paragraphs.en: We first investigate whether a general-purpose coding agent, given existing consensus implementations and repeated experimental feedback, can discover protocol changes that improve performance. We choose the SwiftPaxos [ 63 ] codebase 1 1 1 See https://github.com/imdea-software/swiftpaxos . as our starting point because it provides a high-performance consensus implementation alongside implementations of several baseline protocols. Using this codebase, we give the Codex harness powered by the GPT-6.1 Sol model with High reasoning effort the prompt in Appendix B to conduct an iterative 20-round search for consensus protocols with lower mean and tail (P99) latency. § 7 provides additional information about our experimental setup. Unlike AI-greement , this agent receives no curated protocol knowledge: it may search for the state of the art itself, but the codebase includes neither Bodega nor PQL , on which A-greement builds. This experiment is therefore not a controlled comparison with AI-greement , but an illustration of the difficulties a general-purpose agent faces.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先研究一个通用的编码智能体，在给定现有共识实现和反复的实验反馈的情况下，能否发现能够提升性能的协议变更。 我们选择 SwiftPaxos [ 63 ] 代码库 1 1 1 见 https://github.com/imdea-software/swiftpaxos 。 作为起点，因为它既提供了高性能的共识实现，也提供了若干基线协议的实现。 基于该代码库，我们给由 GPT-6.1 Sol 模型驱动、采用 High 推理强度的 Codex 框架提供了附录 B 中的提示词，进行 20 轮迭代搜索，以寻找具有更低平均延迟和尾延迟（P99）的共识协议。§ 7 提供了关于我们实验设置的更多信息。 与 AI-greement 不同，该智能体不会获得任何经过整理的协议知识：它可以自行搜索现有技术，但代码库中既不包含 Bodega，也不包含 A-greement 所依赖的 PQL。 因此，该实验并不是与 AI-greement 的受控比较，而是对通用智能体所面临困难的一种展示。

For reference, the red line reports the latency of A-greement , discovered with the domain-specific support of our AI-greement ( § 4 ).

paragraphs.en: We observe an initial latency reduction in the first two rounds, followed by a plateau. The agent begins with a basic leader-based replication protocol in round 0, in which both reads and writes undergo Paxos -style consensus and execution before clients receive replies. Our manual inspection of the agent trajectories reveal that the early gains mainly come from applying established optimizations: quorum-validated reads, early write completion, and improved leader placement shorten read and write completion paths. Later rounds mainly explore secondary engineering optimizations, including batching, message encoding, and caching, which only result in marginal reductions in latency. Mean latency spikes in round 12 which stems from processing and reply-traffic overhead introduced by periodic snapshot refreshes. Moreover, we noticed that candidate implementations between rounds 3–14 violate availability despite a surviving majority, due to defects in client registration, recovery transfers, or peer connection handling. At an offered load of 20 000 20\,000 commands per second, the best candidate achieves 179.87 ms 179.87\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} mean latency and 289.77 ms 289.77\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} average P99, averaged across deployments with 5, 9, and 13 replicas. These results are only marginally better than the corresponding mean and P99 latencies of 196.16 ms 196.16\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} and 297.62 ms 297.62\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} , respectively, for SwiftPaxos .
paragraphs.zh: 我们观察到前两轮出现了初始的延迟下降，随后进入平台期。 该智能体在第 0 轮从一个基于领导者的基础复制协议开始，其中读和写操作都要经过 Paxos 风格的共识与执行后，客户端才会收到回复。 我们对智能体轨迹的人工检查表明，早期收益主要来自应用已有优化：法定人数验证读、提前完成写，以及改进领导者部署位置，这些都缩短了读写完成路径。 后续轮次主要探索次要的工程优化，包括批处理、消息编码和缓存，这些只能带来边际的延迟降低。 平均延迟在第 12 轮出现尖峰，其原因在于周期性快照刷新带来的处理与回复流量开销。 此外，我们注意到第 3–14 轮之间的候选实现尽管存在存活多数派，仍会因客户端注册、恢复传输或节点连接处理中的缺陷而违反可用性。 在每秒 20 000 条命令的施加负载下，最佳候选在 5、9 和 13 副本部署上的平均表现达到 179.87 ms 的平均延迟和 289.77 ms 的平均 P99。 这些结果仅略优于 SwiftPaxos 相应的 196.16 ms 平均延迟和 297.62 ms P99 延迟。

sents.en: We observe an initial latency reduction in the first two rounds, followed by a plateau.
sents.zh: 我们观察到前两轮出现了初始的延迟下降，随后进入平台期。

sents.en: The agent begins with a basic leader-based replication protocol in round 0, in which both reads and writes undergo Paxos -style consensus and execution before clients receive replies.
sents.zh: 该智能体在第 0 轮从一个基于领导者的基础复制协议开始，其中读和写操作都要经过 Paxos 风格的共识与执行后，客户端才会收到回复。

sents.en: Our manual inspection of the agent trajectories reveal that the early gains mainly come from applying established optimizations: quorum-validated reads, early write completion, and improved leader placement shorten read and write completion paths.
sents.zh: 我们对智能体轨迹的人工检查表明，早期收益主要来自应用已有优化：法定人数验证读、提前完成写，以及改进领导者部署位置，这些都缩短了读写完成路径。

sents.en: Later rounds mainly explore secondary engineering optimizations, including batching, message encoding, and caching, which only result in marginal reductions in latency.
sents.zh: 后续轮次主要探索次要的工程优化，包括批处理、消息编码和缓存，这些只能带来边际的延迟降低。

sents.en: Mean latency spikes in round 12 which stems from processing and reply-traffic overhead introduced by periodic snapshot refreshes.
sents.zh: 平均延迟在第 12 轮出现尖峰，其原因在于周期性快照刷新带来的处理与回复流量开销。

sents.en: Moreover, we noticed that candidate implementations between rounds 3–14 violate availability despite a surviving majority, due to defects in client registration, recovery transfers, or peer connection handling.
sents.zh: 此外，我们注意到第 3–14 轮之间的候选实现尽管存在存活多数派，仍会因客户端注册、恢复传输或节点连接处理中的缺陷而违反可用性。

sents.en: At an offered load of 20 000 20\,000 commands per second, the best candidate achieves 179.87 ms 179.87\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} mean latency and 289.77 ms 289.77\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} average P99, averaged across deployments with 5, 9, and 13 replicas.
sents.zh: 在每秒 20 000 条命令的施加负载下，最佳候选在 5、9 和 13 副本部署上的平均表现达到 179.87 ms 的平均延迟和 289.77 ms 的平均 P99。

sents.en: These results are only marginally better than the corresponding mean and P99 latencies of 196.16 ms 196.16\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} and 297.62 ms 297.62\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} , respectively, for SwiftPaxos .
sents.zh: 这些结果仅略优于 SwiftPaxos 相应的 196.16 ms 平均延迟和 297.62 ms P99 延迟。

paragraphs.en: After careful inspection of the traces, we identify three potential problems that limit the ability by the general-purpose agent to discover consensus algorithm with more substantial gains. The first issue is that the agent relies mainly on conventional optimizations and secondary engineering refinements and appears not to fully understand the principles behind techniques in existing consensus work. This motivates explicit consensus-design knowledge that explains these techniques’ rationale and tradeoffs. Second, we observed that the agent re-implements the entire protocol each search iteration. Implementing consensus, however, requires substantial infrastructure for communication, client handling, and recovery, making implementation from scratch complex and error-prone. The observed defects, including loss of availability despite a surviving majority, motivate a reusable and modular implementation foundation that reduces this burden and lets the agent focus on protocol-specific logic. Third, experimental feedback measures performance and can expose some correctness violations, but cannot by itself establish protocol safety beyond the tested executions. This motivates explicit invariants and formal proofs that guarantee safety for all executions permitted by the fault model.
paragraphs.zh: 在对运行轨迹进行仔细检查后，我们识别出三个限制通用智能体发现具有更显著收益的共识算法的潜在问题。 第一个问题是，智能体主要依赖常规优化和次要的工程改进，似乎并未充分理解现有共识工作中各类技术背后的原理。 这促使我们引入显式的共识设计知识，以解释这些技术的设计依据与权衡。 其次，我们观察到智能体在每次搜索迭代中都会重新实现整个协议。 然而，实现共识协议需要大量用于通信、客户端处理和恢复的基础设施，这使得从零开始实现既复杂又容易出错。 所观察到的缺陷——例如在多数派存活的情况下仍然丧失可用性——促使我们构建一个可复用、模块化的实现基础，以减轻这一负担，让智能体专注于协议特定的逻辑。 第三，实验反馈能够度量性能并暴露某些正确性违规，但仅凭实验本身无法在已被测试的执行之外确立协议安全性。 这促使我们引入显式的不变式和形式化证明，以保证在故障模型所允许的所有执行下协议的安全性。

paragraphs.en: We believe these limitations stem in part from a gap between the general-purpose support provided by the agent’s harness and the domain-specific requirements of consensus discovery. In the following section, we introduce an additional harness layer that builds on the existing software engineering capabilities of state-of-the-art coding agents and augments them with three domain-specific modules for consensus research.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，这些局限性部分源于智能体的通用支撑框架与共识发现这一领域的特定需求之间存在差距。 在下一节中，我们引入一个额外的框架层，该层建立在最先进编程智能体已有的软件工程能力之上，并通过三个面向共识研究的领域特定模块对其加以增强。

sents.zh: 在下一节中，我们引入一个额外的框架层，该层建立在最先进编程智能体已有的软件工程能力之上，并通过三个面向共识研究的领域特定模块对其加以增强。

paragraphs.en: We also conduct a trial with SkyDiscover-Synthesize ( SkySynth [ 43 ] ) and use its test-driven agentic workflow to search for SMR protocols with lower mean and tail latency. Despite a requested budget of 20 search rounds, the run remained focused on implementing and repairing its initial candidate. We terminated the experiment after approximately 11.5 hours, and 486 million input and output tokens across the main agent, workers, and automatic reviews. Although the workflow produced correctness tests and diagnostic traces, unresolved client-completion failures prevented a complete latency evaluation, and no performance improvement was demonstrated. This trial further illustrates the difficulty of reaching reliable end-to-end evaluation in the synthesis of consensus protocols, even with a structured agent workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还使用 SkyDiscover-Synthesize（SkySynth [43]）进行了一次试验，利用其测试驱动的智能体工作流来搜索具有更低平均延迟和尾延迟的 SMR 协议。 尽管请求的预算为 20 轮搜索，该运行仍专注于实现和修复其初始候选方案。 在大约 11.5 小时后，以及在主智能体、工作者和自动审查共消耗 4.86 亿输入和输出 token 后，我们终止了该实验。 尽管该工作流生成了正确性测试和诊断轨迹，但未解决的客户端完成失败使其无法进行完整的延迟评估，且未展示出任何性能改进。 这一试验进一步表明，即使采用结构化的智能体工作流，在共识协议的合成中实现可靠的端到端评估仍然十分困难。

paragraphs.en: We design AI-greement , an agentic harness to support the iterative discovery process of consensus algorithms ( Figure 3 ). AI-greement equips general-purpose coding agents with the knowledge, implementation structure, and verification support needed for consensus research. Given a failure model, performance objective, and search budget, the agent takes researcher, developer, and verifier roles in an iterative process. We next explain these components and roles in detail.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了 AI-greement，一个用于支持共识算法迭代发现过程的智能体框架（图 3）。 AI-greement 为通用编码智能体提供共识研究所需的知识、实现结构和验证支持。 在给定故障模型、性能目标和搜索预算的情况下，该智能体在一个迭代过程中承担研究者、开发者和验证者的角色。 接下来我们详细解释这些组件和角色。

sents.en: We design AI-greement , an agentic harness to support the iterative discovery process of consensus algorithms ( Figure 3 ).
sents.zh: 我们设计了 AI-greement，一个用于支持共识算法迭代发现过程的智能体框架（图 3）。

sents.en: AI-greement equips general-purpose coding agents with the knowledge, implementation structure, and verification support needed for consensus research.
sents.zh: AI-greement 为通用编码智能体提供共识研究所需的知识、实现结构和验证支持。

sents.en: Given a failure model, performance objective, and search budget, the agent takes researcher, developer, and verifier roles in an iterative process.
sents.zh: 在给定故障模型、性能目标和搜索预算的情况下，该智能体在一个迭代过程中承担研究者、开发者和验证者的角色。

sents.en: We next explain these components and roles in detail.
sents.zh: 接下来我们详细解释这些组件和角色。

paragraphs.en: General-purpose agents can search the web and retrieve relevant papers. However, access to the literature alone does not provide a systematic way to design new consensus protocols. Relevant design ideas are scattered across many papers that differ in their assumptions, terminology, and protocol structures. Understanding how a mechanism used by one consensus protocol can be applied to another requires reasoning about its underlying principles, safety conditions, and interactions with other mechanisms. To address this, we construct a protocol knowledge base (the left column in Figure 3 ) that organizes existing consensus research around reusable designs in Markdown format, instead of supplying individual papers. This gives the LLM agent a structured way to understand and reason about the concepts relevant to consensus research. The knowledge base is constructed through human-guided, AI-assisted organization and expert review.
paragraphs.zh: 通用智能体可以搜索网络并检索相关论文。 然而，仅凭访问文献并不能提供一种系统化的方法来设计新的共识协议。 相关设计思路分散在许多论文中，这些论文在假设、术语和协议结构上各不相同。 要理解某个共识协议所使用的一种机制如何应用于另一个协议，需要对其底层原理、安全性条件以及与其他机制的交互进行推理。 为解决这一问题，我们构建了一个协议知识库（图3左列），以Markdown格式围绕可复用设计来组织现有的共识研究，而不是直接提供单篇论文。 这为大语言模型智能体提供了一种结构化的方式，来理解和推理与共识研究相关的概念。 该知识库通过人工引导、AI辅助的组织方式和专家评审构建而成。

sents.zh: 通用智能体可以搜索网络并检索相关论文。

sents.en: However, access to the literature alone does not provide a systematic way to design new consensus protocols.
sents.zh: 然而，仅凭访问文献并不能提供一种系统化的方法来设计新的共识协议。

sents.en: To address this, we construct a protocol knowledge base (the left column in Figure 3 ) that organizes existing consensus research around reusable designs in Markdown format, instead of supplying individual papers.
sents.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们构建了一个协议知识库（图3左列），以Markdown格式围绕可复用设计来组织现有的共识研究，而不是直接提供单篇论文。

sents.en: The knowledge base is constructed through human-guided, AI-assisted organization and expert review.
sents.zh: 该知识库通过人工引导、AI辅助的组织方式和专家评审构建而成。

paragraphs.en: As a first step, we identified 22 representative papers on foundational and state-of-the-art consensus protocols [ 39 , 40 , 48 , 49 , 28 , 59 , 20 , 52 , 36 , 76 , 3 , 75 , 13 , 58 , 15 , 51 , 63 , 64 , 27 , 29 , 72 , 9 ] . We then define a shared extraction structure covering system assumptions, roles, messages, local state, normal operation, completion conditions, recovery rules, and safety arguments. Afterwards, we let AI use this structure to produce notes from the published papers. We manually verify the produced notes against the source papers, correct errors, and add missing explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 作为第一步，我们选定了 22 篇关于基础性和最先进共识协议的代表性论文 [ 39 , 40 , 48 , 49 , 28 , 59 , 20 , 52 , 36 , 76 , 3 , 75 , 13 , 58 , 15 , 51 , 63 , 64 , 27 , 29 , 72 , 9 ] 。 随后，我们定义了一个统一的提取结构，涵盖系统假设、角色、消息、本地状态、正常运行、完成条件、恢复规则以及安全性论证。 之后，我们让 AI（智能体）使用该结构从已发表的论文中生成笔记。 我们将生成的笔记与原始论文进行人工核对，纠正错误，并补充缺失的解释。

We then define a shared extraction structure covering system assumptions, roles, messages, local state, normal operation, completion conditions, recovery rules, and safety arguments.

sents.en: We manually verify the produced notes against the source papers, correct errors, and add missing explanations.
sents.zh: 我们将生成的笔记与原始论文进行人工核对，纠正错误，并补充缺失的解释。

paragraphs.en: The produced notes streamline cross-protocol comparison for the agent. The concept index connects 24 consensus concepts, such as quorums, conflicts, and dependencies, to concrete protocol examples. The associated mechanism cards summarize each example’s message flow, assumptions, recovery behavior, and safety conditions. The shared structure also enables comparisons across 11 design dimensions, including quorum systems, completion rules, recovery mechanisms, and latency. By organizing mechanisms under common concepts, the knowledge base allows the agent to more easily compare how different protocols address similar design challenges without being constrained by the organization and presentation of individual papers.
paragraphs.zh: 所生成的笔记为智能体简化了跨协议比较。 概念索引将 24 个共识概念（如法定人数、冲突和依赖关系）与具体的协议示例关联起来。 相关的机制卡片总结了每个示例的消息流、假设、恢复行为和安全条件。 这种共享结构还支持跨 11 个设计维度的比较，包括法定人数系统、完成规则、恢复机制和延迟。 通过将各种机制组织在共同概念之下，该知识库使智能体能够更容易地比较不同协议如何应对相似的设计挑战，而不受各篇论文的组织与呈现方式的限制。

sents.zh: 所生成的笔记为智能体简化了跨协议比较。

sents.zh: 这种共享结构还支持跨 11 个设计维度的比较，包括法定人数系统、完成规则、恢复机制和延迟。

sents.en: By organizing mechanisms under common concepts, the knowledge base allows the agent to more easily compare how different protocols address similar design challenges without being constrained by the organization and presentation of individual papers.
sents.zh: 通过将各种机制组织在共同概念之下，该知识库使智能体能够更容易地比较不同协议如何应对相似的设计挑战，而不受各篇论文的组织与呈现方式的限制。

paragraphs.en: In the researcher role, AI-greement uses the concept index during protocol discovery to design a candidate protocol and to identify mechanisms that could cause a performance bottleneck. It consults the mechanism cards and cross-protocol comparisons to assess their expected benefits, costs, and compatibility conditions. For example, changing a completion quorum requires examining what evidence remains available during recovery. These checks guide the compare and compose activity, where the agent selects and combines candidate mechanisms. The resulting transition-level design records the candidate’s states, transitions, quorum rules, and recovery behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 在研究者角色中，AI-greement 在协议发现阶段使用概念索引来设计候选协议，并识别可能导致性能瓶颈的机制。 它会查阅机制卡片和跨协议比较，以评估这些机制的预期收益、成本和兼容性条件。 例如，更改完成法定人数需要考察在恢复期间还保留哪些证据。 这些检查指导比较与组合活动，智能体在该活动中选择并组合候选机制。 所得到的迁移级设计记录了候选方案的状态、迁移、法定人数规则和恢复行为。

paragraphs.en: Many consensus protocols have open-source implementations. However, their engineering choices differ in code organization, communication primitives, and runtime infrastructure. Exploring mechanisms across these codebases therefore requires the agent to understand and adapt the surrounding implementation as well as the protocol itself. We address this with ConsensusArena , a framework written in the Go language in which seven baseline protocols share a common runtime, client framework, and benchmark harness. We let an AI agent integrate baseline protocols, including classical Paxos [ 38 ] , FastPaxos [ 40 ] , EPaxos [ 49 , 75 , 64 ] , SwiftPaxos [ 63 ] , Bodega [ 29 ] , CURP [ 59 ] , and KCensus [ 9 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 许多共识协议都有开源实现。 然而，它们在代码组织、通信原语和运行时基础设施方面的工程选择各不相同。 因此，跨这些代码库探索机制时，智能体不仅需要理解并适配协议本身，还需要理解并适配周围的实现。 我们通过 ConsensusArena 解决这一问题，这是一个用 Go 语言编写的框架，其中七个基线协议共享同一个运行时、客户端框架和基准测试工具。 我们让 AI 智能体集成基线协议，包括经典 Paxos [38]、FastPaxos [40]、EPaxos [49, 75, 64]、SwiftPaxos [63]、Bodega [29]、CURP [59] 和 KCensus [9]。

paragraphs.en: On top of this framework, we provide a modular consensus skeleton for implementing new candidates ( Figure 3 , middle). The AI-greement (in the developer role) supplies the orange components (deployment planning, the client policy, and the protocol core) while the blue components are shared by all protocols and created by us. For each candidate, a generator instantiates an independent package with one file per component. Every agent-supplied component returns an explicit error until the agent replaces it, so a partially implemented candidate cannot produce measurements by silently inheriting a default leader, quorum, commit rule, or routing policy. Baselines are read-only to the agent, and a finished candidate is registered through a single entry in a log, after which it runs on the same runtime and benchmark as the baselines. Next, we further describe the components in Figure 3 (middle).
paragraphs.zh: 在此框架之上，我们提供了一个模块化的共识骨架，用于实现新的候选方案（图3，中间）。 AI-greement（以开发者角色）提供橙色组件（部署规划、客户端策略和协议核心），而蓝色组件由所有协议共享并由我们创建。 对于每个候选方案，生成器会实例化一个独立的包，每个组件对应一个文件。 每个由智能体提供的组件在智能体替换它之前都会返回显式错误，因此部分实现的候选方案无法通过静默继承默认的领导者、法定人数、提交规则或路由策略来产生测量结果。 基线对智能体是只读的，完成的候选方案通过日志中的单个条目注册，之后它与基线运行在相同的运行时和基准测试上。 接下来，我们进一步描述图3（中间）中的组件。

paragraphs.en: Before startup, the planner maps the network topology and workload to an initial leader, quorums, read responders, and one ingress replica per client. All such policy lives in the candidate’s planner rather than in launch scripts, which lets AI-greement ’s workload-aware planner ( § 4.3 ) run without changes to the framework.
paragraphs.zh: 在启动之前，规划器将网络拓扑和工作负载映射到一个初始领导者、法定人数（quorums）、读取响应者，以及每个客户端一个入口副本。 所有这类策略都存在于候选者的规划器中，而不是启动脚本中，这使得 AI-greement 的工作负载感知规划器（§4.3）无需对框架进行任何更改即可运行。

paragraphs.en: Protocols differ in how clients interact with replicas: a Multi-Paxos client sends each request to the leader, whereas a Fast Paxos client sends it to all replicas. The client component specifies this behavior: which replicas receive a request, which replies complete it, and whether pending requests are retried after a failure.
paragraphs.zh: 各协议在客户端与副本交互的方式上有所不同：Multi-Paxos 的客户端将每个请求发送给领导者，而 Fast Paxos 的客户端则将其发送给所有副本。 客户端组件规定了这一行为：哪些副本接收请求，哪些回复算完成请求，以及在发生故障后是否重试未完成的请求。

sents.en: Protocols differ in how clients interact with replicas: a Multi-Paxos client sends each request to the leader, whereas a Fast Paxos client sends it to all replicas.
sents.zh: 各协议在客户端与副本交互的方式上有所不同：Multi-Paxos 的客户端将每个请求发送给领导者，而 Fast Paxos 的客户端则将其发送给所有副本。

sents.en: The client component specifies this behavior: which replicas receive a request, which replies complete it, and whether pending requests are retried after a failure.
sents.zh: 客户端组件规定了这一行为：哪些副本接收请求，哪些回复算完成请求，以及在发生故障后是否重试未完成的请求。

paragraphs.en: Each replica processes all events on a single loop, so the protocol core needs no locks. The loop drives the core through three adapters: Propose for client requests, Handle for peer messages and local events, and Tick for timers.
paragraphs.zh: 每个副本在单个循环上处理所有事件，因此协议核心不需要锁。 该循环通过三个适配器驱动核心：Propose 处理客户端请求，Handle 处理对等节点消息和本地事件，Tick 处理定时器。

sents.en: Each replica processes all events on a single loop, so the protocol core needs no locks.
sents.zh: 每个副本在单个循环上处理所有事件，因此协议核心不需要锁。

sents.en: The loop drives the core through three adapters: Propose for client requests, Handle for peer messages and local events, and Tick for timers.
sents.zh: 该循环通过三个适配器驱动核心：Propose 处理客户端请求，Handle 处理对等节点消息和本地事件，Tick 处理定时器。

paragraphs.en: AI-greement defines the core’s state, messages, and handlers, including the quorum checks that determine acceptance and commitment. Recovery and execution mechanisms are also part of the core: recovery collects evidence and selects safe values or orders, and execution orders, deduplicates, and applies commands to a shared key-value store. The skeleton defines accepted, committed, executed, and client-completed as distinct states for a command.
paragraphs.zh: AI-greement 定义了核心的状态、消息与处理器，包括决定接受与提交的法定人数检查。 恢复与执行机制也属于核心的一部分：恢复负责收集证据并选出安全的值或命令，执行负责排序、去重，并将命令应用到共享的键值存储上。 该框架将已接受、已提交、已执行和客户端完成为一个命令的不同状态。

sents.en: AI-greement defines the core’s state, messages, and handlers, including the quorum checks that determine acceptance and commitment.
sents.zh: AI-greement 定义了核心的状态、消息与处理器，包括决定接受与提交的法定人数检查。

sents.en: Recovery and execution mechanisms are also part of the core: recovery collects evidence and selects safe values or orders, and execution orders, deduplicates, and applies commands to a shared key-value store.

paragraphs.en: Each transition returns outgoing messages and client replies, where a reply signals that the protocol has authorized completion. The dispatcher freezes each message and hands it to a per-connection sender with a bounded, non-blocking queue; received messages return through the event loop.
paragraphs.zh: 每次状态转换都会返回外发消息和客户端回复，其中回复表示协议已授权完成。 调度器冻结每条消息，并将其交给每个连接的发送器，该发送器拥有一个有界且非阻塞的队列；接收到的消息则通过事件循环返回。

sents.zh: 每次状态转换都会返回外发消息和客户端回复，其中回复表示协议已授权完成。

paragraphs.en: In the developer role, candidate protocols are evaluated with the ConsensusArena benchmark, which emulates geo-replication on a Slurm cluster using Toxiproxy to emulate network delays and inter-region delays from 35 AWS cloud regions. The development suite covers 5, 9, and 13 replicas in three topologies under the YCSB workloads. Candidates that meet the performance target are then crash-tested: replicas are killed until f = ( n − 1 ) / 2 f=(n-1)/2 have failed, and throughput must recover to 90% of its pre-crash level and remain there. Note that our final evaluation in § 7 uses more advanced topologies and workloads disjoint from this suite to show the generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 在开发者角色中，候选协议使用 ConsensusArena 基准进行评估，该基准在 Slurm 集群上模拟地理复制，并使用 Toxiproxy 模拟来自 35 个 AWS 云区域的网络延迟和跨区域延迟。 开发套件在 YCSB 工作负载下覆盖三种拓扑中的 5、9 和 13 个副本。 达到性能目标的候选协议随后进行崩溃测试：持续终止副本直到 f = ( n − 1 ) / 2 f=(n-1)/2 个副本失效，吞吐量必须恢复到崩溃前水平的 90% 并保持在该水平。 请注意，我们在第 7 节中的最终评估使用了与本套件不相交的更高级拓扑和工作负载，以展示泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Testing can expose safety violations, but even extensive testing cannot establish safety under all possible event orderings. Informal correctness arguments must account for interactions among concurrent actions, delayed messages, and failures, making subtle omissions difficult to detect. For example, AI-greement found that the dependency-pruning rules of EPaxos Revisited [ 75 ] allow replicas to execute conflicting commands in opposite orders, also see § 8 . Proof assistants such as Lean [ 18 ] and Rocq [ 73 ] close this gap by mechanically checking that specified safety properties hold for every execution admitted by a formal model. However, developing such models and proofs requires substantial human effort, often spanning several person-months [ 61 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 测试可以暴露安全违规，但即使是广泛的测试也无法在所有可能的事件顺序下确立安全性。 非正式的正确性论证必须考虑并发操作、延迟消息和故障之间的交互，这使得细微的疏漏难以察觉。 例如，AI-greement 发现《EPaxos Revisited》[75] 中的依赖剪枝规则允许副本以相反的顺序执行冲突的命令，另见第 8 节。 诸如 Lean [18] 和 Rocq [73] 之类的证明助手通过机械化地检查指定的安全属性在形式化模型所允许的每次执行中都成立，从而弥合了这一差距。 然而，开发此类模型和证明需要大量的人力投入，通常需要数人月的时间 [61]。

sents.en: Proof assistants such as Lean [ 18 ] and Rocq [ 73 ] close this gap by mechanically checking that specified safety properties hold for every execution admitted by a formal model.
sents.zh: 诸如 Lean [18] 和 Rocq [73] 之类的证明助手通过机械化地检查指定的安全属性在形式化模型所允许的每次执行中都成立，从而弥合了这一差距。

sents.en: However, developing such models and proofs requires substantial human effort, often spanning several person-months [ 61 ] .
sents.zh: 然而，开发此类模型和证明需要大量的人力投入，通常需要数人月的时间 [61]。

paragraphs.en: We therefore aim to enable AI-greement to automate protocol formalization and proof construction with Lean within the discovery loop, using safety properties predefined by experts ( Figure 3 , right). The process proceeds in two stages. First, the agent encodes the candidate protocol as a formal specification in Lean . Second, it proves that this specification satisfies the predefined linearizability property § 2 , using Lean ’s feedback on remaining proof obligations and errors to refine its proof iteratively. We integrate the reference Lean specifications and proofs or disproofs of linearizability for Multi-Paxos [ 38 ] , FastPaxos [ 40 ] , EPaxos * [ 64 ] (the corrected version of EPaxos [ 49 , 75 ] ), SwiftPaxos [ 63 ] , and Bodega [ 29 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们旨在让 AI-greement 在发现循环中利用 Lean 自动化协议形式化与证明构造，并使用由专家预先定义的安全性质（图 3，右侧）。 该过程分为两个阶段进行。 首先，智能体将候选协议编码为 Lean 中的形式化规约。 其次，它证明该规约满足预定义的线性一致性性质 § 2，并利用 Lean 对剩余证明义务和错误的反馈来迭代地完善其证明。 我们整合了 Multi-Paxos [ 38 ]、FastPaxos [ 40 ]、EPaxos * [ 64 ]（EPaxos [ 49 , 75 ] 的修正版本）、SwiftPaxos [ 63 ] 和 Bodega [ 29 ] 的参考 Lean 规约以及关于线性一致性的证明或反证。

sents.zh: 因此，我们旨在让 AI-greement 在发现循环中利用 Lean 自动化协议形式化与证明构造，并使用由专家预先定义的安全性质（图 3，右侧）。

sents.en: The process proceeds in two stages.
sents.zh: 该过程分为两个阶段进行。

sents.en: First, the agent encodes the candidate protocol as a formal specification in Lean .
sents.zh: 首先，智能体将候选协议编码为 Lean 中的形式化规约。

sents.en: Second, it proves that this specification satisfies the predefined linearizability property § 2 , using Lean ’s feedback on remaining proof obligations and errors to refine its proof iteratively.
sents.zh: 其次，它证明该规约满足预定义的线性一致性性质 § 2，并利用 Lean 对剩余证明义务和错误的反馈来迭代地完善其证明。

sents.en: We integrate the reference Lean specifications and proofs or disproofs of linearizability for Multi-Paxos [ 38 ] , FastPaxos [ 40 ] , EPaxos * [ 64 ] (the corrected version of EPaxos [ 49 , 75 ] ), SwiftPaxos [ 63 ] , and Bodega [ 29 ] .
sents.zh: 我们整合了 Multi-Paxos [ 38 ]、FastPaxos [ 40 ]、EPaxos * [ 64 ]（EPaxos [ 49 , 75 ] 的修正版本）、SwiftPaxos [ 63 ] 和 Bodega [ 29 ] 的参考 Lean 规约以及关于线性一致性的证明或反证。

paragraphs.en: The framework lets the agent specify a protocol much as it would in pseudocode, by defining a node’s local state and its handlers for messages and timeouts. A shared transition model uses these handlers to describe how node and network state change as messages are delivered and timeouts occur. Client invocations and responses form the observable history of each execution and provide the basis for the framework’s linearizability specification. We then establish protocol safety by proving that every execution starting from the initial state and following these transition rules produces a linearizable history. Although researchers must still manually check that the specification faithfully captures the intended protocol and its assumptions, the shared foundation reduces this review burden: once the common definitions have been checked, researchers can focus on the protocol-specific state, initialization, and transition rules.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架让智能体像编写伪代码那样定义协议，即声明节点的本地状态及其针对消息和超时的处理程序。 一个共享的迁移模型利用这些处理程序来描述，随着消息被投递和超时发生，节点状态与网络状态如何变化。 客户端的调用与响应构成每次执行的可观察历史，并为框架的线性一致性规范提供基础。 随后我们通过证明每一条从初始状态出发、遵循这些迁移规则的执行都产生可线性化的历史，来确立协议的安全性。 尽管研究人员仍需人工检查该规范是否忠实地刻画了预期协议及其假设，但这一共享基础减轻了审查负担：一旦公共定义经过检查，研究人员即可专注于协议特定的状态、初始化和迁移规则。

paragraphs.en: For proving, the agent develops protocol-specific invariants and uses reference proofs and reusable lemmas to establish the predefined safety properties. Lean provides feedback on unsuccessful proof attempts, and its kernel checks the completed proof against the stated theorem. An unresolved proof obligation may also prompt AI-greement to investigate whether the required property can be violated, although proof failure alone does not always result in a bug. If this investigation yields a counterexample, the agent checks whether it arises from an inaccurate encoding or a flaw in the intended protocol, with human review where needed. A modeling error requires correcting the specification; a protocol flaw calls for revising the protocol and updating its specification before attempting the proof again. When AI-greement establishes a protocol vulnerability, it records the counterexample, the violated property, and any resulting repair, preserving the finding as feedback for subsequent discovery iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 在证明阶段，智能体会开发针对特定协议的不变式，并利用参考证明和可复用引理来建立预定义的安全性质。 Lean 会对不成功的证明尝试提供反馈，其内核会根据所陈述的定理检查已完成的证明。 未解决的证明义务也可能促使 AI-greement 去调查所需性质是否可被违反，尽管证明失败本身并不一定意味着存在缺陷。 如果这一调查得出了反例，智能体会检查它是源于不准确的编码还是目标协议中的缺陷，并在需要时进行人工审查。 建模错误需要修正规约；协议缺陷则要求修订协议并更新其规约，然后再重新尝试证明。 当 AI-greement 确认了一个协议漏洞时，它会记录该反例、被违反的性质以及由此产生的任何修复，并将该发现保存下来，作为后续发现迭代的反馈。

paragraphs.en: We found that reference specifications and proofs are valuable beyond the protocols they verify: they provide modeling patterns and proof strategies that the agent can reuse. Expanding this library helped the agent build more faithful models and complete proofs faster. More implementation detail, however, is not always helpful. The agent sometimes carries incidental engineering choices into the formal model, adding proof obligations without improving its fidelity to the protocol. We therefore ground formalization in the paper’s pseudocode and use open-source implementations only to resolve details that the paper leaves unspecified.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，参考规范和证明的价值超出了它们所验证的协议本身：它们提供了智能体可以复用的建模模式和证明策略。 扩充这个库有助于智能体构建更忠实的模型并更快地完成证明。 然而，更多的实现细节并不总是有帮助的。 智能体有时会把附带的工程选择带入形式化模型中，在不提高其对协议忠实度的情况下增加证明义务。 因此，我们将形式化工作立足于论文的伪代码，仅在论文未明确的细节上借助开源实现来解决。

paragraphs.en: We implement AI-greement on top of the Codex coding harness. The search begins with user-defined objectives and a search budget specified as the number of discovery rounds. The user may target a single metric, such as latency or maximum achievable throughput, or specify tradeoffs among multiple metrics, for example, requiring improvements in both mean and tail latency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Codex 编码框架之上实现了 AI-greement。 搜索从用户定义的目标和以发现轮数指定的搜索预算开始。 用户可以针对单一指标，例如延迟或可达到的最大吞吐量，也可以指定多个指标之间的权衡，例如同时要求改善平均延迟和尾延迟。

sents.en: We implement AI-greement on top of the Codex coding harness.
sents.zh: 我们在 Codex 编码框架之上实现了 AI-greement。

sents.en: The search begins with user-defined objectives and a search budget specified as the number of discovery rounds.
sents.zh: 搜索从用户定义的目标和以发现轮数指定的搜索预算开始。

sents.en: The user may target a single metric, such as latency or maximum achievable throughput, or specify tradeoffs among multiple metrics, for example, requiring improvements in both mean and tail latency.
sents.zh: 用户可以针对单一指标，例如延迟或可达到的最大吞吐量，也可以指定多个指标之间的权衡，例如同时要求改善平均延迟和尾延迟。

paragraphs.en: In each discovery round, the agent first acts as a researcher, selecting a parent protocol and forming a hypothesis about the bottleneck limiting the target metrics. It consults the consensus-specific knowledge base ( § 3.1 ) to compare candidate mechanisms, assess their safety risks, and estimate their expected benefits and additional overhead. The resulting design document specifies messages, local state, quorum and completion rules, execution, fallback, and recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 在每轮发现过程中，智能体首先扮演研究者的角色，选择一个父协议，并针对限制目标指标的瓶颈提出假设。 它查阅共识专用知识库（§ 3.1），以比较候选机制、评估其安全风险，并估计其预期收益与额外开销。 由此产生的设计文档规定了消息、本地状态、法定人数与完成规则、执行、回退与恢复。

sents.en: In each discovery round, the agent first acts as a researcher, selecting a parent protocol and forming a hypothesis about the bottleneck limiting the target metrics.
sents.zh: 在每轮发现过程中，智能体首先扮演研究者的角色，选择一个父协议，并针对限制目标指标的瓶颈提出假设。

sents.en: It consults the consensus-specific knowledge base ( § 3.1 ) to compare candidate mechanisms, assess their safety risks, and estimate their expected benefits and additional overhead.
sents.zh: 它查阅共识专用知识库（§ 3.1），以比较候选机制、评估其安全风险，并估计其预期收益与额外开销。

sents.en: The resulting design document specifies messages, local state, quorum and completion rules, execution, fallback, and recovery.
sents.zh: 由此产生的设计文档规定了消息、本地状态、法定人数与完成规则、执行、回退与恢复。

paragraphs.en: To test each candidate design, the agent then acts as a developer, implementing the candidate design within the skeleton ( § 3.2 ) and comparing it with other candidates under the same benchmark. Instrumentation helps relate the results to the original hypothesis, for example by separating latency spent collecting votes, waiting for execution, and resolving conflicts. Candidates that meet the user-defined performance criteria proceed to fault-injection testing. Fault injection separately tests recovery after replica failures. Candidates that meet the performance criteria and pass the experimental checks proceed to formal verification. The agent then acts as a verifier, constructing a Lean model and attempting to prove the safety target ( § 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试每个候选设计，智能体随后扮演开发者的角色，在骨架中实现候选设计（ § 3.2 ），并在同一基准下将其与其他候选设计进行比较。 插桩有助于将结果与原始假设联系起来，例如通过区分收集投票、等待执行和解决冲突所花费的延迟。 满足用户自定义性能标准的候选设计进入故障注入测试。 故障注入分别测试副本故障后的恢复情况。 满足性能标准并通过实验检查的候选设计进入形式化验证。 随后智能体扮演验证者的角色，构建 Lean 模型并尝试证明安全目标（ § 3.3 ）。

sents.zh: 满足用户自定义性能标准的候选设计进入故障注入测试。

sents.en: Fault injection separately tests recovery after replica failures.
sents.zh: 故障注入分别测试副本故障后的恢复情况。

sents.zh: 随后智能体扮演验证者的角色，构建 Lean 模型并尝试证明安全目标（ § 3.3 ）。

paragraphs.en: The staged process in AI-greement rejects unpromising candidates before committing effort to their implementation, experimental evaluation, and formal verification. Feedback from each stage guides subsequent revision or rejection, concentrating verification effort on promising candidates. To conserve resources, our current implementation defers formal verification until the end of the search and proves only the final version.
paragraphs.zh: AI-greement 中的分阶段流程会在投入精力进行实现、实验评估和形式化验证之前，先淘汰没有前景的候选方案。 每个阶段的反馈会指导后续的修订或淘汰，将验证精力集中在有前景的候选方案上。 为节约资源，我们当前的实现将形式化验证推迟到搜索结束时进行，仅对最终版本进行证明。

sents.zh: AI-greement 中的分阶段流程会在投入精力进行实现、实验评估和形式化验证之前，先淘汰没有前景的候选方案。

paragraphs.en: After every discovery round, the agent records the candidate’s parent, mechanism changes, expected and observed bottlenecks, measurements, recovery results, and proof status. It summarizes both successful and unsuccessful attempts into reusable lessons about which mechanisms improved performance, which failed to deliver the expected gains, and which correctness questions remain unresolved. These accumulated lessons guide the agent’s choice of subsequent search strategy, including whether to refine a candidate, revise a bottleneck hypothesis, revisit an earlier parent, or explore a different mechanism family. For example, when successive changes leave the same bottleneck, the agent reassesses the remaining improvement potential and decides whether to change direction. By carrying these lessons forward, the agent builds on successful mechanisms and avoids repeating unsuccessful approaches without new evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个探索轮次结束后，智能体会记录候选方案的父节点、机制变更、预期与观察到的瓶颈、测量结果、恢复结果以及证明状态。 它将成功与失败的尝试都总结为可复用的经验：哪些机制提升了性能，哪些未能带来预期的收益，以及哪些正确性问题仍未解决。 这些积累的经验指导智能体选择后续的搜索策略，包括是精化某个候选方案、修正瓶颈假设、回溯更早的父节点，还是探索另一类机制。 例如，当连续多次变更后仍存在同一个瓶颈时，智能体会重新评估剩余的改进潜力，并决定是否改变方向。 通过沿用这些经验，智能体能在成功的机制基础上继续构建，并在没有新证据的情况下避免重复失败的做法。

paragraphs.en: Our agent synthesized A-greement , a consensus algorithm that jointly reduces read and write latency. The design starts from a simple observation: the best way to complete a write depends on how that choice affects subsequent reads. A frequently accessed key benefits from a nearby replica that can serve reads and control write completion. A less frequently accessed key may benefit more from sending acceptance evidence directly to the client. For sufficiently rarely accessed keys, writes can also avoid leader ordering altogether. A-greement therefore combines three write paths with local reads , which allow a replica holding a read lease to answer reads without contacting other replicas.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的智能体合成了 A-greement，这是一种能够同时降低读延迟和写延迟的共识算法。 该设计源于一个简单的观察：完成写入的最佳方式取决于这一选择对后续读取的影响。 频繁访问的键受益于一个就近的副本，它既能服务读取，又能控制写入的完成。 访问频率较低的键则可能更受益于将接受证据直接发送给客户端。 对于访问极少出现的键，写入甚至可以完全避免领导者排序。 因此，A-greement 将三条写入路径与本地读取相结合，本地读取允许持有读租约的副本在不联系其他副本的情况下应答读取。

sents.zh: 我们的智能体合成了 A-greement，这是一种能够同时降低读延迟和写延迟的共识算法。

sents.en: A less frequently accessed key may benefit more from sending acceptance evidence directly to the client.
sents.zh: 访问频率较低的键则可能更受益于将接受证据直接发送给客户端。

sents.en: For sufficiently rarely accessed keys, writes can also avoid leader ordering altogether.
sents.zh: 对于访问极少出现的键，写入甚至可以完全避免领导者排序。

sents.en: A-greement therefore combines three write paths with local reads , which allow a replica holding a read lease to answer reads without contacting other replicas.
sents.zh: 因此，A-greement 将三条写入路径与本地读取相结合，本地读取允许持有读租约的副本在不联系其他副本的情况下应答读取。

paragraphs.en: Because AI-greement draws on prior consensus designs through its knowledge base ( § 3.1 ), many of A-greement ’s mechanisms are borrowed from existing algorithms; § 4.1 points out where each one comes from. At its core, A-greement is closest to PQL ( PQL ) [ 50 ] and Bodega [ 29 ] : a Multi-Paxos log in which a stable leader orders writes, combined with lease-based local reads at selected replicas. A write completes only once a majority and every read responder for its key have accepted it, so a responder holding a lease can answer reads from its local state. A-greement makes two changes to this core. First, writes need not complete at the leader: depending on the key, they can complete at a responder near the readers or directly at the client. Second, writes to rarely accessed keys bypass the log entirely and follow a fast path in the style of SwiftPaxos .
paragraphs.zh: 由于 AI-greement 通过其知识库（§ 3.1）借鉴了先前的共识设计，A-greement 的许多机制都借自现有算法；§ 4.1 指出了每个机制的来源。 就核心而言，A-greement 最接近 PQL（PQL）[50] 和 Bodega [29]：一个由稳定领导者对写入排序的 Multi-Paxos 日志，并结合在选定副本上基于租约的本地读取。 一次写入只有在大多数节点以及其键的每个读取响应者都接受之后才算完成，因此持有租约的响应者可以从其本地状态回答读取。 A-greement 对这一核心做了两处改动。 第一，写入不必在领导者处完成：根据键的不同，写入可以在靠近读取者的响应者处完成，或直接在客户端完成。 第二，对很少被访问的键的写入完全绕过日志，并遵循 SwiftPaxos 风格的快速路径。

paragraphs.en: Before deployment, A-greement ’s planner takes as input a workload profile: a sample of key accesses, obtained from historical traces or a profiling phase before the protocol starts serving requests, together with measured network delays between clients and replicas and the expected write fraction. From this profile, the planner selects the write path for each key and places the replica roles. The resulting plan is fixed during execution. A profile that does not match the actual workload can reduce performance but never affects safety: keys absent from the profile are ordered by the shared log, and every path enforces the same completion and read-visibility conditions. This section explains the high-level design of A-greement ; Appendix A contains the detailed description, and Table 1 compares its latency and quorum requirements with prior protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 在部署之前，A-greement 的规划器以一个负载画像作为输入：画像包含关键访问的样本（从历史轨迹或协议开始服务请求前的剖析阶段获得），以及客户端与副本之间测得的网络延迟和预期的写入比例。 规划器根据该画像为每个键选择写入路径，并放置副本角色。 由此得到的计划在执行期间是固定的。 与实际负载不匹配的画像只会降低性能，而绝不会影响安全性：画像中缺失的键由共享日志排序，且每条路径都强制执行相同的完成条件和读可见性条件。 本节介绍 A-greement 的高层设计；附录 A 包含详细描述，表 1 将其延迟与法定人数要求同先前协议进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: A-greement divides the key space into three: frequently accessed (hot) keys, regularly accessed (ordinary) keys and infrequent (cold) keys. Before execution, the planner chooses this partition from the workload profile and assigns the associated replica roles (leader, responder, quorum, etc.) using measured network delays. All three classes share one read mechanism; they differ in how writes complete and how the replicas serving reads learn about them. Figure 4 shows the write path of each class. Before describing these paths, we explain how replicas serve local reads, since each write path must ensure that these reads do not miss completed writes. For each mechanism, we give the main idea, how it works, and where it comes from.
paragraphs.zh: 该协议将键空间划分为三类：频繁访问（热）键、常规访问（普通）键和不常访问（冷）键。 在执行之前，规划器根据工作负载画像选择这一划分，并利用测得的网络时延为各副本分配相应的角色（领导者、响应者、法定人数等）。 三类共享同一种读机制；它们的区别在于写如何完成，以及服务于读的副本如何得知这些写。 图4展示了每一类的写路径。 在描述这些路径之前，我们先解释副本如何提供本地读，因为每条写路径都必须确保这些读不会遗漏已完成的写。 针对每种机制，我们给出其主要思想、工作原理及其来源。

sents.en: Figure 4 shows the write path of each class.
sents.zh: 图4展示了每一类的写路径。

sents.en: Before describing these paths, we explain how replicas serve local reads, since each write path must ensure that these reads do not miss completed writes.
sents.zh: 在描述这些路径之前，我们先解释副本如何提供本地读，因为每条写路径都必须确保这些读不会遗漏已完成的写。

sents.en: For each mechanism, we give the main idea, how it works, and where it comes from.
sents.zh: 针对每种机制，我们给出其主要思想、工作原理及其来源。

paragraphs.en: Hot and ordinary keys retain a Multi-Paxos -style shared log ordered by a stable leader [ 38 ] . For all three classes, the planner chooses read responders : replicas that answer reads without contacting other replicas. These local reads follow PQL [ 50 ] : replicas grant each other read leases covering all keys at once, a responder may serve local reads while it holds leases from a majority, and read responders are chosen from access statistics. As in Bodega ’s roster leases, A-greement binds the lease assignment, that is, the leader and the read responders, to the ballot [ 29 ] . A lease establishes who may answer a read, not which value is safe to return: a responder must also know that its local value includes every write that could have completed before the read began. Following PQL , a write therefore completes only once a majority and every read responder for its key have accepted it, and a responder that has accepted a write holds reads of that key until it can safely answer. A local read thus costs a single round trip to one replica, but every responder must learn about each write to the keys it serves. The three write paths differ in how they achieve this. To our knowledge, prior protocols that vary the write path by key access pattern [ 21 ] do not support local reads; A-greement instead chooses each class’s write path for how it keeps read responders up to date.
paragraphs.zh: 热键和普通键保留一种 Multi-Paxos 风格的共享日志，由稳定的领导者排序 [38]。 对于这三类键，规划器会选择读取响应者：即无需联系其他副本即可应答读取的副本。 这些本地读取遵循 PQL [50]：副本相互授予一次性覆盖所有键的读取租约，响应者在持有来自多数派的租约期间可以服务本地读取，而读取响应者根据访问统计来选择。 与 Bodega 的花名册租约类似，A-greement 将租约分配（即领导者和读取响应者）绑定到选票上 [29]。 租约确定了谁可以应答读取，而不是返回哪个值是安全的：响应者还必须知道其本地值包含了在读取开始之前可能已完成的每一次写入。 遵循 PQL，写入只有在得到多数派以及其键的每个读取响应者接受之后才算完成，而接受了某次写入的响应者会暂停对该键的读取，直到它能够安全地应答。 因此，本地读取只需到单个副本的一次往返，但每个响应者都必须得知针对其服务键的每一次写入。 三条写入路径的区别在于它们如何实现这一点。 据我们所知，此前按键访问模式改变写入路径的协议 [21] 并不支持本地读取；A-greement 则根据各类型写入路径能否让读取响应者保持最新来为其选择写入路径。

sents.zh: 热键和普通键保留一种 Multi-Paxos 风格的共享日志，由稳定的领导者排序 [38]。

sents.zh: 对于这三类键，规划器会选择读取响应者：即无需联系其他副本即可应答读取的副本。

sents.en: A local read thus costs a single round trip to one replica, but every responder must learn about each write to the keys it serves.
sents.zh: 因此，本地读取只需到单个副本的一次往返，但每个响应者都必须得知针对其服务键的每一次写入。

sents.en: The three write paths differ in how they achieve this.
sents.zh: 三条写入路径的区别在于它们如何实现这一点。

sents.en: To our knowledge, prior protocols that vary the write path by key access pattern [ 21 ] do not support local reads; A-greement instead chooses each class’s write path for how it keeps read responders up to date.
sents.zh: 据我们所知，此前按键访问模式改变写入路径的协议 [21] 并不支持本地读取；A-greement 则根据各类型写入路径能否让读取响应者保持最新来为其选择写入路径。

paragraphs.en: Hot keys receive the most reads, so their write path aims to keep responders serving reads while writes are pending. As in Bodega , the leader orders writes in the shared log and broadcasts Accept to the acceptors. In Bodega , acceptors send Accepted only to the leader, so no other replica can learn that a write committed before the leader does. The leader therefore implicitly gates every write and can keep serving the committed value while writes are pending [ 12 ] , whereas the other responders must hold reads of a key once they have accepted a write to it. A-greement generalizes this gate to a completion owner : a responder the planner selects for a range of hot keys, typically close to their readers. A client sends each write for these keys directly to the leader and names the completion owner as the replica that will reply. Acceptors send Accepted to the leader, the other responders and the completion owner. Since the completion owner is itself a responder, no write to its keys can complete without its Accepted . It therefore withholds that message and keeps serving the old value until it has Accepted from a majority and every other responder. Only then does it switch to the new value and send its own Accepted ; it replies to the client once it has executed the write. Because votes reach several learners rather than only the leader, the gate is no longer implied by the message pattern; withholding the vote enforces it explicitly. The planner assigns completion owners only where it estimates a latency gain. Other hot keys keep Bodega ’s arrangement: the leader is their implicit completion owner, and gates the writes it receives itself; writes that clients send through another replica are not gated, and that replica replies once it has executed them.
paragraphs.zh: 热键接收最多的读取，因此其写入路径的目标是在写入待处理时保持响应者继续提供读取服务。 与 Bodega 一样，领导者对共享日志中的写入进行排序，并向接受者广播 Accept。 在 Bodega 中，接受者只向领导者发送 Accepted，因此在领导者得知写入已提交之前，其他任何副本都无法得知该写入已提交。 因此，领导者隐式地把守每一次写入，并可以在写入待处理时继续提供已提交的值 [12]，而其他响应者一旦接受了针对某个键的写入，就必须暂停对该键的读取。 A-greement 将这种门控推广为完成所有者：由规划器为一组热键选择的响应者，通常靠近它们的读取者。 客户端将这些键的每次写入直接发送给领导者，并指定完成所有者作为将进行回复的副本。 接受者向领导者、其他响应者和完成所有者发送 Accepted。 由于完成所有者本身就是一个响应者，任何针对其键的写入若没有它的 Accepted 都无法完成。 因此它会扣留该消息，并继续提供旧值，直到它收到来自多数派和每个其他响应者的 Accepted。 只有在那之后它才切换到新值并发送自己的 Accepted；它在执行完该写入后回复客户端。 由于投票到达多个学习者而不仅仅是领导者，门控不再由消息模式隐含；扣留投票显式地强制实施门控。 规划器只在估计能带来延迟收益的地方分配完成所有者。 其他热键保持 Bodega 的安排：领导者是它们隐式的完成所有者，并对其收到的写入进行门控；客户端通过其他副本发送的写入不被门控，该副本在执行完这些写入后进行回复。

sents.zh: 热键接收最多的读取，因此其写入路径的目标是在写入待处理时保持响应者继续提供读取服务。

sents.zh: 接受者向领导者、其他响应者和完成所有者发送 Accepted。

sents.en: It therefore withholds that message and keeps serving the old value until it has Accepted from a majority and every other responder.
sents.zh: 因此它会扣留该消息，并继续提供旧值，直到它收到来自多数派和每个其他响应者的 Accepted。

sents.zh: 由于投票到达多个学习者而不仅仅是领导者，门控不再由消息模式隐含；扣留投票显式地强制实施门控。

sents.en: The planner assigns completion owners only where it estimates a latency gain.
sents.zh: 规划器只在估计能带来延迟收益的地方分配完成所有者。

sents.en: Other hot keys keep Bodega ’s arrangement: the leader is their implicit completion owner, and gates the writes it receives itself; writes that clients send through another replica are not gated, and that replica replies once it has executed them.
sents.zh: 其他热键保持 Bodega 的安排：领导者是它们隐式的完成所有者，并对其收到的写入进行门控；客户端通过其他副本发送的写入不被门控，该副本在执行完这些写入后进行回复。

paragraphs.en: Ordinary keys receive fewer reads, so holding back a write to keep one responder serving the old value gains little; their write path instead minimizes write latency. The leader orders writes in the same log, but acceptors send their Accepted votes directly to the client, which completes the write once it holds matching votes from a majority that includes every read responder. This moves PQL ’s learner into the client: in PQL , acceptors also send their votes to the replica near the client, which commits and replies [ 50 , 11 ] . There is no completion-owner shortcut on this path: once a responder accepts a write, it holds later reads of the key until it has itself gathered acceptances from a majority and every responder.
paragraphs.zh: 普通键的读请求较少，因此为了保持某个响应者继续提供旧值而推迟一次写操作的收益甚微；它们的写路径反而以最小化写延迟为目标。 主节点在同一个日志中为写操作排序，但接受者将它们的 Accepted 投票直接发送给客户端，一旦客户端持有来自包含所有读响应者的多数派的匹配投票，写操作即告完成。 这相当于把 PQL 的学习者移到了客户端中：在 PQL 里，接受者同样把投票发送给靠近客户端的副本，由该副本提交并回复 [ 50 , 11 ] 。 这条路径上没有完成者捷径：一旦某个响应者接受了一次写操作，它就会阻塞对同一键的后续读请求，直到它自己从多数派以及所有响应者处收集到接受确认。

sents.en: Ordinary keys receive fewer reads, so holding back a write to keep one responder serving the old value gains little; their write path instead minimizes write latency.
sents.zh: 普通键的读请求较少，因此为了保持某个响应者继续提供旧值而推迟一次写操作的收益甚微；它们的写路径反而以最小化写延迟为目标。

sents.en: This moves PQL ’s learner into the client: in PQL , acceptors also send their votes to the replica near the client, which commits and replies [ 50 , 11 ] .
sents.zh: 这相当于把 PQL 的学习者移到了客户端中：在 PQL 里，接受者同样把投票发送给靠近客户端的副本，由该副本提交并回复 [ 50 , 11 ] 。

sents.en: There is no completion-owner shortcut on this path: once a responder accepts a write, it holds later reads of the key until it has itself gathered acceptances from a majority and every responder.
sents.zh: 这条路径上没有完成者捷径：一旦某个响应者接受了一次写操作，它就会阻塞对同一键的后续读请求，直到它自己从多数派以及所有响应者处收集到接受确认。

paragraphs.en: Writes to infrequently accessed keys rarely conflict, so they can skip leader ordering altogether. The client sends such a write directly to a fixed majority of replicas, the cold quorum . Instead of a shared log, each cold key has its own version sequence. Each member votes for the next version of the key and notifies the client directly; without conflicts, the write completes once the client holds votes from every member. This uncontended case follows the fast path of SwiftPaxos , but omits dependency ordering and the second-vote fallback [ 63 ] . Because every member of the cold quorum votes on every write, all of them learn about it, so they also serve as the key’s read responders without adding a participant to the fast path. A member holds reads of the key from its vote until it learns which value was chosen. Upon a conflict, the leader checks whether either write could already have completed and, if so, keeps it first. It then proposes the next write in a new per-key round, which every cold quorum member must accept before completion. If higher-ballot recovery is needed while the cold path is active, the protocol recovers its potentially completed writes and transfers their state into the shared log. This transfer is permanent; subsequent operations use the log.
paragraphs.zh: 对不常访问的键的写入很少发生冲突，因此它们可以完全跳过领导者排序。 客户端将这类写入直接发送给固定的多数副本，即冷仲裁。 每个冷键拥有自己的版本序列，而不是共享日志。 每个成员为该键的下一个版本投票并直接通知客户端；在没有冲突的情况下，一旦客户端持有来自每个成员的选票，写入即完成。 这种无竞争的情形遵循 SwiftPaxos 的快速路径，但省略了依赖排序和第二次投票回退 [ 63 ]。 由于冷仲裁的每个成员都对每次写入投票，所有成员都会得知该写入，因此它们也充当该键的读取响应者，而无需在快速路径中增加参与者。 成员在得知选定了哪个值之前，会暂扣对该键的读取，直至其投票之后。 发生冲突时，领导者会检查是否某个写入可能已经完成，如果是，则保持其在前。 然后领导者在一个新的按键轮次中提议下一个写入，每个冷仲裁成员都必须接受该提议后写入才能完成。 如果在冷路径活跃期间需要更高选票的恢复，协议会恢复其可能已完成的写入，并将其状态转移到共享日志中。 这种转移是永久的；后续操作都使用该日志。

sents.zh: 对不常访问的键的写入很少发生冲突，因此它们可以完全跳过领导者排序。

sents.zh: 发生冲突时，领导者会检查是否某个写入可能已经完成，如果是，则保持其在前。
