sents.zh: 然后领导者在一个新的按键轮次中提议下一个写入，每个冷仲裁成员都必须接受该提议后写入才能完成。

sents.en: If higher-ballot recovery is needed while the cold path is active, the protocol recovers its potentially completed writes and transfers their state into the shared log.
sents.zh: 如果在冷路径活跃期间需要更高选票的恢复，协议会恢复其可能已完成的写入，并将其状态转移到共享日志中。

sents.en: This transfer is permanent; subsequent operations use the log.
sents.zh: 这种转移是永久的；后续操作都使用该日志。

paragraphs.en: A-greement replicates a key–value store across a fixed set R R of n = 2 ​ f + 1 n=2f+1 replicas; m = f + 1 m=f+1 denotes a majority. Replicas may crash but do not behave arbitrarily or restart. Surviving replicas retain accepted commands and duplicate-detection state in memory. The protocol tolerates delayed or repeated messages. Progress requires partial synchrony: eventually, message delays among available replicas stay below the failure-detection and lease timeouts, and a majority remains available; a fast path may additionally depend on particular replicas.
paragraphs.zh: A-greement 在固定集合 R R 中的 n = 2f+1 个副本之间复制一个键值存储；m = f+1 表示多数。 副本可能崩溃，但不会任意行事，也不会重启。 存活的副本在内存中保留已接受的命令和重复检测状态。 该协议可以容忍延迟或重复的消息。 进展需要部分同步：最终，可用副本之间的消息延迟保持在故障检测和租约超时之内，并且多数副本保持可用；快速路径还可能额外依赖于特定的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Clients issue read and write operations with unique request identifiers. A write returns an acknowledgment. Operations on distinct keys commute. The target consistency guarantee is linearizability.
paragraphs.zh: 客户端使用唯一的请求标识符发起读写操作。 写操作会返回一个确认。 对不同键的操作可以交换顺序。 目标一致性保证是线性一致性。

sents.zh: 对不同键的操作可以交换顺序。

sents.en: The target consistency guarantee is linearizability.
sents.zh: 目标一致性保证是线性一致性。

paragraphs.en: The ordinary log operates in ballots . Ballot b b identifies a leader L b L_{b} and the read responders S b ​ ( k ) S_{b}(k) for each key k k ; we call this assignment the roster . The planner chooses the roster of the initial ballot. A higher ballot may change the leader and removes failed role holders ( § 4.5 ), but otherwise keeps the planned roles. A responder needs a valid lease and sufficiently up-to-date state before answering locally. Leases assume bounded clock-rate drift, but not synchronized clocks. When the cold path is enabled, Q b Q_{b} denotes its fixed majority quorum and its set of read responders.

paragraphs.en: We distinguish acceptance , when a replica records a proposal and votes for it, from execution , when it applies the chosen command to its state. A certificate is a set of matching votes sufficient to establish that a write has been chosen.
paragraphs.zh: 我们区分「接受」（当副本记录一项提案并为其投票时）与「执行」（当它将已选定的命令应用到其状态时）。 证书是一组相互匹配的投票，足以确立一项写入已被选定。

sents.zh: 我们区分「接受」（当副本记录一项提案并为其投票时）与「执行」（当它将已选定的命令应用到其状态时）。

sents.en: A certificate is a set of matching votes sufficient to establish that a write has been chosen.
sents.zh: 证书是一组相互匹配的投票，足以确立一项写入已被选定。

paragraphs.en: The planner runs once, before deployment, on the workload profile introduced above; it does not run during execution. It first divides keys into hot, ordinary, and cold classes. A key is hot if the profile records more accesses to it than to the average observed key. Among the remaining observed keys, the least frequently accessed ones may be assigned to the cold path. The planner considers up to seven candidate cold cutoffs: the hot boundary itself, and the boundaries that split the remaining keys’ cumulative accesses into seven equal parts. All other keys use the shared log. By default, observed keys among them take the ordinary path, while unobserved keys, and hot keys outside every completion-owner range, have the leader as their implicit completion owner; the planner may instead enable direct client certificates for all log-ordered keys, which removes completion owners altogether. Using the sampled read and write counts, measured network delays, and configured workload rate and write fraction, the planner chooses this cold cutoff together with the leader, read responders, completion owners, direct client completion policy, and cold quorum. These choices remain fixed during execution; § A.7 gives the exact rules.
paragraphs.zh: 规划器在部署之前，对上文引入的工作负载特征运行一次；它不会在执行期间运行。 它首先将键划分为热、普通、冷三类。 如果特征中记录的某键的访问次数高于被观测键的平均访问次数，则该键是热键。 在其余被观测的键中，访问频率最低的键可能被分配到冷路径。 规划器最多考虑七个候选的冷分界点：热边界本身，以及把其余键的累计访问次数七等分的分界点。 所有其他键使用共享日志。 默认情况下，其中被观测的键走普通路径，而未被观测的键以及不在任何完成所有者范围内的热键，以领导者作为其隐式完成所有者；规划器也可以改为对所有按日志排序的键启用直接客户端证书，这将完全取消完成所有者。 规划器利用采样得到的读写计数、测得的网络延迟以及配置的工作负载速率和写入比例，来确定这个冷分界点，同时确定领导者、读取响应者、完成所有者、直接客户端完成策略和冷仲裁。 这些选择在执行期间保持不变；§ A.7 给出了确切的规则。

sents.zh: 规划器在部署之前，对上文引入的工作负载特征运行一次；它不会在执行期间运行。

sents.zh: 它首先将键划分为热、普通、冷三类。

sents.zh: 所有其他键使用共享日志。

sents.zh: 默认情况下，其中被观测的键走普通路径，而未被观测的键以及不在任何完成所有者范围内的热键，以领导者作为其隐式完成所有者；规划器也可以改为对所有按日志排序的键启用直接客户端证书，这将完全取消完成所有者。

sents.zh: 这些选择在执行期间保持不变；§ A.7 给出了确切的规则。

paragraphs.en: The planner balances read and write latency: placing a responder closer to readers can make it more costly for writes to reach that responder. The cold path avoids leader ordering but requires every member of its quorum and incurs recovery work when writes conflict. The planner can therefore leave some non-hot keys on the ordinary log or disable the cold path entirely. Its cost model and search procedure are specified in § A.7 ; they guide placement rather than guarantee a latency improvement for every workload.
paragraphs.zh: 规划器（planner）在读写延迟之间进行权衡：将响应者（responder）放置在离读者更近的位置，可能会使写入更难到达该响应者，从而增加写延迟。 冷路径避开了领导者排序，但要求其法定人数中的每个成员都参与，并且在写入冲突时会产生恢复工作。 因此，规划器可以让一些非热点键保留在普通日志上，或者完全禁用冷路径。 其成本模型和搜索过程在 § A.7 中规定；它们用于指导放置决策，而不是保证对每种工作负载都能改善延迟。

paragraphs.en: This subsection states the precise conditions behind the paths of § 4.1 . Before serving requests, replicas install the planned roles under a common ballot: the leader, the read responders of each key range, the completion owners, and, when enabled, the cold quorum. Each client also receives from the plan its read responder and its write ingress , the replica that replies to its writes; for a key in a completion-owner range, the ingress is that owner. The client sends each write both to its ingress and directly to the leader, which proposes whichever copy arrives first. Read responders obtain leases from a majority and catch up before answering locally, and the cold quorum installs the initial per-key state before accepting proposals.

paragraphs.en: A completion owner gates exactly the writes for which it is the ingress: it withholds its vote until it has observed ( 1 ) and advanced its read target to the write, and serves the preceding value meanwhile. The leader plays the same role for the writes it receives itself on log-ordered keys that use neither a completion owner nor direct certificates. Batches are split so that each log entry has at most one gate. If a write that the completion owner does not gate is pending on the key, it holds reads like any other responder. Without a gate, a responder holds reads of a key from the moment it accepts a write to it until it learns that the write is chosen.
paragraphs.zh: 完成属主恰好对其作为入口的写入进行把关：在它观察到（1）并将读目标推进到该写入之前，它会扣留自己的投票，期间继续提供先前的值。 对于既不使用完成属主也不使用直接证书、按日志排序的键上自行接收的写入，领导者扮演同样的角色。 批次会被拆分，使得每个日志条目至多有一个把关。 如果完成属主不把关的某个写入在该键上处于待处理状态，它会像任何其他响应者一样扣留读取。 在没有把关的情况下，响应者从接受对某键的写入那一刻起扣留对该键的读取，直到得知该写入已被选定。

paragraphs.en: A responder can sometimes return a chosen value while execution is still waiting on earlier log entries. It needs matching votes from a majority and every required read responder for the write, together with evidence that a majority has accepted a contiguous log sequence through its entry. The responder can then check whether the write is a new operation or a retry of an earlier request, and return the key’s latest chosen value without waiting for unrelated earlier commands to execute. When the shortcut is unavailable, the read waits. The full eligibility and visibility conditions appear in § A.2 .

paragraphs.en: A member of Q b Q_{b} votes for version v v of a key only if it has applied every version up to v − 1 v-1 and has not voted for another command at v v in the current key round. Matching votes from every member complete the write; the client then distributes the certificate, and replicas apply certified writes in per-key version order. Consequently, a write that reaches a member before the certificate of the key’s preceding write collides there, even if the two writes did not overlap from the clients’ point of view. Such collisions, like concurrent proposals, are resolved by the leader in a higher key round that preserves any write that might already have completed; the fast path resumes once every member of Q b Q_{b} has installed the resolved state.
paragraphs.zh: Q b Q_{b} 的成员只有在已经应用了直到 v − 1 v-1 的每个版本、并且未在当前密钥轮次中为版本 v v 的其他命令投过票时，才会为密钥的版本 v v 投票。 来自每个成员的匹配投票即完成写入；随后客户端分发证书，副本按每密钥的版本顺序应用已认证的写入。 因此，即使从客户端的角度来看两次写入并不重叠，在密钥前一次写入的证书之前到达某成员的写入也会在该成员处发生冲突。 这类冲突与并发提案一样，由领导者在更高的密钥轮次中解决，并保留任何可能已经完成的写入；一旦 Q b Q_{b} 的每个成员都安装了解决后的状态，快速路径即可恢复。

paragraphs.en: Failure of the leader or a required read responder triggers a higher ballot. The leader for that ballot revokes conflicting read leases or waits for them to expire. It collects accepted log entries from a majority, which promise to reject proposals from earlier ballots, and preserves any entry that could already have been chosen. Replacement read responders obtain leases and catch up before answering reads. Other replica failures need no role change if a majority and all required role holders remain available.
paragraphs.zh: 主节点或指定的读应答者发生故障时，会触发更高的选票编号。 该选票的主节点会撤销冲突的读租约，或等待它们到期。 它从多数节点收集已接受的日志条目，这些节点承诺拒绝来自更早选票的提议，并且它会保留任何可能已经被选定的条目。 替补的读应答者在应答读请求之前会先获取租约并追上进度。 只要多数节点和所有所需角色的持有者仍然可用，其他副本的故障无需进行角色变更。

paragraphs.en: If the cold path is active, higher-ballot recovery also freezes its voting and collects acceptance records from a majority. A write might have completed before its client distributed the certificate, so a missing certificate does not establish that the write was unchosen. Recovery preserves every write that might have completed and binds the recovered cold state to a bridge entry in the ordinary log. Executing this entry installs that state and imports its request identifiers for duplicate detection. The handoff is permanent: subsequent operations use the ordinary log, and write completion and read visibility require execution of the relevant log prefix. A same-key collision instead uses a leader-coordinated round to resolve the next per-key version, after which the cold quorum can resume the fast path.
paragraphs.zh: 如果冷路径处于活跃状态，更高选票的恢复过程同样会冻结其投票，并从多数节点收集接受记录。 一次写入可能在客户端分发证书之前就已完成，因此缺少证书并不能证明该写入未被选定。 恢复过程会保留每个可能已完成的写入，并将恢复出的冷状态绑定到普通日志中的一个桥接条目。 执行该条目会安装该状态，并导入其请求标识符用于重复检测。 这种交接是永久的：后续操作使用普通日志，写入完成和读取可见性都需要执行相关日志前缀。 同键冲突则改用由领导者协调的轮次来确定下一个按键的版本，之后冷仲裁即可恢复快速路径。

paragraphs.en: Turning a consensus design into an efficient implementation requires engineering optimization beyond pseudocode [ 12 ] . When acting as a developer to implement each finalized candidate protocol, we allow AI-greement to perform up to five rounds of performance tuning. These rounds use experimental feedback to refine implementation choices while preserving the protocol idea. The following engineering optimizations reduce communication and waiting in A-greement and limit repeated execution and recovery work.
paragraphs.zh: 将共识设计转化为高效实现需要超越伪代码层面的工程优化 [ 12 ]。 在作为开发者实现每个最终确定的候选协议时，我们允许 AI-greement 进行最多五轮性能调优。 这些轮次利用实验反馈来完善实现选择，同时保持协议思路不变。 以下工程优化减少了 A-greement 中的通信与等待，并限制了重复执行与恢复工作。

paragraphs.en: The completion owner’s read shortcut imposes a constraint on batching: each log entry may have at most one owner withholding its vote. If an entry depended on several such owners, each could wait for a vote that another owner was withholding. The leader therefore splits a pending batch when it encounters an eligible write with a different completion owner, preserving command order across the resulting entries.
paragraphs.zh: 补全所有者的读取捷径对批处理施加了一个约束：每个日志条目至多只能有一个所有者扣留其投票。 如果一个条目依赖于多个这样的所有者，每个所有者都可能等待另一个所有者扣留的投票。 因此，领导者在遇到具有不同补全所有者的合格写入时会拆分待处理批次，并在由此产生的各条目之间保持命令顺序。

sents.en: The completion owner’s read shortcut imposes a constraint on batching: each log entry may have at most one owner withholding its vote.
sents.zh: 补全所有者的读取捷径对批处理施加了一个约束：每个日志条目至多只能有一个所有者扣留其投票。

sents.en: If an entry depended on several such owners, each could wait for a vote that another owner was withholding.
sents.zh: 如果一个条目依赖于多个这样的所有者，每个所有者都可能等待另一个所有者扣留的投票。

sents.en: The leader therefore splits a pending batch when it encounters an eligible write with a different completion owner, preserving command order across the resulting entries.
sents.zh: 因此，领导者在遇到具有不同补全所有者的合格写入时会拆分待处理批次，并在由此产生的各条目之间保持命令顺序。

paragraphs.en: Only writes eligible for the owner shortcut determine these split points. Writes eligible for direct client certificates never acquire a gate of their own, even when an owner is assigned to their key. They can, however, be batched into the same log entry as a gated write, and then wait for its gate ( § 10 ). Replicas also check received entries and disable the shortcut if completion owners are incompatible. This permits batching among compatible writes while retaining the owner’s ability to serve the preceding value during a pending write. Changes in eligible completion owners can reduce batch size.
paragraphs.zh: 只有符合所有者快捷条件资格的写操作才会决定这些分割点。 符合直接客户端证书资格的写操作永远不会获取自己的门控，即使其键已被分配了所有者。 不过，它们可以与一个受门控的写操作一起批量写入同一条日志条目，然后等待该条目的门控（§ 10）。 副本也会检查收到的条目，并在完成所有者不兼容时禁用该快捷方式。 这允许在兼容的写操作之间进行批量处理，同时保留所有者在写操作挂起期间提供前一个值的能力。 符合资格的完成所有者发生变化可能会减小批量的大小。

sents.en: Only writes eligible for the owner shortcut determine these split points.
sents.zh: 只有符合所有者快捷条件资格的写操作才会决定这些分割点。

sents.en: Writes eligible for direct client certificates never acquire a gate of their own, even when an owner is assigned to their key.
sents.zh: 符合直接客户端证书资格的写操作永远不会获取自己的门控，即使其键已被分配了所有者。

sents.en: They can, however, be batched into the same log entry as a gated write, and then wait for its gate ( § 10 ).
sents.zh: 不过，它们可以与一个受门控的写操作一起批量写入同一条日志条目，然后等待该条目的门控（§ 10）。

sents.en: Replicas also check received entries and disable the shortcut if completion owners are incompatible.
sents.zh: 副本也会检查收到的条目，并在完成所有者不兼容时禁用该快捷方式。

sents.en: This permits batching among compatible writes while retaining the owner’s ability to serve the preceding value during a pending write.
sents.zh: 这允许在兼容的写操作之间进行批量处理，同时保留所有者在写操作挂起期间提供前一个值的能力。

sents.en: Changes in eligible completion owners can reduce batch size.
sents.zh: 符合资格的完成所有者发生变化可能会减小批量的大小。

paragraphs.en: The leader broadcasts ordinary proposals, while acceptors direct their votes to replicas that collect completion or read-visibility evidence. For fresh current-ballot entries, the recipient set includes the leader, planned learners, all read responders in the installed roster, and the ingresses of batched requests. Planned learners include write ingresses and completion owners; previously observed request ingresses are also retained as recipients. These sites collect evidence directly while votes to other replicas can be omitted.
paragraphs.zh: 领导者广播普通提案，而接受者则将投票发送给收集完成或读可见性证据的智能体。 对于新当选票上的条目，接收者集合包括领导者、计划中的学习者、已安装名单中的所有读响应者，以及批量请求的入口。 计划中的学习者包括写入口和完成所有者；之前观察到请求的入口也会保留为接收者。 这些站点直接收集证据，而发往其他智能体的投票可以省略。

sents.en: The leader broadcasts ordinary proposals, while acceptors direct their votes to replicas that collect completion or read-visibility evidence.
sents.zh: 领导者广播普通提案，而接受者则将投票发送给收集完成或读可见性证据的智能体。

sents.en: For fresh current-ballot entries, the recipient set includes the leader, planned learners, all read responders in the installed roster, and the ingresses of batched requests.
sents.zh: 对于新当选票上的条目，接收者集合包括领导者、计划中的学习者、已安装名单中的所有读响应者，以及批量请求的入口。

sents.en: Planned learners include write ingresses and completion owners; previously observed request ingresses are also retained as recipients.
sents.zh: 计划中的学习者包括写入口和完成所有者；之前观察到请求的入口也会保留为接收者。

sents.en: These sites collect evidence directly while votes to other replicas can be omitted.
sents.zh: 这些站点直接收集证据，而发往其他智能体的投票可以省略。

paragraphs.en: For eligible ordinary writes, acceptors also send votes directly to the client. The majority and responder-coverage requirements remain unchanged. Vote traffic decreases when the recipient set excludes some replicas; if the selected roles cover the entire membership, no votes are omitted. Recovered entries and configurations without a selective learner set retain dissemination to all replicas.
paragraphs.zh: 对于符合条件的普通写入，接受者还会直接向客户端发送投票。 多数派和响应者覆盖的要求保持不变。 当接收者集合排除部分副本时，投票流量会减少；如果所选角色覆盖全部成员，则不会遗漏任何投票。 没有选择性学习者集合的已恢复条目和配置仍向所有副本分发。

sents.en: For eligible ordinary writes, acceptors also send votes directly to the client.
sents.zh: 对于符合条件的普通写入，接受者还会直接向客户端发送投票。

sents.en: The majority and responder-coverage requirements remain unchanged.
sents.zh: 多数派和响应者覆盖的要求保持不变。

sents.en: Vote traffic decreases when the recipient set excludes some replicas; if the selected roles cover the entire membership, no votes are omitted.
sents.zh: 当接收者集合排除部分副本时，投票流量会减少；如果所选角色覆盖全部成员，则不会遗漏任何投票。

sents.en: Recovered entries and configurations without a selective learner set retain dissemination to all replicas.
sents.zh: 没有选择性学习者集合的已恢复条目和配置仍向所有副本分发。

paragraphs.en: A read’s target depends on both the state of a write and who controls its completion. A chosen current-ballot write may be visible before prefix execution, whereas an accepted write that could complete elsewhere must already prevent stale reads. Each replica therefore maintains per-key indexes for the latest accepted write, the latest committed write, and the latest write whose completion is outside the owner’s control. The third index identifies writes that prevent the owner from continuing to serve the preceding value. Together, these indexes support the owner’s read shortcut while fencing writes that may have completed elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 一次读取的目标同时取决于写入的状态以及谁控制着它的完成。 已选定当前选票的写入可能在执行前缀之前可见，而可能在别处完成的已接受写入则必须已经阻止过时的读取。 因此，每个副本按键维护多个索引：最新已接受的写入、最新已提交的写入，以及完成不在所有者控制之内的最新写入。 第三个索引用于识别那些阻止所有者继续提供先前值的写入。 这些索引共同支持所有者的读取快捷路径，同时对可能在别处完成的写入进行栅栏保护。

sents.en: A read’s target depends on both the state of a write and who controls its completion.
sents.zh: 一次读取的目标同时取决于写入的状态以及谁控制着它的完成。

sents.en: A chosen current-ballot write may be visible before prefix execution, whereas an accepted write that could complete elsewhere must already prevent stale reads.
sents.zh: 已选定当前选票的写入可能在执行前缀之前可见，而可能在别处完成的已接受写入则必须已经阻止过时的读取。

sents.en: Each replica therefore maintains per-key indexes for the latest accepted write, the latest committed write, and the latest write whose completion is outside the owner’s control.
sents.zh: 因此，每个副本按键维护多个索引：最新已接受的写入、最新已提交的写入，以及完成不在所有者控制之内的最新写入。

sents.en: The third index identifies writes that prevent the owner from continuing to serve the preceding value.
sents.zh: 第三个索引用于识别那些阻止所有者继续提供先前值的写入。

sents.en: Together, these indexes support the owner’s read shortcut while fencing writes that may have completed elsewhere.
sents.zh: 这些索引共同支持所有者的读取快捷路径，同时对可能在别处完成的写入进行栅栏保护。

paragraphs.en: The indexes locate a read’s target log position without searching the log. Blocked reads are grouped by that position in two ordered queues: one for prefix execution and another for earlier visibility once the acceptance-prefix evidence permits it. As each prefix advances, the replica revisits the corresponding groups instead of scanning all waiting readers. This limits repeated work as blocked reads accumulate while preserving both ways of making a read ready. Every release still checks the lease, responder assignment, and chosen-value visibility conditions in § 4.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 这些索引无需搜索日志即可定位读取的目标日志位置。 被阻塞的读取按该位置被分组到两个有序队列中：一个用于前缀执行，另一个用于在接受前缀证据允许时实现更早的可见性。 随着每个前缀推进，副本会重新访问相应的分组，而不是扫描所有等待中的读取者。 这在保留使读取就绪的两种方式的同时，限制了被阻塞读取累积时产生的重复工作。 每次释放仍会检查 § 4.4 中的租约、响应者分配以及已选定值的可见性条件。

sents.en: The indexes locate a read’s target log position without searching the log.
sents.zh: 这些索引无需搜索日志即可定位读取的目标日志位置。

sents.en: Blocked reads are grouped by that position in two ordered queues: one for prefix execution and another for earlier visibility once the acceptance-prefix evidence permits it.
sents.zh: 被阻塞的读取按该位置被分组到两个有序队列中：一个用于前缀执行，另一个用于在接受前缀证据允许时实现更早的可见性。

sents.en: As each prefix advances, the replica revisits the corresponding groups instead of scanning all waiting readers.
sents.zh: 随着每个前缀推进，副本会重新访问相应的分组，而不是扫描所有等待中的读取者。

sents.en: This limits repeated work as blocked reads accumulate while preserving both ways of making a read ready.
sents.zh: 这在保留使读取就绪的两种方式的同时，限制了被阻塞读取累积时产生的重复工作。

sents.en: Every release still checks the lease, responder assignment, and chosen-value visibility conditions in § 4.4 .
sents.zh: 每次释放仍会检查 § 4.4 中的租约、响应者分配以及已选定值的可见性条件。

paragraphs.en: A nearby responder may return later than a more distant one if a concurrent write holds its read. For selected hot keys, the planner therefore assigns a second responder using network delays and modeled read waiting. The client sends the same request to both responders without waiting for a timeout, after checking that the second target is available and authorized for the key. The assignment applies only while the initial ballot and leader remain unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 如果并发写入阻塞了某个较近响应者的读取，它可能比更远的响应者返回得更晚。 因此，对于选定的热点键，规划器会根据网络延迟和建模的读取等待时间分配第二个响应者。 在确认第二个目标可用且对该键具有授权后，客户端将同一请求同时发送给两个响应者，而无需等待超时。 该分配仅在初始选票和领导者保持不变期间有效。

sents.en: A nearby responder may return later than a more distant one if a concurrent write holds its read.
sents.zh: 如果并发写入阻塞了某个较近响应者的读取，它可能比更远的响应者返回得更晚。

sents.en: For selected hot keys, the planner therefore assigns a second responder using network delays and modeled read waiting.
sents.zh: 因此，对于选定的热点键，规划器会根据网络延迟和建模的读取等待时间分配第二个响应者。

sents.en: The client sends the same request to both responders without waiting for a timeout, after checking that the second target is available and authorized for the key.
sents.zh: 在确认第二个目标可用且对该键具有授权后，客户端将同一请求同时发送给两个响应者，而无需等待超时。

sents.en: The assignment applies only while the initial ballot and leader remain unchanged.
sents.zh: 该分配仅在初始选票和领导者保持不变期间有效。

paragraphs.en: Each responder independently checks its lease and read-visibility conditions. The client returns the first valid result and sends a best-effort cancellation to release waiting state on the other path. This trades an additional read request for an opportunity to avoid waiting behind a write at one responder. The planner selects this extra path only for ranges where its model predicts a sufficient gain.
paragraphs.zh: 每个响应方独立检查其租约和读可见性条件。 客户端返回第一个有效结果，并尽力发送取消请求，以释放另一条路径上的等待状态。 这是用一次额外的读请求，换取在一个响应方避免排队等待写入的机会。 规划器只在其模型预测有足够收益的范围上选择这条额外路径。

sents.en: Each responder independently checks its lease and read-visibility conditions.
sents.zh: 每个响应方独立检查其租约和读可见性条件。

sents.en: The client returns the first valid result and sends a best-effort cancellation to release waiting state on the other path.
sents.zh: 客户端返回第一个有效结果，并尽力发送取消请求，以释放另一条路径上的等待状态。

sents.en: This trades an additional read request for an opportunity to avoid waiting behind a write at one responder.
sents.zh: 这是用一次额外的读请求，换取在一个响应方避免排队等待写入的机会。

sents.en: The planner selects this extra path only for ranges where its model predicts a sufficient gain.
sents.zh: 规划器只在其模型预测有足够收益的范围上选择这条额外路径。

paragraphs.en: Placing write completion near a reader may select an ingress different from the leader. Sending the command only through that ingress would make ordering wait for an additional forwarding hop. When the selected ingress differs from an available leader, the client sends an ordinary write directly to the leader as well as to the ingress. The direct copy identifies the selected ingress, allowing the leader to start ordering while execution replies retain their planned return path.
paragraphs.zh: 将写入完成点放置在靠近读取方的位置，可能选中的入口与领导者（leader）不同。 如果命令仅通过该入口发送，排序将需要等待额外的一次转发跳。 当所选入口不同于某个可用的领导者时，客户端会向领导者直接发送一条普通写入，同时也向该入口发送。 直接副本会标识所选入口，使领导者能够开始排序，同时执行回复仍保留其原定的返回路径。

sents.en: Placing write completion near a reader may select an ingress different from the leader.
sents.zh: 将写入完成点放置在靠近读取方的位置，可能选中的入口与领导者（leader）不同。

sents.en: Sending the command only through that ingress would make ordering wait for an additional forwarding hop.
sents.zh: 如果命令仅通过该入口发送，排序将需要等待额外的一次转发跳。

sents.en: When the selected ingress differs from an available leader, the client sends an ordinary write directly to the leader as well as to the ingress.
sents.zh: 当所选入口不同于某个可用的领导者时，客户端会向领导者直接发送一条普通写入，同时也向该入口发送。

sents.en: The direct copy identifies the selected ingress, allowing the leader to start ordering while execution replies retain their planned return path.
sents.zh: 直接副本会标识所选入口，使领导者能够开始排序，同时执行回复仍保留其原定的返回路径。

paragraphs.en: Both copies retain the original request identifier, so a later forwarded copy is recognized as the same operation. The leader can thus begin ordering without waiting for ingress forwarding, while the ingress keeps its completion role. The additional client-to-leader transmission trades bandwidth for earlier ordering; its net benefit depends on the network routes.
paragraphs.zh: 两份副本都保留原始请求标识符，因此后续转发的副本会被识别为同一操作。 因此，领导者可以在不等待入口转发的情况下开始排序，而入口节点仍保留其完成角色。 额外的客户端到领导者的传输以带宽换取更早的排序；其净收益取决于网络路由。

sents.en: Both copies retain the original request identifier, so a later forwarded copy is recognized as the same operation.
sents.zh: 两份副本都保留原始请求标识符，因此后续转发的副本会被识别为同一操作。

sents.en: The leader can thus begin ordering without waiting for ingress forwarding, while the ingress keeps its completion role.
sents.zh: 因此，领导者可以在不等待入口转发的情况下开始排序，而入口节点仍保留其完成角色。

sents.en: The additional client-to-leader transmission trades bandwidth for earlier ordering; its net benefit depends on the network routes.
sents.zh: 额外的客户端到领导者的传输以带宽换取更早的排序；其净收益取决于网络路由。

paragraphs.en: The per-key write path can complete a cold-key write before its chosen proof reaches every replica. Recovery must reconstruct these writes from retained records, but full snapshots would repeatedly transfer command contents held by several participants. The implementation therefore separates the evidence needed to select the recovered state from the command data needed to install it.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 key 的写入路径可能会在其所选证明到达所有副本之前，先完成对一个冷 key 的写入。 恢复必须从保留的记录中重建这些写入，但完整快照会反复传输由多个参与者持有的命令内容。 因此，该实现将选择恢复状态所需的证据与安装该状态所需的命令数据分离开来。

sents.en: The per-key write path can complete a cold-key write before its chosen proof reaches every replica.
sents.zh: 每个 key 的写入路径可能会在其所选证明到达所有副本之前，先完成对一个冷 key 的写入。

sents.en: Recovery must reconstruct these writes from retained records, but full snapshots would repeatedly transfer command contents held by several participants.
sents.zh: 恢复必须从保留的记录中重建这些写入，但完整快照会反复传输由多个参与者持有的命令内容。

sents.en: The implementation therefore separates the evidence needed to select the recovered state from the command data needed to install it.
sents.zh: 因此，该实现将选择恢复状态所需的证据与安装该状态所需的命令数据分离开来。

paragraphs.en: Each replica freezes a metadata report containing per-key versions, request identifiers, command digests, and acceptance evidence, while retaining full commands locally. The coordinator collects complete reports from a majority and selects the state to preserve according to § 4.5 . The reports also identify potential command holders, allowing selection without attaching full command contents to every report.
paragraphs.zh: 每个副本冻结一份元数据报告，其中包含按密钥的版本、请求标识符、命令摘要和接受证据，同时在本地保留完整命令。 协调者从多数副本收集完整报告，并根据 § 4.5 选择要保留的状态。 报告还会标识潜在的命令持有者，从而无需在每个报告中附上完整命令内容即可完成选择。

sents.en: Each replica freezes a metadata report containing per-key versions, request identifiers, command digests, and acceptance evidence, while retaining full commands locally.
sents.zh: 每个副本冻结一份元数据报告，其中包含按密钥的版本、请求标识符、命令摘要和接受证据，同时在本地保留完整命令。

sents.en: The coordinator collects complete reports from a majority and selects the state to preserve according to § 4.5 .
sents.zh: 协调者从多数副本收集完整报告，并根据 § 4.5 选择要保留的状态。

sents.en: The reports also identify potential command holders, allowing selection without attaching full command contents to every report.
sents.zh: 报告还会标识潜在的命令持有者，从而无需在每个报告中附上完整命令内容即可完成选择。

paragraphs.en: The coordinator distributes a manifest listing recovered versions and request identities, with digest references to the required commands. Recipients check these references against their local command stores and fetch only missing contents from replicas that retain them. Each recipient tracks missing commands and votes only after retaining and validating all referenced data. This reduces repeated payload transfer when reports refer to the same command or recipients already cache it; cache misses still require data fetching before installation.
paragraphs.zh: 协调者分发一份清单，其中列出已恢复的版本和请求标识，并附带对所需命令的摘要引用。 接收方将这些引用与其本地命令存储进行比对，只从仍保留相关内容的副本获取缺失的内容。 每个接收方跟踪缺失的命令，只有在保留并验证所有被引用的数据之后才投票。 当报告引用同一命令或接收方已缓存该命令时，这可以减少重复的载荷传输；缓存未命中时，仍需在安装之前获取数据。

sents.en: The coordinator distributes a manifest listing recovered versions and request identities, with digest references to the required commands.
sents.zh: 协调者分发一份清单，其中列出已恢复的版本和请求标识，并附带对所需命令的摘要引用。

sents.en: Recipients check these references against their local command stores and fetch only missing contents from replicas that retain them.
sents.zh: 接收方将这些引用与其本地命令存储进行比对，只从仍保留相关内容的副本获取缺失的内容。

sents.en: Each recipient tracks missing commands and votes only after retaining and validating all referenced data.
sents.zh: 每个接收方跟踪缺失的命令，只有在保留并验证所有被引用的数据之后才投票。

sents.en: This reduces repeated payload transfer when reports refer to the same command or recipients already cache it; cache misses still require data fetching before installation.
sents.zh: 当报告引用同一命令或接收方已缓存该命令时，这可以减少重复的载荷传输；缓存未命中时，仍需在安装之前获取数据。

paragraphs.en: Bridge installation reuses the command store and missing-command tracking, pausing until the referenced contents are complete. It also imports recovered request identifiers into ordinary duplicate detection, preserving operation identities as pending requests move to the log. Command transfer continues over ordinary peer streams after the per-key write path is disabled, so installed replicas can help others finish recovery without reactivating that path.
paragraphs.zh: 桥接安装复用命令存储和缺失命令跟踪，并暂停直到被引用的内容完成。 它还将已恢复的请求标识符导入普通的重复检测中，在待处理请求移动到日志时保留操作标识。 在每键写入路径被禁用后，命令传输仍通过普通的对等流继续进行，因此已安装的副本可以帮助其他副本完成恢复，而无需重新激活该路径。

sents.en: Bridge installation reuses the command store and missing-command tracking, pausing until the referenced contents are complete.
sents.zh: 桥接安装复用命令存储和缺失命令跟踪，并暂停直到被引用的内容完成。

sents.en: It also imports recovered request identifiers into ordinary duplicate detection, preserving operation identities as pending requests move to the log.
sents.zh: 它还将已恢复的请求标识符导入普通的重复检测中，在待处理请求移动到日志时保留操作标识。

sents.en: Command transfer continues over ordinary peer streams after the per-key write path is disabled, so installed replicas can help others finish recovery without reactivating that path.
sents.zh: 在每键写入路径被禁用后，命令传输仍通过普通的对等流继续进行，因此已安装的副本可以帮助其他副本完成恢复，而无需重新激活该路径。

paragraphs.en: AI-greement did not create the final version of A-greement fully autonomously, however. Before accepting A-greement ’s great performance in our measured benchmarks, we reviewed whether its improvements reflected generalizable design choices or hard-coded benchmark-hacking. It is known that agents may use unexpected methods or cheat to reach their goals [ 31 , 69 ] . As our discovery process uses a quantitative benchmark to assess performance, the agent might use questionable methods to optimize for latency, resulting in a non-generalizable algorithm with shortcuts. We observed multiple cases where AI-greement employed such shortcuts, especially when the agent was aware only of the evaluation it could invoke itself.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，AI-greement 并未完全自主地创建出 A-greement 的最终版本。 在接受 A-greement 在我们所测基准上的出色表现之前，我们审查了其改进究竟反映了可泛化的设计选择，还是硬编码的基准作弊。 众所周知，智能体可能使用意想不到的方法或作弊来达成其目标 [31, 69]。 由于我们的发现过程使用定量基准来评估性能，该智能体可能采用可疑的方法来优化延迟，从而产生带有捷径的、不可泛化的算法。 我们观察到多起 AI-greement 采用此类捷径的案例，尤其是在该智能体只知道它可以自行调用的评估时。

paragraphs.en: We mitigated this by introducing a separate test set and telling the agent about it, while keeping its details hidden. While this discouraged hard-coded execution paths, it did not eliminate questionable optimizations. A separate test set can expose overfitting to particular workloads, but it cannot rule out unsupported claims of improvement or shortcuts that exploit assumptions shared by the development and test environments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过引入一个单独的测试集并将其告知智能体（同时隐藏其细节）来缓解了这一问题。 虽然这抑制了硬编码的执行路径，但并未消除可疑的优化手段。 单独的测试集可以暴露针对特定工作负载的过拟合，但无法排除缺乏依据的改进声明，也无法排除利用开发环境与测试环境之间共享假设的捷径。

paragraphs.en: Automated checks can enforce explicit requirements, but those requirements may still fail to capture the intended behavior, even in formally verified systems [ 22 ] . Deciding which requirements capture a meaningful consensus experiment therefore still requires domain knowledge. We reviewed the generated implementation and intervened where a latency improvement depended on assumptions we did not consider acceptable.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化检查可以强制执行明确的需求，但这些需求仍然可能无法捕捉预期的行为，即使在经过形式化验证的系统中也是如此 [ 22 ]。 因此，判断哪些需求能够捕捉有意义的共识实验，仍然需要领域知识。 我们审查了生成的实现，并在延迟改进依赖于我们认为不可接受的假设之处进行了干预。

paragraphs.en: For example, our benchmark sampled network jitter independently for each message. The agent exploited this by sending duplicate requests simultaneously over two TCP connections to the same destination and using whichever arrived first. This reduced measured latency by giving each logical request two chances to receive a smaller delay, an advantage that is unlikely to materialize on a real network, where messages sent together to the same destination are rarely reordered. Moreover, due to borrowing ideas from Bodega , A-greement inherited one of its flaws, detailed in § 8 . We removed both the inherited flaw and benchmark-hacking before the final evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，我们的基准测试为每条消息独立采样网络抖动。 智能体利用了这一点：它通过两条 TCP 连接同时向同一目的地发送重复请求，并采用先到达的那个结果。 这降低了测量到的延迟，因为它让每个逻辑请求有两次机会获得更小的延迟；这一优势在真实网络上不太可能出现，因为同时发送到同一目的地的消息很少被乱序。 此外，由于借鉴了 Bodega 的思路，A-greement 继承了它的一个缺陷，详见第 8 节。 在最终评估之前，我们移除了这一继承的缺陷和针对基准测试的作弊行为。

paragraphs.en: We implement and evaluate the efficiency of A-greement . Our experiments answer the following questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们实现并评估了 A-协议（A-greement）的效率。 我们的实验回答了以下问题：

sents.en: We implement and evaluate the efficiency of A-greement .
sents.zh: 我们实现并评估了 A-协议（A-greement）的效率。

sents.en: Our experiments answer the following questions:
sents.zh: 我们的实验回答了以下问题：

paragraphs.en: How does failure-free latency of A-greement compare with that of state-of-the-art protocols across workloads, deployment sizes and topologies ( § 7.3 )?
paragraphs.zh: A-greement 的无故障延迟在各工作负载、部署规模和拓扑下与最先进的协议相比表现如何（§ 7.3）？

paragraphs.en: Can A-greement keep making progress and recover when replicas fail, despite the role assignments that reduce its normal-case latency ( § 7.4 )?
paragraphs.zh: 即使存在降低其正常情况下延迟的角色分配（§ 7.4），A-greement 还能在副本发生故障时持续取得进展并恢复吗？

paragraphs.en: What does it cost, in terms of tokens and time, for AI-greement to discover A-greement ( § 7.5 )?
paragraphs.zh: 「AI-greement」发现「A-greement」（第 7.5 节）在 token 和时间方面需要付出多少代价？

paragraphs.en: We implement AI-greement as a repository-based harness and run it using the goal mode of Codex powered by GPT-6.1 Sol High , with the prompt in Appendix B . A top-level AGENTS.md encodes the researcher–developer–verifier workflow, consistency requirements across designs, implementations, and proofs, and the performance and recovery criteria for accepting candidates. Four project-specific skills provide operational guidance for knowledge retrieval, prototype development and benchmarking, Lean formalization, and Lean proof construction. The skills connect these roles to the three components in § 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 AI-greement 实现为基于代码仓库的框架，并使用由 GPT-6.1 Sol High 驱动的 Codex 的目标模式运行它，提示词见附录 B。 顶层的 AGENTS.md 文件编码了研究者—开发者—验证者的工作流程、设计、实现与证明之间的一致性要求，以及接受候选方案的性能与恢复标准。 四个项目专用技能为知识检索、原型开发与基准测试、Lean 形式化以及 Lean 证明构建提供操作指导。 这些技能将上述角色与 § 3 中的三个组件联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Our implementation is organized into three repositories: ConsensusWiki , ConsensusArena , and ConsensusVerifier . ConsensusWiki provides the knowledge base described in § 3.1 , comprising 97 Markdown documents and approximately 8,600 lines. ConsensusArena provides the implementation framework described in § 3.2 . It contains approximately 6,800 lines of shared Go runtime code, 19,100 lines across the baseline implementations, and 8,300 lines for A-greement . ConsensusVerifier provides the verification framework described in § 3.3 . It comprises approximately 135K lines of Lean code, covering shared definitions and formal specifications and proofs for Multi-Paxos , FastPaxos , SwiftPaxos , EPaxos *, Bodega and A-greement . Of these, approximately 98K lines support the final model and proofs of A-greement . For Bodega , we prove its linearizability when the early-accept optimization is disabled; when it is enabled, we exhibit a counterexample to linearizability ( § 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实现由三个代码库组成：ConsensusWiki、ConsensusArena 和 ConsensusVerifier。 ConsensusWiki 提供了 §3.1 中所述的知识库，包含 97 份 Markdown 文档，约 8,600 行。 ConsensusArena 提供了 §3.2 中所述的实现框架。 它包含约 6,800 行共享的 Go 运行时代码、基线实现共约 19,100 行，以及 A-greement 的约 8,300 行代码。 ConsensusVerifier 提供了 §3.3 中所述的验证框架。 它包含约 135K 行 Lean 代码，涵盖共享定义以及 Multi-Paxos、FastPaxos、SwiftPaxos、EPaxos*、Bodega 和 A-greement 的形式化规约与证明。 其中，约 98K 行用于支持 A-greement 的最终模型与证明。 对于 Bodega，我们证明了在禁用早期接受（early-accept）优化时其线性一致性成立；当启用该优化时，我们给出了一个违反线性一致性的反例（§8）。

paragraphs.en: To compare the baselines under common deployment conditions without hardcoded assumptions about topology or key popularity, we adapt their planners to use supplied topology inputs and, where needed, independent pre-measurement workload samples, following the core configuration principles of the respective papers and source code. We also address implementation issues to support the broader range of workloads and deployment configurations exercised by our benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在没有对拓扑或密钥热度的硬编码假设的常见部署条件下比较各基线方法，我们调整其规划器以使用提供的拓扑输入，并在需要时使用独立的预测量负载样本，遵循相应论文和源代码的核心配置原则。 我们还解决了实现问题，以支持我们的基准测试所涉及的更广泛的工作负载和部署配置。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, for Bodega , whose original evaluation scripts manually select the leader, we reuse our Multi-Paxos planner to choose the initial leader that minimizes the mean client–leader round-trip latency plus the estimated time to collect a majority of acknowledgments. When an independent pre-measurement sample contains only reads, we configure every replica as a responder for all keys, enabling local reads throughout the deployment. In addition, we also disable its early-accept notification optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，对于 Bodega（其原始评估脚本手动选择主节点），我们复用我们的 Multi-Paxos 规划器来选择使客户端与主节点之间的平均往返延迟加上收集多数确认所需的估计时间最小的初始主节点。 当独立的预测量样本只包含读操作时，我们将所有副本配置为所有键的响应者，从而使整个部署中的读操作都能在本地完成。 此外，我们还禁用了它的提前接受通知优化。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate A-greement against SwiftPaxos [ 63 ] , Bodega [ 29 ] , Multi-Paxos [ 38 ] , and KCensus [ 9 ] . We consider four deployment sizes with 5, 9, 13, and 17 replicas, each containing an equal number of clients. At each size, we generate one uniform, one clustered, and one colocated network topology, for a total of twelve configurations. Uniform topologies place all participants independently, clustered topologies group them around three centers, and colocated topologies place each client at the same location as one replica. Network delay, asymmetry, jitter, bandwidth, client placement, leader placement, workload arrival rate, value size, key-space size, and key-access skew vary across these configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 A-greement 与 SwiftPaxos [63]、Bodega [29]、Multi-Paxos [38] 和 KCensus [9] 进行对比评估。 我们考虑四种部署规模，分别包含 5、9、13 和 17 个副本，每个规模中客户端数量相同。 在每个规模下，我们生成一种均匀、一种聚类和一种同置的网络拓扑，共十二种配置。 均匀拓扑将所有参与者独立放置，聚类拓扑将它们围绕三个中心分组，同置拓扑将每个客户端与某个副本放置在同一位置。 网络延迟、不对称性、抖动、带宽、客户端放置、领导者放置、工作负载到达率、值大小、键空间大小和键访问偏斜在这些配置中各不相同。

paragraphs.en: We generate key–value workloads with read/write mixes corresponding to YCSB workloads A, B, and C [ 16 ] . Reads and writes correspond to Get and Put operations, respectively. Workload A contains 50% writes, workload B contains 5% writes, and workload C is read-only. The per-client arrival rate is sampled independently for each topology between 500 and 1,800 requests per second. Commands carry values of 256, 1,000, or 2,048 bytes and operate over either 250,000 or one million keys. For each topology, we sample a Zipf skew parameter θ \theta from [ 0.65 , 1.15 ] [0.65,1.15] and hold it fixed throughout the experiment. Each request independently selects a popularity rank r r with probability p r ∝ ( r + 1 ) − θ p_{r}\propto(r+1)^{-\theta} ; ranks are mapped to key identifiers through a fixed random permutation shared by all clients. Across the twelve generated topologies, the sampled values of θ \theta range from 0.651 0.651 to 1.120 1.120 . Clients submit requests according to an open-loop Poisson process, meaning that request arrivals are scheduled independently of response completion. After a five-second warm-up, clients generate requests at the configured arrival rates during a ten-second measurement window. After the measurement window ends, we wait for all requests submitted during that window to complete and include their end-to-end latencies.

paragraphs.en: We run all experiments on EPFL’s SCITAS Jed CPU cluster using Slurm [ 34 ] 2 2 2 See https://www.epfl.ch/research/facilities/scitas/jed/ . . Experiments use 2–5 compute nodes, depending on the deployment size. Each node contains two 36-core Intel Xeon Platinum 8360Y processors running at 2.40 GHz, for a total of 72 physical cores, and 492 GB of memory. Replicas, clients, and the coordinating master execute as separate Slurm tasks, each requesting eight CPUs. Communication uses TCP over the cluster’s Ethernet interconnect. ConsensusArena uses Toxiproxy to emulate the generated network conditions. For each topology, we select a bandwidth limit of 200 Mb/s, 1 Gb/s, or 4 Gb/s for each TCP connection and direction. We also select a jitter parameter J ∈ { 0 , 3 , 10 , 20 } J\in\{0,3,10,20\} ms for each topology. Toxiproxy introduces random variations of approximately ± J \pm J around each nonzero configured directional delay.

paragraphs.en: Our primary metrics are mean and p99 end-to-end latency. For each measured read or write, latency is measured from client submission until the client receives sufficient protocol-specific evidence to declare the operation complete. Mean latency averages these measurements, while p99 latency is the value below which 99% of measured operations complete and therefore captures tail performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要指标是平均端到端延迟和 p99 端到端延迟。 对于每次被测量的读或写操作，延迟的计时从客户端提交开始，直到客户端收到足以判定该操作完成的特定协议证据为止。 平均延迟是对这些测量值取平均，而 p99 延迟是指 99% 的被测操作在此值之下完成，因此它能够反映尾部性能。

sents.en: Our primary metrics are mean and p99 end-to-end latency.
sents.zh: 我们的主要指标是平均端到端延迟和 p99 端到端延迟。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 reports mean and p99 latency for each workload, averaged across the six deployments with 5 or 9 replicas. We exclude larger deployments from this average because, at 13 and 17 replicas, saturation of individual baselines dominates it: for example, SwiftPaxos ’s mean latency reaches 516.8 ms with 17 replicas in the uniform topology. Fine-grained results for every algorithm, topology, and workload, including all twelve configurations, are reported in Appendix D , together with the corresponding operation-level read and write latency breakdowns.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 报告了每种工作负载的平均延迟和 p99 延迟，数值为 6 个具有 5 或 9 个副本的部署的平均值。 我们在求平均时排除了规模更大的部署，因为在 13 和 17 个副本时，个别基线的饱和会主导该平均值：例如，在均匀拓扑下，SwiftPaxos 在 17 个副本时的平均延迟达到 516.8 毫秒。 每种算法、拓扑和工作负载（包括全部十二种配置）的细粒度结果见附录 D，其中还给出了相应的操作级读写延迟分解。

sents.zh: 图 5 报告了每种工作负载的平均延迟和 p99 延迟，数值为 6 个具有 5 或 9 个副本的部署的平均值。

paragraphs.en: On workload A (50% writes), A-greement reduces mean latency by 12.2% relative to SwiftPaxos , the alternative with the lowest mean and p99 latency, while its p99 latency is 13.8% higher than that of SwiftPaxos . Notably, the mean read and write latencies of A-greement are 56.5 ms and 145.4 ms, respectively, compared with 115.0 ms and 115.2 ms for SwiftPaxos . Thus, A-greement ’s overall advantage over SwiftPaxos comes from its local-read path, at the cost of slower writes. Bodega also provides fast reads, with a mean read latency of 77.2 ms, but incurs a substantially higher mean write latency of 212.6 ms. These results show that A-greement combines fast local reads with a write path that avoids Bodega ’s substantial write-latency penalty.
paragraphs.zh: 在工作负载 A（50% 写入）上，相对于 SwiftPaxos（即平均延迟和 p99 延迟最低的替代方案），A-greement 将平均延迟降低了 12.2%，但其 p99 延迟比 SwiftPaxos 高出 13.8%。 值得注意的是，A-greement 的平均读延迟和写延迟分别为 56.5 ms 和 145.4 ms，而 SwiftPaxos 则分别为 115.0 ms 和 115.2 ms。 因此，A-greement 相对于 SwiftPaxos 的整体优势来自其本地读路径，代价是写入速度较慢。 Bodega 同样提供了快速读取，平均读延迟为 77.2 ms，但其平均写延迟明显更高，达到 212.6 ms。 这些结果表明，A-greement 将快速本地读取与一条避免 Bodega 显著写延迟代价的写路径结合在了一起。

sents.en: On workload A (50% writes), A-greement reduces mean latency by 12.2% relative to SwiftPaxos , the alternative with the lowest mean and p99 latency, while its p99 latency is 13.8% higher than that of SwiftPaxos .
sents.zh: 在工作负载 A（50% 写入）上，相对于 SwiftPaxos（即平均延迟和 p99 延迟最低的替代方案），A-greement 将平均延迟降低了 12.2%，但其 p99 延迟比 SwiftPaxos 高出 13.8%。

sents.zh: 因此，A-greement 相对于 SwiftPaxos 的整体优势来自其本地读路径，代价是写入速度较慢。

sents.en: Bodega also provides fast reads, with a mean read latency of 77.2 ms, but incurs a substantially higher mean write latency of 212.6 ms.
sents.zh: Bodega 同样提供了快速读取，平均读延迟为 77.2 ms，但其平均写延迟明显更高，达到 212.6 ms。

sents.en: These results show that A-greement combines fast local reads with a write path that avoids Bodega ’s substantial write-latency penalty.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，A-greement 将快速本地读取与一条避免 Bodega 显著写延迟代价的写路径结合在了一起。

paragraphs.en: On workload B (5% writes), it reduces mean and p99 latency by 33.3% and 30.1%, respectively, relative to Bodega , the alternative with the lowest mean latency, while its p99 latency is 3.4% higher than that of SwiftPaxos , the alternative with the lowest p99 latency. As in workload A, the main weakness of Bodega is its write path, for which it spent on average 207.3 ms compared to A-greement ’s 150.5 ms.
paragraphs.zh: 在写入占 5% 的工作负载 B 上，与平均延迟最低的替代方案 Bodega 相比，它分别将平均延迟和 p99 延迟降低了 33.3% 和 30.1%，而其 p99 延迟比 p99 延迟最低的替代方案 SwiftPaxos 高 3.4%。 与工作负载 A 一样，Bodega 的主要弱点在于其写入路径，该路径平均耗时 207.3 ms，而 A-greement 为 150.5 ms。

sents.en: On workload B (5% writes), it reduces mean and p99 latency by 33.3% and 30.1%, respectively, relative to Bodega , the alternative with the lowest mean latency, while its p99 latency is 3.4% higher than that of SwiftPaxos , the alternative with the lowest p99 latency.
sents.zh: 在写入占 5% 的工作负载 B 上，与平均延迟最低的替代方案 Bodega 相比，它分别将平均延迟和 p99 延迟降低了 33.3% 和 30.1%，而其 p99 延迟比 p99 延迟最低的替代方案 SwiftPaxos 高 3.4%。

paragraphs.en: On the read-only workload C, A-greement achieves mean and p99 latencies of 34.0 ms and 56.3 ms, respectively, which is comparable to Bodega , because both protocols use lease-based local reads.
paragraphs.zh: 在只读负载 C 上，A-greement 的平均延迟和 p99 延迟分别为 34.0 ms 和 56.3 ms，与 Bodega 相当，因为这两种协议都使用基于租约的本地读取。

paragraphs.en: The lower bound in Figure 5 is an analytical communication reference computed from the same network topologies. For each client, it assigns reads the minimum direct round-trip latency to any replica and writes the time to collect replies from the fastest majority, allowing shortest paths through replicas. It assumes ideal read freshness and write ordering, and excludes processing, queueing, serialization, bandwidth limits, and jitter.
paragraphs.zh: 图5中的下界是一条基于相同网络拓扑计算得到的解析式通信参考线。 对于每个客户端，它将读操作的延迟设为到任意副本的最小直接往返时延，将写操作的延迟设为从最快多数派收集回复所需的时间，并允许经由副本的最短路径。 该参考假设理想的读新鲜度和写顺序，并排除了处理、排队、序列化、带宽限制和抖动。

sents.zh: 图5中的下界是一条基于相同网络拓扑计算得到的解析式通信参考线。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate recovery with five replicas under workloads A, B, and C across three network topologies. The offered load is 20,000 requests per second. Each run lasts 40 seconds, including an initial five-second warm-up. At 5 seconds, we crash the current leader for protocols with a leader, or a replica for protocols without one. At 20 seconds, we crash one additional replica, prioritizing the latest reported live leader when available and otherwise selecting the surviving replica. The two crashes leave a majority of three replicas. Failed replicas remain stopped for the rest of the run. Figure 6 reports completed requests per second throughout this sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在负载 A、B 和 C 下，跨三种网络拓扑，使用五个副本评估恢复。 提供的负载为每秒 20,000 个请求。 每次运行持续 40 秒，包括最初五秒的预热。 在第 5 秒，对于有领导者的协议，我们使当前领导者崩溃；对于没有领导者的协议，则使某个副本崩溃。 在第 20 秒，我们再使一个额外的副本崩溃，若有可用的最新报告存活领导者则优先选择它，否则选择存活的副本。 这两次崩溃后剩下三个副本构成多数派。 崩溃的副本在本次运行的剩余时间内保持停止状态。 图 6 报告了整个过程中的每秒已完成请求数。

sents.en: We evaluate recovery with five replicas under workloads A, B, and C across three network topologies.
sents.zh: 我们在负载 A、B 和 C 下，跨三种网络拓扑，使用五个副本评估恢复。

sents.en: The offered load is 20,000 requests per second.
sents.zh: 提供的负载为每秒 20,000 个请求。

sents.en: Each run lasts 40 seconds, including an initial five-second warm-up.
sents.zh: 每次运行持续 40 秒，包括最初五秒的预热。

sents.en: At 5 seconds, we crash the current leader for protocols with a leader, or a replica for protocols without one.
sents.zh: 在第 5 秒，对于有领导者的协议，我们使当前领导者崩溃；对于没有领导者的协议，则使某个副本崩溃。

sents.en: At 20 seconds, we crash one additional replica, prioritizing the latest reported live leader when available and otherwise selecting the surviving replica.
sents.zh: 在第 20 秒，我们再使一个额外的副本崩溃，若有可用的最新报告存活领导者则优先选择它，否则选择存活的副本。

sents.en: The two crashes leave a majority of three replicas.
sents.zh: 这两次崩溃后剩下三个副本构成多数派。

sents.en: Failed replicas remain stopped for the rest of the run.
sents.zh: 崩溃的副本在本次运行的剩余时间内保持停止状态。

sents.en: Figure 6 reports completed requests per second throughout this sequence.
sents.zh: 图 6 报告了整个过程中的每秒已完成请求数。

paragraphs.en: Across all nine runs, A-greement experiences a temporary throughput drop after each failure and recovers to at least 90% of its initial failure-free throughput within approximately three seconds. It maintains this level until the next crash or the end of the run. After the second crash, its throughput settles near 20,000 requests per second through the end of the observation window, as do the baselines. The temporary peaks above this rate reflect the completion of requests accumulated during the interruption; they do not indicate a higher sustainable throughput. The curves show that A-greement retains progress with two failed replicas, although it does not consistently recover faster than the other protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 在全部九次运行中，A-greement 在每次故障后都会出现短暂的吞吐量下降，并在大约三秒内恢复到至少初始无故障吞吐量的 90%。 它会一直维持这一水平，直到下一次崩溃或运行结束。 第二次崩溃后，直到观察窗口结束，其吞吐量都稳定在每秒约 20,000 个请求附近，各基线系统也是如此。 高于这一速率的短暂峰值反映的是中断期间积累的请求的完成情况；它们并不代表更高的可持续吞吐量。 这些曲线表明，A-greement 在有两个副本发生故障的情况下仍能保持进展，尽管它并不总是比其他协议恢复得更快。

paragraphs.en: These failures test whether the role assignments used to reduce normal-case latency prevent progress when replicas become unavailable. As described in § 4.5 , recovery replaces failed role holders, preserves potentially chosen writes, and reestablishes read authority. If the per-key write path is active, recovery transfers its retained state into the shared log. The recovered system can therefore continue processing requests using the surviving majority without requiring the original fast-path participants to return.
paragraphs.zh: 这些故障用于测试：在副本不可用时，用于降低正常情况延迟的角色分配是否会阻碍进展。 如 § 4.5 所述，恢复会替换失效的角色持有者，保留可能已被选定的写入，并重建读取权威。 如果每键写入路径处于活动状态，恢复会将其保留的状态迁移到共享日志中。 因此，恢复后的系统可以利用幸存的多数副本继续处理请求，而无需原始快速路径参与者返回。

paragraphs.en: The complete discovery process, including 20 search rounds and formalization and verification of the final protocol, took approximately 24 hours in total. The search rounds consumed 68.14 million tokens across 333 model responses, including 67.83 million input tokens and 0.308 million output tokens. Thus, cumulative token usage largely reflects repeated processing of the accumulated context, rather than newly generated content. Across the complete process, model reasoning accounted for approximately 23 hours. The remaining elapsed time includes output generation, tool execution, explicit waiting, context compaction, and unattributed runtime intervals. Formalization and verification of the final protocol consumed an additional 710.31 million tokens, bringing total usage to approximately 778.45 million. For the stage breakdown in Figure 7 , we attribute this verification usage to iteration 19.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的发现过程，包括20轮搜索以及对最终协议的形式化与验证，总共耗时约24小时。 搜索轮次在333次模型响应中消耗了6814万个token，其中输入token为6783万个，输出token为30.8万个。 因此，累积的token使用量主要反映了对不断累积上下文的重复处理，而非新生成的内容。 在整个过程中，模型推理约占23小时。 其余耗时包括输出生成、工具执行、显式等待、上下文压缩以及未归类的运行时段。 对最终协议的形式化与验证额外消耗了7.1031亿个token，使总使用量达到约7.7845亿。 对于图7中的阶段划分，我们将这部分验证使用量归因于第19次迭代。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 attributes token usage to execution stages. Research and implementation includes literature and code inspection, candidate selection, feasibility analysis, parent-protocol diagnostic experiments, protocol design, coding, compilation, and initial candidate benchmark submission. Performance evaluation covers subsequent monitoring, troubleshooting, and metric analysis; recovery evaluation covers crash-recovery monitoring and analysis. Finalization includes evidence preservation and reporting.
paragraphs.zh: 图7将token使用量归因到各个执行阶段。 研究与实现包括文献和代码审查、候选方案选择、可行性分析、父协议诊断实验、协议设计、编码、编译以及初始候选方案的基准测试提交。 性能评估涵盖后续的监控、故障排查和指标分析；恢复评估涵盖崩溃恢复的监控与分析。 收尾工作包括证据保存和报告撰写。

paragraphs.en: Formalization and verification accounts for 91.25% of the combined token usage. Within the original search, excluding this additional stage as in Figure 7 (b), research and implementation accounts for 46.67%. Performance and recovery evaluation account for 20.78% and 15.60%, respectively. Finalization accounts for 16.28%, and context compaction for 0.67%. Ten iterations produced benchmarked candidate prototypes, while ten were rejected before candidate implementation. Early rejection avoided candidate evaluation, but was not necessarily inexpensive: feasibility assessment could itself require instrumenting and benchmarking a parent protocol.

paragraphs.en: Individual iterations illustrate these costs. Iteration 3 used a parent-protocol diagnostic to establish that the proposed execution-lane change had no observed prefix-blocking delay to remove. Iteration 5 similarly measured an optimistic latency-saving bound below the promotion threshold and rejected the candidate before implementation. Together, these two iterations consumed 7.36 million tokens. Iteration 9 investigated acknowledgment queueing and implemented cumulative prefix certificates, but reduced acknowledgment traffic did not translate into improved client latency. By contrast, iteration 14 combined the rejected iteration 13’s read racing mechanism with per-key completion rules, passed the performance gate and all 27 recovery cases, and became the final promoted version. These results show that discovery cost includes feasibility diagnostics, unsuccessful experiments, and reusable findings from rejected candidates, in addition to implementation of the final design.
paragraphs.zh: 各次迭代的过程说明了这些成本。 第 3 次迭代使用父协议诊断，确认所提议的执行通道变更没有可消除的可观测前缀阻塞延迟。 第 5 次迭代同样测得一个低于晋升阈值的乐观延迟节省上界，并在实现之前否决了该候选方案。 这两次迭代合计消耗了 736 万个 token。 第 9 次迭代研究了确认消息排队问题并实现了累积前缀证书，但确认流量的减少并未转化为客户端延迟的改善。 相比之下，第 14 次迭代将第 13 次迭代被否决的读取竞争机制与逐键完成规则相结合，通过了性能门禁和全部 27 个恢复用例，成为最终晋升的版本。 这些结果表明，发现成本除了最终设计的实现之外，还包括可行性诊断、不成功的实验，以及来自被否决候选方案的可复用发现。

paragraphs.en: While constructing the reference Lean specifications and proofs in § 3.3 , AI-greement uncovered four vulnerabilities in existing consensus protocols that, to the best of our knowledge, were previously unreported. Two affect the optimizations introduced by EPaxos Revisited [ 75 ] : they allow replicas to execute conflicting commands in opposite orders. Two concern Bodega [ 29 ] : its optional early-accept optimization can expose inconsistent values across read paths, while its client-side timeout retries can execute one client write twice. Appendix E details the counterexamples and analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 在构建 § 3.3 中的参考 Lean 规约与证明时，AI-greement 发现了现有共识协议中的四个漏洞，据我们所知，这些漏洞此前均未被报告过。 其中两个影响 EPaxos Revisited [ 75 ] 引入的优化：它们允许副本以相反的顺序执行冲突的命令。 另外两个涉及 Bodega [ 29 ]：其可选的提前接受优化可能在不同的读取路径上暴露出不一致的值，而其客户端超时重试可能将客户端的一次写入执行两次。 附录 E 详细给出了这些反例及相关分析。

sents.en: While constructing the reference Lean specifications and proofs in § 3.3 , AI-greement uncovered four vulnerabilities in existing consensus protocols that, to the best of our knowledge, were previously unreported.
sents.zh: 在构建 § 3.3 中的参考 Lean 规约与证明时，AI-greement 发现了现有共识协议中的四个漏洞，据我们所知，这些漏洞此前均未被报告过。

sents.en: Two affect the optimizations introduced by EPaxos Revisited [ 75 ] : they allow replicas to execute conflicting commands in opposite orders.
sents.zh: 其中两个影响 EPaxos Revisited [ 75 ] 引入的优化：它们允许副本以相反的顺序执行冲突的命令。

sents.en: Two concern Bodega [ 29 ] : its optional early-accept optimization can expose inconsistent values across read paths, while its client-side timeout retries can execute one client write twice.
sents.zh: 另外两个涉及 Bodega [ 29 ]：其可选的提前接受优化可能在不同的读取路径上暴露出不一致的值，而其客户端超时重试可能将客户端的一次写入执行两次。

sents.en: Appendix E details the counterexamples and analysis.
sents.zh: 附录 E 详细给出了这些反例及相关分析。

paragraphs.en: Dependency pruning uses sequence numbers and dependencies to skip commands that appear to execute after the current command. However, preaccepted metadata can change before commitment. A delayed proposal can therefore make a dependency appear safe to prune, allowing one replica to execute commands in an order opposite to another replica’s. The counterexample in § E.1 shows why pruning requires committed or otherwise immutable metadata.
paragraphs.zh: 依赖剪枝使用序列号和依赖关系来跳过那些看起来在当前命令之后执行的命令。 然而，预接受元数据在提交之前可能会发生变化。 因此，一个延迟的提案可能使某个依赖看起来可以被安全地剪枝，从而导致一个智能体以与另一个智能体相反的顺序执行命令。 § E.1 中的反例说明了为什么剪枝需要已提交的或不可变的元数据。

sents.en: Dependency pruning uses sequence numbers and dependencies to skip commands that appear to execute after the current command.
sents.zh: 依赖剪枝使用序列号和依赖关系来跳过那些看起来在当前命令之后执行的命令。

sents.en: However, preaccepted metadata can change before commitment.
sents.zh: 然而，预接受元数据在提交之前可能会发生变化。

sents.en: A delayed proposal can therefore make a dependency appear safe to prune, allowing one replica to execute commands in an order opposite to another replica’s.
sents.zh: 因此，一个延迟的提案可能使某个依赖看起来可以被安全地剪枝，从而导致一个智能体以与另一个智能体相反的顺序执行命令。

sents.en: The counterexample in § E.1 shows why pruning requires committed or otherwise immutable metadata.
sents.zh: § E.1 中的反例说明了为什么剪枝需要已提交的或不可变的元数据。

paragraphs.en: Committed metadata alone is insufficient: skipping a committed node can also hide commands reachable through its dependency branch. One replica can consequently execute a command before an unresolved conflicting dependency, while another preserves the opposite order. § E.2 presents the counterexample.
paragraphs.zh: 仅已提交的元数据并不足够：跳过一个已提交节点也可能隐藏通过其依赖分支可达的命令。 因此，一个副本可能在未解决的冲突依赖之前执行某条命令，而另一个副本则保持相反的顺序。§ E.2 给出了该反例。

sents.en: Committed metadata alone is insufficient: skipping a committed node can also hide commands reachable through its dependency branch.
sents.zh: 仅已提交的元数据并不足够：跳过一个已提交节点也可能隐藏通过其依赖分支可达的命令。

sents.en: One replica can consequently execute a command before an unresolved conflicting dependency, while another preserves the opposite order. § E.2 presents the counterexample.
sents.zh: 因此，一个副本可能在未解决的冲突依赖之前执行某条命令，而另一个副本则保持相反的顺序。§ E.2 给出了该反例。

paragraphs.en: Bodega [ 29 ] ’s early-accept notification allows a responder to return a write after collecting majority accept notifications, while a leader reads only committed state. As mentioned in § E.3 , consider Write ( k , 7 ) (k,7) for an initially absent key. All replicas accept the write, but their acceptance replies to the leader are delayed, so the leader has not committed it or replied to the writing client. A responder nevertheless receives enough accept notifications to return 7 7 to a read. After that read completes, a second read reaches the leader, which returns absence from its unchanged committed state. Returning 7 7 and then absence in two successive reads violates linearizability.
paragraphs.zh: Bodega [29] 的提前接受通知机制允许响应者在收集到多数接受通知后即返回写入，而领导者只读取已提交的状态。 如 §E.3 所述，考虑对一个最初不存在的键执行 Write(k, 7)。 所有副本都接受了该写入，但它们发给领导者的接受回复被延迟，因此领导者尚未提交该写入，也未回复写入的客户端。 然而，某个响应者已收到足够多的接受通知，因而在一次读取中返回 7。 在该读取完成后，第二次读取到达领导者，领导者从其未变化的已提交状态中返回该键不存在。 连续两次读取先返回 7 再返回不存在，违反了线性一致性。

sents.en: Bodega [ 29 ] ’s early-accept notification allows a responder to return a write after collecting majority accept notifications, while a leader reads only committed state.
sents.zh: Bodega [29] 的提前接受通知机制允许响应者在收集到多数接受通知后即返回写入，而领导者只读取已提交的状态。

sents.en: As mentioned in § E.3 , consider Write ( k , 7 ) (k,7) for an initially absent key.
sents.zh: 如 §E.3 所述，考虑对一个最初不存在的键执行 Write(k, 7)。

sents.zh: 所有副本都接受了该写入，但它们发给领导者的接受回复被延迟，因此领导者尚未提交该写入，也未回复写入的客户端。

sents.en: A responder nevertheless receives enough accept notifications to return 7 7 to a read.
sents.zh: 然而，某个响应者已收到足够多的接受通知，因而在一次读取中返回 7。

sents.en: After that read completes, a second read reaches the leader, which returns absence from its unchanged committed state.
sents.zh: 在该读取完成后，第二次读取到达领导者，领导者从其未变化的已提交状态中返回该键不存在。

sents.en: Returning 7 7 and then absence in two successive reads violates linearizability.
sents.zh: 连续两次读取先返回 7 再返回不存在，违反了线性一致性。

paragraphs.en: The client-side timeout retry path in Bodega [ 29 ] ’s implementation assigns a new request identifier to each attempt, so the server can execute the original request and its retry as separate writes. As mentioned in § E.4 , consider a write that sets x = 1 x=1 but whose reply is delayed. Another client reads 1 1 and then completes a write of 2 2 . After a timeout, the original client retries with a new identifier; the retry sets x = 1 x=1 again, and a later read returns 1 1 . If both attempts represent one client write, the first read requires that write to precede the write of 2 2 , so the final read must return 2 2 . This violates linearizability even though replicas agree on the order of the individual requests.
paragraphs.zh: Bodega [ 29 ] 的实现中，客户端超时重试路径会为每次尝试分配一个新的请求标识符，因此服务器可以将原始请求及其重试作为两次独立的写入来执行。 如 § E.4 所述，考虑一次将 x = 1 x=1 设置为 1 的写入，但其应答被延迟了。 另一个客户端读到 1 1，随后完成了一次将 x 设置为 2 2 的写入。 超时之后，原客户端使用新的标识符重试；重试再次将 x = 1 x=1 设置为 1，而之后的读取返回 1 1。 如果这两次尝试代表同一个客户端的写入，那么第一次读取要求该写入发生在对 2 2 的写入之前，因此最后一次读取必须返回 2 2。 即使各个副本对单个请求的顺序达成一致，这仍然违反了线性一致性。

paragraphs.en: Paxos supplies the ballot-and-quorum safety baseline for replicated agreement [ 38 ] . FastPaxos then lets proposers send values directly to acceptors in prepared fast rounds, enabling two-message-delay learning without collisions at the cost of stronger quorum intersection and recovery rules [ 40 ] . Later systems remove different parts of the consensus critical path. Mencius spreads log slots across rotating coordinators [ 48 ] . EPaxos and Atlas use per-command coordination and dependency ordering, and Atlas additionally sizes its fast quorum around a chosen concurrent site-failure budget [ 49 , 20 ] . Rabia uses randomized weak multi-valued consensus to avoid a distinguished leader and separate fail-over protocol [ 58 ] . Later analysis exposed EPaxos ’s tail-latency and recovery subtleties [ 75 ] , while SwiftPaxos reduces the cost of dependency disagreement through leader-including quorums and double voting [ 63 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Paxos 为副本间一致性达成提供了选票与法定人数的安全基线 [ 38 ] 。 FastPaxos 随后允许提议者在已准备的快速轮次中直接向接受者发送值，从而实现两消息延迟的学习，其代价是更强的法定人数相交规则与恢复规则 [ 40 ] 。 后续系统移除了共识关键路径的不同部分。 Mencius 将日志槽位分散给轮换的协调者 [ 48 ] 。 EPaxos 和 Atlas 采用按命令协调与依赖排序，此外 Atlas 还围绕所选定的并发站点故障预算来设定其快速法定人数的大小 [ 49 , 20 ] 。 Rabia 使用随机化的弱多值共识，以避免特殊领导者和单独的故障转移协议 [ 58 ] 。 后续分析揭示了 EPaxos 在尾延迟与恢复方面的微妙问题 [ 75 ] ，而 SwiftPaxos 通过包含领导者的法定人数和双重投票降低了依赖不一致的代价 [ 63 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Other designs change the system boundary or optimize a particular workload. NOPaxos and Hydra move common-case ordering into the network [ 41 , 15 ] . CURP uses witnesses for unordered durability when operations commute [ 59 ] , and Jetpack retrofits a parallel one-RTT path onto compatible consensus protocols [ 72 ] . Copilot tolerates one slow replica by redundantly processing commands at two pilots [ 52 ] . Bodega combines roster leases with responder-covering write quorums for local linearizable reads during interfering writes [ 29 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 其他设计改变了系统边界或针对特定工作负载进行优化。 NOPaxos 和 Hydra 将常见情形下的排序移入网络 [ 41 , 15 ] 。 CURP 在操作可交换时使用见证者实现无序持久化 [ 59 ] ，而 Jetpack 在兼容的共识协议上改造出一条并行的单往返（one-RTT）路径 [ 72 ] 。 Copilot 通过在两个 pilot 上冗余处理命令来容忍一个慢副本 [ 52 ] 。 Bodega 将名册租约与响应覆盖写仲裁相结合，以便在存在相互干扰的写入时实现本地线性一致读 [ 29 ] 。

paragraphs.en: AlphaEvolve combines LLM -driven evolutionary search with automated evaluators to discover improved algorithms [ 54 ] . ADRS studies this approach in systems research, using OpenEvolve [ 67 ] , an open-source framework inspired by AlphaEvolve , for tasks such as spot-instance scheduling, mixture-of-experts load balancing, and transaction scheduling [ 14 ] . Glia instead uses a multi-agent LLM workflow, in which a researcher agent proposes, implements, and evaluates designs in a simulator under a supervisor agent, to design request-routing, scheduling, and autoscaling policies for LLM -serving clusters [ 24 ] . These frameworks optimize isolated policies in which every candidate is valid by construction or checked exactly, and a simulator scores it in seconds. ADRS identifies consensus protocols, whose logic spans state management, communication, and failure handling, as a poor fit for this approach. AI-greement targets this gap, where three challenges arise together: (C1) faster candidates can break safety, (C2) tests cannot establish safety, and (C3) each candidate takes minutes to hours to evaluate. Table 4 and Table 6 in Appendix F compare these approaches and the challenges they face.
paragraphs.zh: AlphaEvolve 将 LLM 驱动的演化搜索与自动化评估器相结合，以发现更优的算法 [54]。 ADRS 在系统研究领域研究了这一方法，使用 OpenEvolve [67]——一个受 AlphaEvolve 启发的开源框架——来完成诸如抢占式实例调度、专家混合负载均衡和事务调度等任务 [14]。 Glia 则采用多智能体 LLM 工作流，其中一个研究员智能体在监督者智能体的管理下在模拟器中提出、实现并评估设计方案，用于为 LLM 服务集群设计请求路由、调度和自动扩缩容策略 [24]。 这些框架优化的是孤立的策略，其中每个候选方案在构造上就是有效的，或可被精确检查，并且模拟器能在几秒内为其打分。 ADRS 指出共识协议——其逻辑横跨状态管理、通信和故障处理——并不适合这种方法。 AI-greement 正是针对这一空白，其中三个挑战同时出现：(C1) 更快的候选方案可能破坏安全性，(C2) 测试无法确立安全性，以及 (C3) 每个候选方案需要几分钟到几小时才能完成评估。 附录 F 中的表 4 和表 6 对这些方法及其所面临的挑战进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: The SkyDiscover framework [ 44 ] , from the authors of ADRS , extends this line from evolving isolated programs to synthesizing complete systems. Its proof-driven mode, IDS [ 2 ] , is the work closest to AI-greement : agents jointly synthesize an implementation and its Rocq proof, use incomplete proofs as a search oracle, and use benchmarks to steer toward efficient designs, producing verified distributed key-value stores for session and causal consistency specifications. IDS , however, starts from a fixed, human-written specification, so performance only ranks candidates that already meet it (sidestepping C1), and its design freedom lies in data layout and proof structure rather than in new protocol mechanisms. Its targets involve neither fault-tolerant agreement nor recovery. AI-greement instead designs new consensus protocols under a performance objective. Conversely, IDS proves the extracted implementation, whereas our Lean proofs cover a protocol model whose correspondence to the prototype is additionally checked by a human consensus expert.
paragraphs.zh: SkyDiscover 框架 [ 44 ] 由 ADRS 的作者提出，将这一路线从演化孤立的程序扩展到合成完整的系统。 其证据驱动模式 IDS [ 2 ] 是与 AI-greement 最接近的工作：智能体共同合成一个实现及其 Rocq 证明，将不完整的证明用作搜索预言机，并利用基准测试引导至高效的设计，为会话一致性与因果一致性规范生成经过验证的分布式键值存储。 然而，IDS 从一个固定的、由人工编写的规范出发，因此性能只是对已经满足该规范的候选方案进行排序（回避了 C1），且其设计自由度在于数据布局与证明结构，而非新的协议机制。 其目标既不涉及容错共识，也不涉及恢复。 AI-greement 则是在性能目标下设计新的共识协议。 反之，IDS 证明的是抽取出的实现，而我们的 Lean 证明覆盖的是一个协议模型，该模型与原型之间的对应关系还需由一位共识专家人工核查。

paragraphs.en: Prior AI work on consensus finds bugs in existing protocols, generates small protocols, or assists human protocol designers. Agora ’s agents inspect Raft , EPaxos , HotStuff , and BullShark codebases, synthesize attacks, and generate executable tests. Agora reports 15 new defects classified as protocol-level logic bugs because the observed executions violate protocol properties [ 45 ] . GGMS learns protocols without an LLM , combining Monte Carlo tree search, a transformer action encoder, and a model checker [ 32 ] . It targets synchronous consensus and atomic commit with crash failures, and verifies candidates by exhaustive model checking for at most four processes. For consensus, it rediscovers FloodSet [ 46 ] . By dropping the performance objective and restricting the search to four processes, it sidesteps C1 and keeps evaluation cheap (C3), but its guarantees do not extend beyond the checked instance sizes. An LLM also substantially assisted the design and proofs of a communication-efficient Byzantine broadcast protocol [ 19 ] . There, however, humans drive an interactive collaboration toward an asymptotic bound established by pen-and-paper proof; no candidate is implemented or measured, so C3 does not arise and safety checking (C2) rests on the authors. AI-greement instead faces all three challenges: it designs protocols under a latency objective and evaluates them on deployments of up to 17 replicas.
paragraphs.zh: 先前关于共识的 AI 研究要么在现有协议中发现缺陷，要么生成小型协议，要么辅助人类协议设计者。 Agora 的智能体检查 Raft、EPaxos、HotStuff 和 BullShark 的代码库，综合出攻击，并生成可执行的测试。 Agora 报告了 15 个新缺陷，由于观察到的执行违反了协议性质 [45]，这些缺陷被归类为协议级逻辑缺陷。 GGMS 在不使用大语言模型的情况下学习协议，它结合了蒙特卡洛树搜索、一个 transformer 动作编码器和一个模型检测器 [32]。 它针对具有崩溃故障的同步共识与原子提交，并通过最多四个进程的穷举模型检测来验证候选协议。 对于共识，它重新发现了 FloodSet [46]。 通过舍弃性能目标并将搜索限制在四个进程，它规避了 C1 并保持评估的低成本 (C3)，但其保证无法扩展到被检测实例规模之外。 一个大语言模型也在设计一个通信高效的拜占庭广播协议及其证明方面提供了实质性协助 [19]。 然而，在那里，人类驱动交互式协作以达成由纸笔证明确立的渐近界；没有候选协议被实现或测量，因此 C3 不会出现，而安全检查 (C2) 依赖于作者本人。 AI-greement 则要面对全部三项挑战：它在时延目标下设计协议，并在多达 17 个副本的部署上对其进行评估。

sents.en: There, however, humans drive an interactive collaboration toward an asymptotic bound established by pen-and-paper proof; no candidate is implemented or measured, so C3 does not arise and safety checking (C2) rests on the authors.

sents.en: AI-greement instead faces all three challenges: it designs protocols under a latency objective and evaluates them on deployments of up to 17 replicas.
sents.zh: AI-greement 则要面对全部三项挑战：它在时延目标下设计协议，并在多达 17 个副本的部署上对其进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Our answer is no; this is just a new beginning. We believe this work marks a turning point in how consensus research is conducted. The low latency achieved might still be decreased in specific situations we did not focus on. More generally, our consensus solution could be extended to other failure models and settings. Our results show that AI agents can take on substantial parts of the research process, including retrieving protocol knowledge, designing and implementing candidates, as well as constructing formal arguments and counterexamples. Human expertise, however, remains essential for defining performance objectives and safety requirements, designing evaluation environments, and reviewing agent behavior and research outcomes. A crucial question therefore is: how do our results reshape the role of consensus researchers?
paragraphs.zh: 我们的回答是否定的；这只是一个新的开端。 我们相信这项工作标志着共识研究开展方式的转折点。 我们所实现的低延迟在某些我们未重点关注的特定场景下或许还能进一步降低。 更一般地说，我们的共识方案可以扩展到其他故障模型和环境。 我们的结果表明，AI智能体能够承担研究过程中的大量工作，包括检索协议知识、设计和实现候选方案，以及构建形式化论证和反例。 然而，人类的专业知识对于定义性能目标与安全需求、设计评估环境，以及审查智能体行为和研究成果仍然不可或缺。 因此，一个关键问题是：我们的结果将如何重塑共识研究者的角色？

paragraphs.en: From our experiences, we found that human judgment was needed before, during, and after the agentic search.
paragraphs.zh: 根据我们的经验，我们发现智能体搜索之前、期间和之后都需要人工判断。

paragraphs.en: Human expertise is required before the quest starts. Researchers need to develop the agent harness by checking the protocol knowledge base, defining the implementation interfaces, and choosing the fault model, correctness properties, performance objectives, and evaluation conditions ( § 3 ). Although an agent drafted the knowledge-base notes, we verified them against the source papers and corrected errors. This preparation determines which designs the agent can express and what its feedback measures.
paragraphs.zh: 在探索开始之前需要人类的专业知识。 研究人员需要通过查阅协议知识库、定义实现接口，以及选择故障模型、正确性属性、性能目标和评估条件（§ 3）来开发智能体框架。 尽管知识库笔记由一个智能体起草，我们仍对照原始论文进行了核实并纠正了错误。 这项准备工作决定了智能体能够表达哪些设计，以及其反馈所衡量的是什么。

paragraphs.en: Inspecting an agentic run while it is in progress allows researchers to steer the agent early and avoids restarting a long run that wastes many tokens. Giving the agent an explicit budget, such as a fixed amount of time to search for a new candidate, can reduce the need for such manual checks.
paragraphs.zh: 在智能体运行过程中对其进行检查，可以让研究人员及早引导智能体，避免重启一次耗时漫长、浪费大量 token 的运行。 给智能体设定明确的预算，例如固定的寻找新候选方案的时间，可以减少此类人工检查的需要。

paragraphs.en: Human review remains necessary when interpreting improvements. As described in § 6 , the agent duplicated requests over two TCP connections to the same destination to exploit independently sampled network jitter. The resulting latency reduction reflected an opportunity in the benchmark’s delay model, and we removed the mechanism before the final evaluation. A separate test set helps expose overfitting, but shared assumptions in the development and test environments can still reward such shortcuts. Researchers must therefore examine both candidate protocols and their evaluation environments to reduce the risk of reward hacking.
paragraphs.zh: 在解读性能提升时，人工审查仍然必不可少。 如第 6 节所述，该智能体通过两条到同一目的地的 TCP 连接重复发送请求，以利用独立采样的网络抖动。 由此产生的延迟降低反映的是基准测试延迟模型中的一个漏洞，我们在最终评估前移除了该机制。 独立的测试集有助于暴露过拟合，但开发环境与测试环境中共享的假设仍可能使此类捷径获得奖励。 因此，研究人员必须同时审查候选协议及其评估环境，以降低奖励作弊的风险。

paragraphs.en: Human review can also expose inefficiencies that the agent’s own tuning left in place. In A-greement ’s batching ( § 5.1 ), the leader cuts a batch into log entries in arrival order. This couples some writes to the slower completion of a hot key and fragments batches when completion owners alternate. Grouping each batch by completion owner would remove both inefficiencies and is safe, but the agent chose not to do it. Moreover, upon a ballot change A-greement does not restore the cold quorum ( § 4.5 ), moving all write-related actions to the common log, essentially sacrificing a part of its optimization for no reason. We did not fix either of these inefficiencies, so that the evaluated protocol stays as close as possible to the agent’s design, with only correctness-critical fixes.
paragraphs.zh: 人工审查还能发现智能体自身的调优所遗留的低效之处。 在 A-greement 的批处理（§ 5.1）中，领导者按照到达顺序将一个批次切分为日志条目。 这使得部分写操作与某个热键较慢的完成相耦合，并在完成所有者交替时使批次碎片化。 按完成所有者对每个批次进行分组可以消除这两种低效，并且是安全的，但智能体选择不这样做。 此外，在选票变更时，A-greement 不会恢复冷仲裁（§ 4.5），而是将所有与写相关的操作转移到公共日志中，等于无缘无故地牺牲了其优化的一部分。 我们没有修复这两种低效，以便被评估的协议尽可能贴近智能体的设计，只保留涉及正确性的关键修复。

paragraphs.en: Human review is also necessary for formal verification. Lean checks proofs against the encoded specification; researchers must check that this specification faithfully captures the protocol and its implementation. In our experience, formalizing a protocol from pseudocode presents substantially different challenges from formalizing it from implementation code. The discovery loop could generate an implementation first and then formalize its behavior, or develop both the implementation and the formal specification from shared pseudocode. Which approach produces more faithful specifications with less human intervention remains an open question.
paragraphs.zh: 人工审查对于形式化验证同样是必要的。 Lean 会依据编码后的规范来检查证明；研究人员必须检查该规范是否忠实地刻画了协议及其实现。 根据我们的经验，从伪代码形式化协议与从实现代码形式化协议所面临的挑战有很大不同。 发现循环可以先生成一个实现，然后再将其行为形式化；也可以基于共享的伪代码同时开发实现和形式化规范。 哪种方法能在更少人工干预的情况下产生更忠实的规范，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。

paragraphs.en: As agents take on more research tasks, we believe that human researchers retain three central responsibilities. First, they must define meaningful problems and translate practical requirements into explicit research objectives. This includes deciding which workloads and deployment conditions matter, what safety and availability guarantees are required, and how to prioritize latency, throughput, and resource costs. These decisions give the agent a concrete target and determine which tradeoffs are acceptable. Second, they must test and review agent outputs, which may still contain hallucinations, implementation errors, or unsupported conclusions. Generated code, explanations, and experimental reports require independent scrutiny before they can support a research claim. Researchers must assess whether the evidence justifies the claimed improvement, investigate failures and unexpected behavior, and determine how broadly the conclusions apply. Third, they remain important for proposing new ideas and opening directions beyond the current search. The search reported here primarily combined and adapted known mechanisms, showing how agents can explore combinations that are costly to investigate manually. Human researchers can contribute new abstractions, question assumptions inherited from existing protocols, and formulate hypotheses that expand the design space. Agents can then help develop these ideas into protocols, construct implementations and proofs, and evaluate their consequences, allowing researchers to pursue more alternatives and refine the ideas using concrete evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 随着智能体承担越来越多的研究任务，我们认为人类研究者仍保留三项核心职责。 首先，他们必须定义有意义的问题，并将实际需求转化为明确的研究目标。 这包括决定哪些工作负载和部署条件是重要的、需要什么样的安全性和可用性保证，以及如何在延迟、吞吐量和资源成本之间排定优先级。 这些决定为智能体提供了具体的目标，并确定哪些权衡是可以接受的。 其次，他们必须测试和审查智能体的输出，这些输出仍可能包含幻觉、实现错误或缺乏依据的结论。 生成的代码、解释和实验报告在能够支撑某个研究结论之前，都需要经过独立的审查。 研究者必须评估证据是否足以证明所声称的改进，调查失败和意外行为，并确定结论适用的范围有多广。 第三，他们在提出新想法和开拓当前搜索之外的方向方面仍然很重要。 本文报告的搜索主要是组合和改造已知的机制，展示了智能体如何探索那些人工研究代价高昂的组合。 人类研究者可以贡献新的抽象，质疑从现有协议继承下来的假设，并提出扩展设计空间的假设。 智能体随后可以帮助把这些想法发展为协议，构建实现和证明，并评估其后果，从而让研究者能够探索更多备选方案，并依据具体证据来完善这些想法。

The first two paths share log state and recovery. We specify their different completion and read-visibility rules explicitly. Message names below describe logical actions; transport framing, compression, and retransmission do not change the evidence required by a handler.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录规定 § 4 中引入的三条写入路径：在指定副本处完成、客户端直接从普通日志学习、以及客户端直接从冷态按键历史学习。 前两条路径共享日志状态与恢复机制。 我们明确规定了它们各自不同的完成规则与读取可见性规则。 下文的消息名称描述的是逻辑动作；传输封装、压缩与重传不会改变处理程序所需的证据。

paragraphs.en: A request c c contains an identifier id ⁡ ( c ) \operatorname{id}(c) , its operation, key, and original payload. Retries preserve this identity and command body. An ordinary request also retains its designated reply replica. This identity is needed to determine whether the completion owner controls the request’s reply. paragraphs.en: Local reads require an installed roster and a majority of unexpired lease grants whose catch-up thresholds the responder has executed. Self-grants count only when the local threshold is met. A leader must additionally have completed ordinary preparation. Grantor and holder deadlines include a conservative clock-drift margin; delayed renewal replies cannot restore a revoked ballot. Before replacing conflicting read authority, grantors revoke the old grants and receive acknowledgments, or wait until the grants expire. Failure suspicion starts this process but cannot replace it. Cold readers also require the installed generation to equal the promised generation and the key to be ready.
paragraphs.zh: 本地读需要已安装的花名册，以及多数未过期的租约授权，且响应者已执行这些授权的追赶阈值。 只有满足本地阈值时，自我授权才计数。 领导者还必须完成常规准备。 授权者和持有者的期限都包含保守的时钟漂移余量；延迟的续约回复无法恢复已被撤销的投票。 在替换冲突的读权限之前，授权者会撤销旧授权并收到确认，或者等待授权过期。 故障怀疑会启动此流程，但不能替代此流程。 冷读取者还要求已安装的世代等于承诺的世代，并且键已就绪。

paragraphs.en: Let η \eta be the measured hot boundary and τ ≥ η \tau\geq\eta the selected cold boundary, defined in § A.7 . Under the reference policy, fresh ordinary writes to observed ranks below η \eta complete through their reply destination after execution; ranks at or above η \eta are eligible for direct certificates unless routed to the cold path. The alternative policy enables direct certificates for all ordinary keys, including hot and unobserved keys. Unobserved keys never enter the cold path. Recovered entries are ineligible for early ordinary completion, and bridge acceptance disables new early votes. Thus heat classification, completion-owner placement, and certificate eligibility are related planning decisions, not interchangeable definitions.
