paragraphs.en: This condition identifies a possible old fast choice, not a new certificate. Because | P | = | Q b 0 | = m |P|=|Q_{b_{0}}|=m and | R | = 2 ​ f + 1 |R|=2f+1 , the intersection is nonempty. Any value previously accepted by all of Q b 0 Q_{b_{0}} must appear at every member of this intersection, provided each promise is complete. A missing acceptance in a complete snapshot rules out that candidate; a missing snapshot or body does not. Recovery uses the identities of intersecting replicas, not just a count of matching reports. If no value could have been fast-chosen, the coordinator deterministically selects a retained original input and leaves others pending. It records recovered prefixes, selected tails, and body references in a manifest that remains immutable for generation G ′ G^{\prime} . Missing bodies must be fetched from original holders; their absence cannot justify discarding a possible choice.
paragraphs.zh: 该条件识别的是一种可能的旧快速选择，而不是新的证书。 因为 | P | = | Q b 0 | = m |P|=|Q_{b_{0}}|=m 且 | R | = 2 ​ f + 1 |R|=2f+1，所以该交集非空。 只要每个承诺都是完整的，之前被 Q b 0 Q_{b_{0}} 全体接受过的任何值都必须出现在该交集的每个成员上。 在完整快照中缺失的接受记录会排除该候选值；而缺失快照或正文则不会。 恢复使用的是相交副本的标识，而不仅仅是匹配报告的数量。 如果没有任何值可能被快速选择，协调者会确定性地选择一个保留的原始输入，并让其他输入保持待定。 它在一个清单中记录恢复的前缀、已选的尾部和正文引用，该清单对于世代 G ′ G^{\prime} 保持不可变。 缺失的正文必须从原始持有者处获取；其缺失不能成为丢弃一个可能选择的理由。

sents.en: This condition identifies a possible old fast choice, not a new certificate.
sents.zh: 该条件识别的是一种可能的旧快速选择，而不是新的证书。

sents.en: Because | P | = | Q b 0 | = m |P|=|Q_{b_{0}}|=m and | R | = 2 ​ f + 1 |R|=2f+1 , the intersection is nonempty.
Any value previously accepted by all of Q b 0 Q_{b_{0}} must appear at every member of this intersection, provided each promise is complete.
sents.zh: 只要每个承诺都是完整的，之前被 Q b 0 Q_{b_{0}} 全体接受过的任何值都必须出现在该交集的每个成员上。

sents.en: A missing acceptance in a complete snapshot rules out that candidate; a missing snapshot or body does not.
sents.zh: 在完整快照中缺失的接受记录会排除该候选值；而缺失快照或正文则不会。

sents.en: Recovery uses the identities of intersecting replicas, not just a count of matching reports.
sents.zh: 恢复使用的是相交副本的标识，而不仅仅是匹配报告的数量。

sents.en: If no value could have been fast-chosen, the coordinator deterministically selects a retained original input and leaves others pending.
sents.zh: 如果没有任何值可能被快速选择，协调者会确定性地选择一个保留的原始输入，并让其他输入保持待定。

sents.en: It records recovered prefixes, selected tails, and body references in a manifest that remains immutable for generation G ′ G^{\prime} .
sents.zh: 它在一个清单中记录恢复的前缀、已选的尾部和正文引用，该清单对于世代 G ′ G^{\prime} 保持不可变。

sents.en: Missing bodies must be fetched from original holders; their absence cannot justify discarding a possible choice.
sents.zh: 缺失的正文必须从原始持有者处获取；其缺失不能成为丢弃一个可能选择的理由。

paragraphs.en: The frozen manifest M = ( G ′ , Q b ′ , … ) M=(G^{\prime},Q_{b^{\prime}},\ldots) records recovered prefixes, chosen identifiers, and selected classic tails. Together, these form the foundation state to be transferred into the ordinary log. The coordinator broadcasts M M and H ⁡ ( M ) H(M) in BulkAccept . Each BulkVote requires a matching promise, local retention of every referenced body, installation of valid chosen-prefix evidence, and acceptance of every selected tail. Matching voters V M V_{M} must satisfy | V M | ≥ m |V_{M}|\geq m and Q b ′ ⊆ V M Q_{b^{\prime}}\subseteq V_{M} ; Q b ′ Q_{b^{\prime}} is selected from complete promise respondents. BulkCommit certifies the tails for per-key application. Replicas acknowledge application with BulkApplied . All of Q b ′ Q_{b^{\prime}} and the coordinator must finish application; Ready replies from all of Q b ′ Q_{b^{\prime}} confirm installation before the log transition is proposed. Bulk recovery shares evidence transfer across keys.
paragraphs.zh: 冻结的清单 M = ( G ′ , Q b ′ , … ) 记录了已恢复的前缀、选定的标识符以及挑选出的经典尾缀。 这些共同构成了要迁移到普通日志中的基础状态。 协调者在 BulkAccept 中广播 M 和 H(M)。 每个 BulkVote 都要求有匹配的承诺、对每个被引用主体的本地保留、对有效选定前缀证据的安装，以及对每个选定尾缀的接受。 匹配的投票者 V_M 必须满足 |V_M| ≥ m 且 Q_{b′} ⊆ V_M；Q_{b′} 从完整的承诺响应者中选出。 BulkCommit 为按键应用认证这些尾缀。 副本通过 BulkApplied 确认应用完成。 所有 Q_{b′} 与协调者都必须完成应用；在提议日志转换之前，来自全部 Q_{b′} 的 Ready 应答确认安装完成。 批量恢复在多个键之间共享证据传输。

sents.en: The frozen manifest M = ( G ′ , Q b ′ , … ) M=(G^{\prime},Q_{b^{\prime}},\ldots) records recovered prefixes, chosen identifiers, and selected classic tails.
sents.zh: 冻结的清单 M = ( G ′ , Q b ′ , … ) 记录了已恢复的前缀、选定的标识符以及挑选出的经典尾缀。

sents.en: Together, these form the foundation state to be transferred into the ordinary log.
sents.zh: 这些共同构成了要迁移到普通日志中的基础状态。

sents.en: The coordinator broadcasts M M and H ⁡ ( M ) H(M) in BulkAccept .
sents.zh: 协调者在 BulkAccept 中广播 M 和 H(M)。

sents.en: Each BulkVote requires a matching promise, local retention of every referenced body, installation of valid chosen-prefix evidence, and acceptance of every selected tail.
sents.zh: 每个 BulkVote 都要求有匹配的承诺、对每个被引用主体的本地保留、对有效选定前缀证据的安装，以及对每个选定尾缀的接受。

sents.en: Matching voters V M V_{M} must satisfy | V M | ≥ m |V_{M}|\geq m and Q b ′ ⊆ V M Q_{b^{\prime}}\subseteq V_{M} ; Q b ′ Q_{b^{\prime}} is selected from complete promise respondents.
sents.zh: 匹配的投票者 V_M 必须满足 |V_M| ≥ m 且 Q_{b′} ⊆ V_M；Q_{b′} 从完整的承诺响应者中选出。

sents.en: BulkCommit certifies the tails for per-key application.
sents.zh: BulkCommit 为按键应用认证这些尾缀。

sents.en: Replicas acknowledge application with BulkApplied .
sents.zh: 副本通过 BulkApplied 确认应用完成。

sents.en: All of Q b ′ Q_{b^{\prime}} and the coordinator must finish application; Ready replies from all of Q b ′ Q_{b^{\prime}} confirm installation before the log transition is proposed.
sents.zh: 所有 Q_{b′} 与协调者都必须完成应用；在提议日志转换之前，来自全部 Q_{b′} 的 Ready 应答确认安装完成。

sents.en: Bulk recovery shares evidence transfer across keys.
sents.zh: 批量恢复在多个键之间共享证据传输。

paragraphs.en: Handoff permanently moves cold keys to the ordinary log. To bind this transition to the recovered foundation, the coordinator proposes a bridge entry
paragraphs.zh: 移交（Handoff）会将冷键永久移动到普通日志中。 为了将此转换绑定到已恢复的基础上，协调者提议一条桥接条目。

sents.en: Handoff permanently moves cold keys to the ordinary log.
sents.zh: 移交（Handoff）会将冷键永久移动到普通日志中。

sents.en: To bind this transition to the recovered foundation, the coordinator proposes a bridge entry
sents.zh: 为了将此转换绑定到已恢复的基础上，协调者提议一条桥接条目。

paragraphs.en: The bridge has an internal identifier and no client response. Ordinary Paxos phase one and choice preserve its exact metadata. Accepting it votes for the foundation entry without re-accepting referenced user writes. Bulk voters retain the bound bodies, with a survivor after at most f f crashes.
paragraphs.zh: 该桥接项具有一个内部标识符，且没有客户端响应。 普通Paxos第一阶段和选定操作会完整保留其元数据。 接受该项即为对基础条目投票，而无需重新接受其引用的用户写入。 批量投票者保留绑定的主体，在最多f次崩溃后仍有一个存留项。

sents.en: The bridge has an internal identifier and no client response.
sents.zh: 该桥接项具有一个内部标识符，且没有客户端响应。

sents.en: Ordinary Paxos phase one and choice preserve its exact metadata.
sents.zh: 普通Paxos第一阶段和选定操作会完整保留其元数据。

sents.en: Accepting it votes for the foundation entry without re-accepting referenced user writes.
sents.zh: 接受该项即为对基础条目投票，而无需重新接受其引用的用户写入。

sents.en: Bulk voters retain the bound bodies, with a survivor after at most f f crashes.
sents.zh: 批量投票者保留绑定的主体，在最多f次崩溃后仍有一个存留项。

paragraphs.en: A replica cannot execute past F F until it validates the foundation and obtains all hash-checked bodies. Executing F F installs recovered cold state, imports chosen identifiers into ordinary deduplication, and atomically marks the replica migrated. Installation occurs once, preventing replay from overwriting later writes with an old foundation. Local bridge acceptance, mode hints, and body receipt cannot authorize migration.
paragraphs.zh: 副本在验证基础并获取所有经哈希校验的正文之前，不能执行超过 F F。 执行 F F 会安装恢复的冷状态，将选定的标识符导入普通去重，并原子性地将该副本标记为已迁移。 安装只发生一次，从而防止重放用旧的基础覆盖后续的写入。 本地桥接接受、模式提示和正文接收都不能授权迁移。

sents.en: A replica cannot execute past F F until it validates the foundation and obtains all hash-checked bodies.
sents.zh: 副本在验证基础并获取所有经哈希校验的正文之前，不能执行超过 F F。

sents.en: Executing F F installs recovered cold state, imports chosen identifiers into ordinary deduplication, and atomically marks the replica migrated.
sents.zh: 执行 F F 会安装恢复的冷状态，将选定的标识符导入普通去重，并原子性地将该副本标记为已迁移。

sents.en: Installation occurs once, preventing replay from overwriting later writes with an old foundation.
sents.zh: 安装只发生一次，从而防止重放用旧的基础覆盖后续的写入。

sents.en: Local bridge acceptance, mode hints, and body receipt cannot authorize migration.
sents.zh: 本地桥接接受、模式提示和正文接收都不能授权迁移。

paragraphs.en: After migration, all keys use the ordinary log in strict-prefix mode: reads wait for their relevant slot to execute, and write replies require actual execution. Direct acceptance certificates and cold admission stay disabled. Stale cold requests retain their identities when rerouted to the log. Stale control and proof messages cannot alter migrated state. Historical bodies support reconstruction but grant no authority.
paragraphs.zh: 迁移完成后，所有密钥在严格前缀模式下使用普通日志：读取会等待其相关槽位执行，写入回复需要实际执行。 直接接受证书和冷准入保持禁用状态。 过期的冷请求在被重定向到日志时保留其身份。 过期的控制和证明消息无法更改已迁移的状态。 历史消息体支持重建但不授予权限。

sents.en: After migration, all keys use the ordinary log in strict-prefix mode: reads wait for their relevant slot to execute, and write replies require actual execution.
sents.zh: 迁移完成后，所有密钥在严格前缀模式下使用普通日志：读取会等待其相关槽位执行，写入回复需要实际执行。

sents.en: Direct acceptance certificates and cold admission stay disabled.
sents.zh: 直接接受证书和冷准入保持禁用状态。

sents.en: Stale cold requests retain their identities when rerouted to the log.
sents.zh: 过期的冷请求在被重定向到日志时保留其身份。

sents.en: Stale control and proof messages cannot alter migrated state.
sents.zh: 过期的控制和证明消息无法更改已迁移的状态。

sents.en: Historical bodies support reconstruction but grant no authority.
sents.zh: 历史消息体支持重建但不授予权限。

paragraphs.en: Later leaders run ordinary phase one, preserve selected bridges, and resume prefix replay and body fetching without starting a separate cold history. A locally accepted but unselected bridge awaits phase-one resolution; acceptance alone cannot establish handoff. After migration, failures use ordinary-log and roster recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 后续领导者执行普通的一阶段，保留被选定的桥接，并恢复前缀重放与正文获取，而无需启动单独的冷历史。 已被本地接受但未被选定的桥接等待一阶段裁决；仅被接受不足以确立交接。 迁移完成后，故障处理使用普通日志与成员名册恢复。

sents.en: Later leaders run ordinary phase one, preserve selected bridges, and resume prefix replay and body fetching without starting a separate cold history.
sents.zh: 后续领导者执行普通的一阶段，保留被选定的桥接，并恢复前缀重放与正文获取，而无需启动单独的冷历史。

sents.en: A locally accepted but unselected bridge awaits phase-one resolution; acceptance alone cannot establish handoff.
sents.zh: 已被本地接受但未被选定的桥接等待一阶段裁决；仅被接受不足以确立交接。

sents.en: After migration, failures use ordinary-log and roster recovery.
sents.zh: 迁移完成后，故障处理使用普通日志与成员名册恢复。

paragraphs.en: Both ordering mechanisms retain full commands at replicas before voting. If a client fails before disseminating a proof, phase one preserves possibly chosen values from acceptance records; proof absence cannot rule out a choice.
paragraphs.zh: 两种排序机制都会在副本上完整保留命令，然后再进行投票。 如果客户端在传播证明之前发生故障，第一阶段会从接受记录中保留可能已被选定的值；证明缺失不能排除值被选定的可能。

sents.en: Both ordering mechanisms retain full commands at replicas before voting.
sents.zh: 两种排序机制都会在副本上完整保留命令，然后再进行投票。

sents.en: If a client fails before disseminating a proof, phase one preserves possibly chosen values from acceptance records; proof absence cannot rule out a choice.
sents.zh: 如果客户端在传播证明之前发生故障，第一阶段会从接受记录中保留可能已被选定的值；证明缺失不能排除值被选定的可能。

paragraphs.en: Ordinary writes can continue after nonmandatory replica failures if a majority and all required responders survive. Losing an ordinary read responder or a member of Q b Q_{b} requires a higher roster ballot, even with a live leader. Old leases are fenced and replacement responders catch up before activation. The cold plane uses the recovery and handoff in § A.3 ; its fast quorum stays fixed throughout ballot b b , including changes of key round.
paragraphs.zh: 在发生非强制副本故障时，只要多数派和所有必需的响应者仍存活，普通写入就可以继续进行。 失去一个普通读取响应者或 Q b Q_{b} 的成员需要更高的名册选票（roster ballot），即使领导者仍然存活。 旧租约会被隔离，替代响应者在激活之前完成追赶。 冷平面使用 § A.3 中的恢复与交接机制；其快速法定人数在整个选票 b b 期间保持不变，包括密钥轮次的变化。

sents.en: Ordinary writes can continue after nonmandatory replica failures if a majority and all required responders survive.
sents.zh: 在发生非强制副本故障时，只要多数派和所有必需的响应者仍存活，普通写入就可以继续进行。

sents.en: Losing an ordinary read responder or a member of Q b Q_{b} requires a higher roster ballot, even with a live leader.
sents.zh: 失去一个普通读取响应者或 Q b Q_{b} 的成员需要更高的名册选票（roster ballot），即使领导者仍然存活。

sents.en: Old leases are fenced and replacement responders catch up before activation.
sents.zh: 旧租约会被隔离，替代响应者在激活之前完成追赶。

sents.en: The cold plane uses the recovery and handoff in § A.3 ; its fast quorum stays fixed throughout ballot b b , including changes of key round.
sents.zh: 冷平面使用 § A.3 中的恢复与交接机制；其快速法定人数在整个选票 b b 期间保持不变，包括密钥轮次的变化。

paragraphs.en: Replicas fetch hash-bound bodies and predecessor proofs from original holders. Transfers are idempotent and confer no vote or read authority. ColdDone requires the original command’s chosen evidence and, after migration, ordinary prefix execution. Retries retain original identifiers and complete at most once. Eligible writes may complete through certificates; executed replies require prefix execution at the planned completion replica.
paragraphs.zh: 副本从原始持有者处获取哈希绑定的主体和前驱证明。 转移是幂等的，且不授予任何投票权或读取权。 ColdDone 需要原始命令所选定的证据，并且在迁移之后，还需要普通的前缀执行。 重试保留原始标识符，且至多完成一次。 符合条件的写入可通过证书完成；已执行的回复需要在计划完成的副本处进行前缀执行。

sents.en: Replicas fetch hash-bound bodies and predecessor proofs from original holders.
sents.zh: 副本从原始持有者处获取哈希绑定的主体和前驱证明。

sents.en: Transfers are idempotent and confer no vote or read authority.
sents.zh: 转移是幂等的，且不授予任何投票权或读取权。

sents.en: ColdDone requires the original command’s chosen evidence and, after migration, ordinary prefix execution.
sents.zh: ColdDone 需要原始命令所选定的证据，并且在迁移之后，还需要普通的前缀执行。

sents.en: Retries retain original identifiers and complete at most once.
sents.zh: 重试保留原始标识符，且至多完成一次。

sents.en: Eligible writes may complete through certificates; executed replies require prefix execution at the planned completion replica.
sents.zh: 符合条件的写入可通过证书完成；已执行的回复需要在计划完成的副本处进行前缀执行。

paragraphs.en: Ordinary certificates shorten evidence delivery to clients; the leader still orders commands. The cold path also removes this ordering hop for enabled, uncontended per-key instances. Both certificate paths require recoverable acceptance certificates before write completion. Write acknowledgements need no speculative execution of unchosen commands. Read results require valid read visibility.
paragraphs.zh: 普通证书可缩短向客户端交付证据的时间；领导者仍然对命令进行排序。 对于已启用且无竞争的按键实例，冷路径还消除了这一排序环节。 两条证书路径都要求在写入完成前具备可恢复的接受证书。 写入确认无需对未被选定的命令进行投机执行。 读取结果需要有效的读取可见性。

sents.en: Ordinary certificates shorten evidence delivery to clients; the leader still orders commands.
sents.zh: 普通证书可缩短向客户端交付证据的时间；领导者仍然对命令进行排序。

sents.en: The cold path also removes this ordering hop for enabled, uncontended per-key instances.
sents.zh: 对于已启用且无竞争的按键实例，冷路径还消除了这一排序环节。

sents.en: Both certificate paths require recoverable acceptance certificates before write completion.
sents.zh: 两条证书路径都要求在写入完成前具备可恢复的接受证书。

sents.en: Write acknowledgements need no speculative execution of unchosen commands.
sents.zh: 写入确认无需对未被选定的命令进行投机执行。

sents.en: Read results require valid read visibility.
sents.zh: 读取结果需要有效的读取可见性。

paragraphs.en: Normal-mode reads beyond the applied prefix use chosen key values under the freshness, fixed-prefix, and lease conditions in § A.2 , without speculative suffix execution. Broader certificate eligibility can hold more reads behind accepted writes that may already have completed elsewhere. Read races preserve visibility checks, so placement accounts for write-evidence delivery and read waiting.
paragraphs.zh: 在正常模式下，超出已应用前缀的读取在满足 § A.2 中的新鲜性、固定前缀与租约条件时使用所选的键值，且不进行投机性的后缀执行。 更宽泛的证书资格可能使更多的读取操作落后于那些可能已在别处完成的、已被接受的写入。 读取竞争保留了可见性检查，因此放置策略需要考虑写入证据的传递和读取的等待。

sents.en: Normal-mode reads beyond the applied prefix use chosen key values under the freshness, fixed-prefix, and lease conditions in § A.2 , without speculative suffix execution.
sents.zh: 在正常模式下，超出已应用前缀的读取在满足 § A.2 中的新鲜性、固定前缀与租约条件时使用所选的键值，且不进行投机性的后缀执行。

sents.en: Broader certificate eligibility can hold more reads behind accepted writes that may already have completed elsewhere.
sents.zh: 更宽泛的证书资格可能使更多的读取操作落后于那些可能已在别处完成的、已被接受的写入。

sents.en: Read races preserve visibility checks, so placement accounts for write-evidence delivery and read waiting.
sents.zh: 读取竞争保留了可见性检查，因此放置策略需要考虑写入证据的传递和读取的等待。

paragraphs.en: Bridge acceptance disables early client votes; ordered application installs the foundation and permanently enables strict-prefix execution. Reads cannot pass an unapplied bridge, and later writes cannot combine cold votes with ordinary acceptances. Later operations follow one recovered foundation and one ordinary executed prefix.
paragraphs.zh: 桥接接受会禁用早期的客户端投票；按序应用会安装基础（foundation）并永久启用严格前缀执行。 读取无法越过未应用的桥接，且后续写入无法将冷投票与普通接受相结合。 后续操作遵循同一个已恢复的基础（foundation）和一个普通已执行前缀。

sents.en: Bridge acceptance disables early client votes; ordered application installs the foundation and permanently enables strict-prefix execution.
sents.zh: 桥接接受会禁用早期的客户端投票；按序应用会安装基础（foundation）并永久启用严格前缀执行。

sents.en: Reads cannot pass an unapplied bridge, and later writes cannot combine cold votes with ordinary acceptances.
sents.zh: 读取无法越过未应用的桥接，且后续写入无法将冷投票与普通接受相结合。

sents.en: Later operations follow one recovered foundation and one ordinary executed prefix.
sents.zh: 后续操作遵循同一个已恢复的基础（foundation）和一个普通已执行前缀。

paragraphs.en: The designated reply replica is implemented as a logical ingress. The planner chooses this ordinary write ingress using the modeled end-to-end write cost, rather than simply choosing the nearest replica. A designated completion owner, when usable, becomes the ingress for its key. The client can also submit the same write directly to the leader while retaining that ingress identity. Duplicate submissions are coalesced. A leader’s executed-result notification does not let the ingress acknowledge a write it has not itself executed. These routes change message arrival times, not certificate conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 指定的应答副本被实现为一个逻辑入口。 规划器使用建模的端到端写入开销来选择这个普通写入入口，而不是简单地选择最近的副本。 在可用时，指定的完成所有者会成为其键的入口。 客户端也可以在保留该入口身份的同时，将同一写入直接提交给领导者。 重复提交会被合并。 领导者的已执行结果通知不能让入口确认一个它自己没有执行过的写入。 这些路由只会改变消息到达时间，而不会改变证书条件。

paragraphs.en: Accepting replicas send ordinary votes to the leader and the learners selected to complete writes; eligible writes additionally generate client votes. Restricting recipients reduces traffic. It does not reduce the number or identity requirements of the votes a recipient must collect. Commit notices and repair messages let other replicas learn and execute the chosen history. Recipient selection is an optimization; delaying publication of a completion gate’s own vote until it has locally established coverage is a protocol rule.
paragraphs.zh: 接受写入的副本向领导者以及被选中的学习者发送普通投票以完成写入；符合条件的写入还会额外生成客户端投票。 限制接收者可以减少流量。 它并不会减少接收者必须收集的投票的数量或身份要求。 提交通知和修复消息使其他副本能够获知并执行已选定的历史。 接收者选择是一种优化；而将完成门自身的投票延迟到本地确认覆盖之后才发布，则是一项协议规则。

paragraphs.en: A client may send the same read to more than one authorized responder and use the first valid reply. paragraphs.en: The cold-path search starts with candidate cutoff η \eta . It computes cumulative request mass over the remaining observed ranks and adds boundaries at the first complete frequency group crossing each of the fractions 1 / 7 , … , 6 / 7 1/7,\ldots,6/7 of that mass. A boundary at the end of all observed keys is omitted, and coincident boundaries are merged. There are at most seven candidates. The selected cutoff τ ≥ η \tau\geq\eta may leave a non-hot ordinary region η ≤ ρ ⁡ ( k ) < τ \eta\leq\rho(k)<\tau . If the cold path is disabled, every key uses the ordinary log. Neither boundary depends on a numeric key identifier. paragraphs.en: For memberships up to 13 13 replicas, the ordinary search considers leader/responder combinations, chooses a nearby responder for each client, and compares ingress and completion assignments. An alternative stage selects a best-mean candidate allowing certificates for all ordinary keys. Above 13 13 replicas, this all-key exploration is skipped; the inherited planner uses a bounded topology-derived base search and subsequent refinement. These are implementation search restrictions, not limits on the quorum rules. The cold stage ranks size- m m cold quorums by a workload-weighted combination of cold-read and uncontended-write cost, retains up to 64 64 candidates, and searches the measured cutoff candidates defined above. This stage screens a coarse mean-gain proxy and nearby tail quantiles. Its tail search uses a 10,000 10{,}000 ms upper bound, distinct from the 1000 1000 ms final comparison below. It prefers modeled 0.99 0.99 -quantile improvement, breaking ties by mean gain; it can also disable the cold plane.

paragraphs.en: The numerical grid, truncation bounds, and fixed offsets above are performance heuristics. They do not grant votes, leases, or read authority, and the selection test does not guarantee an improvement in measured mean or tail latency. The rank aggregation and moment-expansion boundaries in the implementation control numerical approximation independently of hot membership and candidate cold cutoffs. The profile counts both reads and writes; the model uses a configured write fraction to estimate per-key write pressure rather than inferring a separate write fraction for every key. A workload change can therefore make a fixed plan inefficient without changing its safety conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 上述数值网格、截断边界和固定偏移量均为性能启发式设置。 它们不授予投票权、租约或读取权限，且该选择测试也不保证实测平均延迟或尾延迟有所改善。 实现中的秩聚合和矩展开边界独立于热点成员资格和候选冷数据截止点来控制数值近似。 该画像同时统计读和写；模型使用配置的写入比例来估计每个键的写入压力，而不是为每个键单独推断一个写入比例。 因此，工作负载的变化可能使固定计划变得低效，而不改变其安全条件。

paragraphs.en: Is the metadata used to justify pruning already final? EPaxos Revisited [ 75 ] uses sequence numbers and dependencies to prune commands that appear to execute after the current instance. A tentative PREACCEPTED tuple can differ from the tuple fixed by COMMIT , so using it to authorize a cutoff can expose an incorrect order.

paragraphs.en: In Figure 11 , command X X first commits at r 0 r_{0} with no dependencies. Command Y Y subsequently commits with a dependency on X X , so r 0 r_{0} executes X X before Y Y . At r 2 r_{2} , however, a delayed PREACCEPT for X X arrives only after Y Y has committed. The tentative local tuple gives X X a higher sequence number and a dependency on Y Y . If the pruning rule treats that tentative tuple as final evidence, it removes X X from Y Y ’s dependency chain and permits r 2 r_{2} to execute Y Y first. The later COMMIT for X X overwrites the tentative tuple, but it arrives too late to undo the order already exposed at r 2 r_{2} . Replica r 2 r_{2} subsequently executes X X , reversing r 0 r_{0} ’s order and violating execution consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 在图 11 中，命令 X X 首先在 r 0 r_{0} 处提交，且没有依赖项。 命令 Y Y 随后提交，并依赖 X X，因此 r 0 r_{0} 先执行 X X 再执行 Y Y。 然而在 r 2 r_{2} 处，X X 的延迟 PREACCEPT 消息在 Y Y 已经提交之后才到达。 该暂定的本地元组给 X X 一个更高的序列号，并带有对 Y Y 的依赖。 如果清理规则将该暂定元组视为最终证据，它会把 X X 从 Y Y 的依赖链中移除，并允许 r 2 r_{2} 先执行 Y Y。 X X 的后续 COMMIT 会覆盖该暂定元组，但到达得太晚，无法撤销 r 2 r_{2} 已经暴露的执行顺序。 副本 r 2 r_{2} 随后执行 X X，颠倒了 r 0 r_{0} 的顺序，违反了执行一致性。

paragraphs.en: Normal-path processing and fast decisions produce the tuples shown in Figure 12 . The full committed graph is one SCC. Commands C C and A A tie at sequence 1, and the replica-ID tie-breaker places C C before A A ; B B has sequence 2. Replica r 0 r_{0} selects B B as its execution root and executes C , A , B C,A,B . Replica r 1 r_{1} , however, learns the committed B B tuple while executing A A . The reciprocal dependency and strict sequence inequality allow it to prune B B . The cutoff hides C C , whose final tuple is not yet known locally. It executes A A , later learns C C , and executes C C , reversing the order of the conflicting pair A , C A,C and violating execution consistency despite the pruned node’s committed metadata.
paragraphs.zh: 正常路径处理与快速决策产生的元组如图 12 所示。 完整的已提交图是一个强连通分量（SCC）。 命令 C C 和 A A 在序列 1 上并列，副本 ID 决胜规则将 C C 排在 A A 之前；B B 的序列为 2。 副本 r 0 r_{0} 选择 B B 作为其执行根，并依次执行 C, A, B。 然而副本 r 1 r_{1} 在执行 A A 时得知了已提交的 B B 元组。 这种相互依赖关系加上严格的序列不等式使其得以剪除 B B。 该剪裁把 C C 隐藏了起来，因为其最终元组在本地尚不可知。 它执行 A A，随后得知 C C 并执行 C C，颠倒了冲突对 A, C 的顺序，从而尽管被剪除节点带有已提交的元数据，仍违反了执行一致性。

paragraphs.en: Can retrying a timed-out write cause the same client operation to take effect twice? In Bodega [ 29 ] , the client’s timeout retry path assigns a new request identifier to each write attempt. The server treats the original request and its retry as separate writes, so both can execute.
paragraphs.zh: 重试一次超时的写入是否会导致同一客户端操作生效两次？ 在 Bodega [ 29 ] 中，客户端的超时重试路径会为每次写入尝试分配一个新的请求标识符。 服务器将原始请求及其重试视为两次独立的写入，因此两者都可能执行。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 14 , the first attempt of W 1 W_{1} , with request identifier u u , sets x = 1 x=1 , but its reply is delayed. Client C 2 C_{2} reads x x and obtains 1 1 , then completes W 2 = Write ​ ( x , 2 ) W_{2}=\textsc{Write}(x,2) . After timing out, C 1 C_{1} resubmits Write ( x , 1 ) (x,1) with a new identifier u ′ ≠ u u^{\prime}\neq u . The server executes the retry, overwriting 2 2 with 1 1 , and its reply completes C 1 C_{1} ’s write. A subsequent read by C 2 C_{2} returns 1 1 . The first read requires W 1 W_{1} to take effect before W 2 W_{2} . If both attempts belong to the same write W 1 W_{1} , there is no additional write after W 2 W_{2} , so the final read must return 2 2 . Returning 1 1 therefore violates linearizability for these client operations.

paragraphs.en: Table 4 compares AI-greement with prior AI-based work that generates algorithms or protocols automatically. AI-driven discovery has already produced new algorithms, but mostly for single-node code or for policies that a simulator can score. For distributed systems, prior AI work either synthesizes verified implementations of a fixed specification, finds bugs in existing protocols, learns small protocols checked only for a bounded number of processes, without a performance objective, or assists humans in designing protocols proved by hand.

paragraphs.en: To compare discovery procedures, we adopt the nomenclature of SkyDiscover [ 44 ] , which decomposes AI-driven discovery into four components, and use it to describe all systems in Table 5 , including AI-greement . A context builder assembles the prompt from the problem and from earlier solutions, a solution generator produces candidates, an evaluator scores them (by simulation, benchmarking, testing, or proof checking), and a solution selector decides which earlier solutions guide the next iteration. AI-greement follows the same loop. It differs in three ways: its context is a curated consensus knowledge base rather than prior programs alone, its evaluator stages benchmarks, fault injection, and Lean proofs so that cheaper checks reject candidates first, and its selector is the agent itself, which chooses a parent from recorded lessons rather than from a population by a fixed rule.
paragraphs.zh: 为了比较各发现流程，我们采用 SkyDiscover [44] 的命名法，该方法将 AI 驱动的发现分解为四个组成部分，并用它来描述表 5 中的所有系统，包括 AI-greement。 上下文构建器根据问题和先前的解来组装提示词，解生成器产生候选解，评估器对候选解打分（通过仿真、基准测试、测试或证明检查），解选择器决定由哪些先前解来指导下一轮迭代。 AI-greement 遵循同样的循环。 它在三方面有所不同：其上下文是经过整理的共识知识库，而不仅仅是先前程序；其评估器分阶段进行基准测试、故障注入和 Lean 证明，使得成本更低的检查先淘汰候选解；其选择器是智能体本身，它从记录的经验教训中而非按固定规则从种群中选择父代。

paragraphs.en: The selectors of FunSearch, AlphaEvolve, ADRS, and SkyDiscover come from evolutionary computation and operate on a population of candidates. In the island model , the population is split into subpopulations (islands) that evolve independently: each new candidate is built from parents of a single island, and islands occasionally exchange their best candidates or are reseeded from stronger ones, which keeps the search from converging prematurely on one line of solutions. MAP-Elites preserves diversity differently, by keeping the best candidate for each cell of a grid of solution features, such as program length or behavior. None of the other systems maintains such a population: AlphaDev and GGMS select by tree search, IDS by a coordinator, and Glia and AI-greement by the agent’s own judgment.
paragraphs.zh: FunSearch、AlphaEvolve、ADRS 和 SkyDiscover 的选择器源自进化计算，作用于一个候选种群。 在岛屿模型中，种群被划分为独立演化的子种群（岛屿）：每个新候选由单一岛屿的父代构建而来，岛屿之间偶尔交换各自的最优候选，或用更强的候选重新播种，从而避免搜索过早收敛到单一路径的解上。 MAP-Elites 则以另一种方式保持多样性，即为解特征网格（例如程序长度或行为）的每个单元保留最优候选。 其他系统均不维护这样的种群：AlphaDev 和 GGMS 通过树搜索进行选择，IDS 通过协调器进行选择，Glia 和 AI-greement 则通过智能体自身的判断进行选择。

paragraphs.en: Three challenges set consensus apart from the problems that AI-driven discovery has addressed so far. (C1) Performance conflicts with correctness: the cheapest way to reduce latency is to shrink a quorum or skip a round, which breaks agreement, so a performance score alone steers the search toward incorrect protocols. (C2) Tests cannot establish correctness: safety violations arise in rare interleavings of messages, failures, and recovery that benchmarks seldom reach, so safety requires a proof, and a proof is only as good as its specification. (C3) Evaluation is expensive: each candidate requires an implementation, a geo-distributed benchmark, fault injection, and a proof attempt, which takes minutes to hours rather than seconds, so thousands of candidates cannot be evaluated. Table 6 shows which of these challenges prior work faces. In classical algorithms and in distributed-systems policies, every candidate is either valid by construction or checked exactly and cheaply, so none of the three arises. The few AI-driven approaches to distributed protocols sidestep them by dropping the performance objective, fixing the specification, or restricting the search to three or four processes.
paragraphs.zh: 共识问题与目前为止人工智能驱动发现所解决的问题相比，面临三大挑战。 (C1) 性能与正确性冲突：降低延迟最廉价的方法是缩小仲裁规模或跳过某一轮，但这会破坏一致性，因此仅凭性能评分会将搜索引向不正确的协议。 (C2) 测试无法确立正确性：安全性违规出现在消息、故障与恢复的罕见交错情形中，而基准测试很少触及这些情形，因此安全性需要证明，而证明的好坏取决于其规约。 (C3) 评估代价高昂：每个候选方案都需要一个实现、一次地理分布式基准测试、故障注入以及一次证明尝试，这需要数分钟到数小时而非数秒，因此无法评估数千个候选方案。 表 6 展示了先前工作面临这些挑战的情况。 在经典算法和分布式系统策略中，每个候选方案要么在构造上即有效，要么可以被精确且廉价地验证，因此这三项挑战均不会出现。 少数针对分布式协议的人工智能驱动方法通过放弃性能目标、固定规约或将搜索限制在三到四个进程来规避这些挑战。
